Short Description
Description

Description

We are actively looking for exceptionally talented individuals who are collaborative, confident and motivated to provide a first-class experience to our clients. If you have an entrepreneurial mind-set and are looking to constantly challenge yourself, J.P. Morgan is the place for you. You will be working alongside a team of talented colleagues from across the Front Office and other businesses functions, providing you with the opportunity to take your career to the next level.

Job Summary

As a Relationship Partner, you will play a crucial role in supporting our Client Advisors by managing and coordinating all service and maintenance related activities for our Private Bank Clients. You will act as the primary point of contact for service needs, ensuring seamless communication and exceptional client satisfaction. Working collaboratively with client advisors, integrated team members, operations and technology teams, you will facilitate exceptional service delivery for our clients. Your passion for client service, coupled with strong communication and relationship management skills, will drive the success of our client engagements.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Oversee and coordinate all client servicing and account maintenance activities, ensuring a high standard of client service excellence.

  • Coordinate with Advisors, Operations, Middle Office, and Onboarding teams to ensure client documentation and servicing requirements are met, prioritizing client needs and expectations.

  • Address and resolve Client and Advisor inquiries and issues promptly and professionally.

  • Execute client transactions relating to cash / liquid positions, corporate actions and inquiries accurately and timely, adhering to established policies and procedures.

  • Monitor and manage client cash long and short balances, liaising with clients as necessary to maintain account positions.

  • Facilitate investments in liquidity funds and foreign exchange (cash management) for clients within set limits.

  • Identify and escalate cross-sell opportunities to bankers and product partners.

  • Drive digital adoption through client education and outreach.

  • Lead completion of the client Periodic Review process.

  • Investigate and resolve potential or actual fraud situations, errors, and losses promptly.

  • Support business, team, and Advisor projects, contributing to overall team success.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in finance, business administration, law, or a related field; advanced degree or certifications (e.g., CFA, IMC) are a plus.

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, both written and oral, with a demonstrated ability to engage effectively with clients.

  • Experience in a similar role within the financial services or banking industry, with a proven track record of client service excellence.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly PowerPoint and Excel; familiarity with CRM systems is advantageous.

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with a strong commitment to accuracy and quality in all tasks.

  • Excellent judgment and problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate complex client situations.

  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team, consistently prioritizing the client experience.

  • Fluency in English and Spanish. Portuguese and other languages are a plus.

title: Hematology/Oncology Specialist - Louisville, KY
description:
Role Overview & Key Functions:

The Hematology-Oncology Specialist maintains strong professional relationships in the patient care continuum and represents the integrity of Karyopharm Therapeutics by providing approved disease and product information and resources to key decision makers and stakeholders within the oncology community practice setting.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop business plans, market analysis, and strategy that link to strong business results and execute accordingly
  • Position on-label benefits for appropriate patients to key customer stakeholders to achieve or exceed forecasted sales goals
  • Resolve issues at account level to ensure access to therapy
  • Coordinate with colleagues in cross-functional areas including Market Access, Clinical Education, and Medical Affairs to facilitate customer and patient access to Karyopharm product(s) and information
  • Provide customer feedback to internal stakeholders, sharing best practices, unmet needs, and business opportunities
  • Assist Marketing function in identifying and inviting appropriate healthcare professionals (HCPs) to promotional and educational events or programs
  • Develop and maintain mastery of clinical and technical knowledge related to product(s) promoted, the oncology marketplace, and disease management
  • Foster and develop relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), decision makers, influencers, and key stakeholders within the oncology community
  • Deliver clinical and technical value at medical meetings by staffing promotional booths, as requested
  • Comply with all laws and regulations and adhere to company compliance guidelines, policy and procedures
  • Acts with a sense of urgency on behalf of patients and customers

Candidate Profile & Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree, required
  • 5+ years of pharmaceutical sales experience, with a documented history of success
  • 2+ years’ oncology or rare disease pharmaceutical sales experience, including product launch(es)
  • Experience in Hematology and/or Multiple Myeloma preferred
  • Existing relationships with oncology practices in territory, preferred
  • Strong business acumen
  • Must reside in close proximity to the geography or be willing to relocate to it
  • Valid driver's license and the ability to travel as necessary

At Karyopharm, base pay is one part of a competitive total rewards package that includes comprehensive benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k), and more), equity and the potential to receive annual target bonuses. Actual pay is based on factors such as location, experience, skills, education, and internal equity. We maintain broad salary ranges to reflect market conditions and the specialized nature of our work. The anticipated base salary range for this position is $170 K - $210 K USD.

Our Value Proposition:

This is a uniquely exciting time to join Karyopharm Therapeutics where we are pioneering the science of nuclear export inhibition to develop differentiated therapies for patients with cancer. We are building upon an established commercial foundation in multiple myeloma while advancing the potential of selinexor across additional hematologic and solid tumor cancers including myelofibrosis and TP53 wild-type endometrial cancer, areas where patients continue to face significant unmet needs.

Our lead therapy, XPOVIO® (selinexor), is a first-in-class inhibitor of exportin 1 (XPO1) and is approved in the U.S. for adults with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma, with approvals in more than 50 countries and territories outside the U.S. We are also exploring opportunities to evaluate XPO1 inhibition across myeloproliferative neoplasms and TP53 wild-type driven solid tumors using next-generation compounds, including eltanexor.

As we prepare for our next phase of growth, we are continuing to invest in critical capabilities across the organization to support future opportunities and deepen our impact in oncology. We are looking for talented people who are motivated by meaningful work, energized by growth and momentum, and excited by the opportunity to help shape what comes next in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where individual contributions are visible and valued.

Learn more at Karyopharm Therapeutics.

title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer
description:
PathAI's mission is to improve patient outcomes with AI-powered pathology.

PathAI is transforming traditional pathology methods into powerful, new technologies. These innovations in pathology can help accelerate drug development, improve confidence in the accuracy of diagnosis, and get life-saving therapies to patients more quickly. At PathAI, you'll work with a diverse and talented team of people, who are dedicated to solving complex problems and making a huge impact.

We're looking for a skilled staff level Site Reliability Engineer focused on designing, architecting, and operating our cloud-native and multi-cloud deployment substrates, environment configurations, and delivery and deployment infrastructure across diverse environments - including connected and air-gapped on-premises setups, as well as customer-managed and PathAI-managed cloud environments.

The Opportunity

  • Advancing the state of our operations by implementing SRE best practices - focusing on users, monitoring, and automation.
  • Designing, building, and owning our deployment substrates, including core environment definitions, delivery plumbing, and infrastructure configuration management across multi-cloud, on-premises (both connected and air-gapped), and customer-managed cloud environments.
  • Architecting secure, compliant, multi-account cloud environments adhering to NIST, ISO, and SOC2 standards.
  • Integrating cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines with internal developer platforms, connected/air-gapped on-premises customer environments, and hybrid cloud targets.
  • Improving the reliability and resilience of our infrastructure through root-cause analysis and reviewing gaps in designs, and implementations of our infrastructure.
  • Participating in platform on-call rotations and assisting with urgent incident response.

Who You Are:
(Required)

  • You have 8+ years of relevant experience.
  • You have deep expertise with multi-cloud platform architectures, identity and access management, and multi-environment network topology.
  • You have a proven track record defining infrastructure and deployment substrates as code using modern IaC tools Timz(Terraform, Crossplane) and GitOps practices (ArgoCD) across Kubernetes clusters, cloud environments, and hybrid/on-prem infrastructure.
  • You have extensive experience managing container orchestration platforms at scale (EKS/Kubernetes/K3s) and building self-service environment templates for engineering teams across cloud and on-premises deployment targets.
  • You have strong software engineering background in languages such as Python, Go, or Bash for building platform tooling, automation pipelines, and infrastructure plumbing.
  • You have experience building key signal infrastructure with modern observability tools (Datadog/Grafana/Prometheus).
  • You work hard to eliminate toil by automating environment provisioning, deployment workflows, and configuration management.
  • You’ve managed critical production infrastructure and are familiar with incident response, scaling, and rapid growth related challenges to operating multi-cloud and on-prem environments.
  • You have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
  • You have an insatiable intellectual curiosity and the ability to learn quickly in a complex space.

This is a hybrid position based in Boston (preferred), NYC, Indianapolis. (A remote option may be considered for an exceptional candidate.)
Relocation benefits are not available for this position.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location Boston, MA is $146,250 - $225,000. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

PathAI is an equal opportunity employer. It is our policy and practice to employ, promote, and otherwise treat any and all employees and applicants on the basis of merit, qualifications, and competence. The company's policy prohibits unlawful discrimination, including but not limited to, discrimination on the basis of Protected Veteran status, individuals with disabilities status, and consistent with all federal, state, or local laws.

title: Data Architect
description:
Overview

The ForHealth Consulting Data Architect reports to the Deputy CIO. The Data Architect is a strategic role responsible for designing, guiding, and governing the organization's data architecture in alignment with business strategy, enterprise priorities, and technology direction. This role partners with business leaders, enterprise, security, and solution architects, analytics teams, application teams, data engineers, and governance stakeholders to define scalable, secure, and sustainable data capabilities that support operational excellence, decision-making, and transformation initiatives.

In a healthcare consulting environment, the Data Architect plays a critical role in shaping how data is structured, governed, integrated, shared, and leveraged across the organization. This includes supporting enterprise data models, information flows, interoperability needs, reporting and analytics enablement, master and reference data strategies, and data governance practices in a regulated and service-oriented environment.

The Data Architect brings strong experience in enterprise data architecture, data modeling, integration design, data governance, analytics enablement, and information management, with the ability to bridge business needs and technical solutions across a complex organization.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities

- Build and maintain relationships as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders on enterprise data strategy, data architecture standards, and information design decisions.- Work closely with the Market Growth and Transformation and solution set teams to support business development, relationship development and client relationship management, representing Digital Solutions in sales opportunities, proposals, client meetings, discussions and projects.- Participate in architecture reviews, investment discussions, and governance processes to assess alignment with target-state data architecture.- Contribute to architecture governance processes by evaluating strategic initiatives for alignment with target-state data architectures.- Communicate architecture concepts, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.- Facilitate workshops and working sessions to clarify business information needs, validate assumptions, and align teams on design direction.- Define, maintain, and evolve the organization's enterprise data architecture, including conceptual, logical, and high-level physical data design principles.- Establish and promote data architecture standards, patterns, reference models, and design principles aligned with the broader Enterprise Architecture practice.- Define target-state data architecture that supports business capabilities, digital transformation, reporting, analytics, integration, and operational needs.- Ensure alignment between data architecture, business architecture, application architecture, and technology architecture.- Develop and maintain enterprise information models, domain models, canonical data structures, and data flow views that support consistency and reuse across the organization.- Guide data modeling efforts for major initiatives, including conceptual, logical, and physical design considerations.- Define data entities, relationships, ownership boundaries, lifecycle expectations, and key information dependencies.- Support consistent use of business definitions, data standards, metadata, and naming conventions across platforms and teams.- Define architectural approaches for data integration, data exchange, interoperability, APIs, messaging, batch and real-time data flows, and platform-to-platform connectivity.- Partner with application, solution, and integration teams to design reliable, maintainable, and scalable data movement patterns.- Support data architecture decisions across cloud, SaaS, on-premises, and hybrid environments.- Ensure integration and interoperability strategies align with enterprise standards, business needs, and security/privacy requirements.- Partner with data governance stakeholders to define and support data ownership, stewardship, data quality, metadata management, lineage, classification, retention, and lifecycle practices.- Contribute architectural guidance that improves the consistency, trustworthiness, and usability of enterprise data.- Support governance forums and initiatives that address data standards, shared definitions, quality issues, and information risk.- Collaborate with business and technical teams to define control points and architecture patterns that improve data quality and reduce fragmentation.- Support architecture planning for data platforms that enable reporting, dashboards, analytics, business intelligence, and advanced data use cases.- Partner with analytics, reporting, and data engineering teams to align architectural decisions to business intelligence and decision-support needs.- Define data architecture considerations for warehousing, data lakes/lakehouses, semantic models, and other enterprise information delivery structures.- Enable scalable access to trusted data for operational and strategic reporting while balancing performance, security, and maintainability.- Ensure data architecture incorporates appropriate controls for data protection, privacy, access management, encryption, retention, de-identification, masking, and secure sharing.- Collaborate with security, privacy, legal, and compliance stakeholders to align architecture designs to regulatory and contractual obligations.- Support risk-aware architecture decisions involving sensitive, confidential, and healthcare-related information.- Promote secure and compliant information management practices in alignment with enterprise and solution architecture standards.- Identify opportunities to simplify the data landscape, improve reuse, reduce redundancy, and increase consistency across enterprise platforms.- Evaluate emerging technologies, patterns, and industry approaches related to data management, interoperability, analytics, and governance.- Contribute to the development of architecture playbooks, reusable artifacts, standards documentation, and reference architectures.- Support the ongoing maturity of the Enterprise Architecture practice through collaboration, knowledge sharing, and data architecture leadership.

Qualifications

Qualifications

•Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Management, Engineering, Healthcare Informatics, or a related field.•5+ years of experience in data architecture, information architecture, data engineering, solution architecture, enterprise data management, or related roles.•Experience designing and documenting enterprise data models, integration patterns, information flows, and target-state data architectures.•Strong understanding of data architecture principles, data modeling, metadata concepts, data governance, integration design, and analytics enablement.•Experience working across business and technical stakeholder groups in complex enterprise environments.•Familiarity with structured and semi-structured data concepts, enterprise reporting environments, and data lifecycle practices.•Excellent communication, facilitation, and presentation skills, including the ability to explain technical data concepts to non-technical stakeholders.•Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

Additional Information

Preferred Qualifications:

•Experience in healthcare, healthcare consulting, payer, provider, life sciences, public sector health, or other regulated industries.•Familiarity with architecture and data management frameworks, methods, and standards.•Experience supporting digital transformation, platform modernization, reporting modernization, or enterprise integration initiatives.•Master's degree in a related field.•Relevant certifications such as data architecture or data management certifications, DAMA-related credentials, cloud data platform certifications, and TOGAF.

title: Automotive Supervisor / Shop Foreman
description:
About Carvana
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period. To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website. Using our Carvana Certified 150-point inspection process, we’re able to verify that every vehicle meets our rigorous mechanical and cosmetic standards.

We strive to provide only the highest quality vehicles to our customers in our mission to deliver a no-hassle, better car buying experience. We are actively looking for passionate and talented individuals who can help us deliver on that promise.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Keep reading below to see what we’re looking for!

Position Overview:

The Automotive Supervisor role is a front-line supervisor role, responsible for directly managing and developing a team of hourly associates in an Inspection Center to regularly achieve production targets. This role is not visa eligible.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Manage the movement of cars into and out of the Inspection Center safely for repairs, while meeting or exceeding set production and quality goals.
  • Meet or exceed inventory production goals on a daily, weekly and monthly basis.
  • Oversee day-to-day activities of assigned team; identify team’s strengths and weaknesses; determine areas of opportunity and the appropriate steps to improve.
  • Engage assigned team, provide appropriate coaching, development and performance management; offer feedback and demonstrate desired skills.
  • Create a work and team environment that inspires positive communication, team cohesion, and adherence to Carvana’s Values.
  • Proactively communicate information to team members, providing clear understanding of expectations, performance measures, and goals.
  • Prevent and resolve conflict among team members.
  • Monitor and ensure adherence to systems, policies, procedures, and performance standards.
  • Review and approve identified mechanical and physical defects of incoming inventory.
  • Lead a team of production associates and partner with the Inspection Center General Manager to repair or reject inventory based on estimated cost of repairs and/or the overall quality of the vehicle.
  • Train a team of production associates using Quality Control standards to identify and complete repairs effectively and efficiently the first time, minimizing re-checks and delays in production.
  • Identify and complete repairs effectively and efficiently the first time, to minimize re-work and delays in production.

title: Senior ServiceNow Solution Consultant – CRM
description:

title: Assessments & Exercises Vice President - Penetration Testing
description:
Drive the security of critical banking applications and platforms through hands-on offensive testing.
As an Assessments & Exercises Senior Associate in the Cybersecurity and Technology Controls organization, you will play a key role in safeguarding the firm's most vital assets. Your primary responsibility will be to plan, execute, and report on penetration tests targeting high-impact applications, platforms, and services, including those that use AI and large language models (LLMs). You will use industry-standard methodologies, advanced techniques, and AI-assisted tooling to find vulnerabilities, work with application owners to understand root causes, and guide effective remediation to strengthen the firm's security posture.
We are seeking candidates with a passion for offensive security, deep technical expertise in penetration testing, an interest in how AI is changing both the attack surface and the way testing is done, and a commitment to continuous learning and excellence


Job responsibilities
  • Plan, scope, and execute penetration testing engagements across a variety of environments, including web applications, APIs, cloud platforms, infrastructure, thick-client, mobile, and AI/LLM-enabled applications.
  • Perform manual and automated testing to identify vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and security weaknesses, using industry-standard tools, custom scripts, and AI-assisted techniques.
  • Assess AI/LLM-enabled applications for common risks such as prompt injection, sensitive data leakage, and insecure integrations with tools or plugins.
  • Use AI tools to make testing more efficient and broader in coverage and contribute to building AI-enabled tooling and automation that scales testing across the team.
  • Document and communicate findings through comprehensive reports that include technical details, risk assessments, and actionable remediation recommendations.
  • Conduct peer reviews of penetration test reports to ensure accuracy, consistency, and quality of deliverables.
  • Collaborate with development, infrastructure, and security teams to clarify findings, support remediation efforts, and provide subject matter expertise on offensive security.
  • Stay current with emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and attack techniques, including those targeting AI systems, by using threat intelligence, security research, and relevant industry groups.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of penetration testing methodologies, tools, and frameworks, including more continuous and automated testing approaches, in alignment with firm strategy and regulatory requirements.

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills
  • 5+ years of hands-on penetration testing experience in offensive security, with a proven track record of scoping, executing, and reporting on complex engagements.
  • Expertise in manual penetration testing of web, API, cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), infrastructure, thick-client, and/or mobile (Android/iOS) applications, including the use of industry-standard tools.
  • Strong understanding of security assessment methodologies such as the OWASP Top Ten, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, and other relevant standards.
  • Familiarity with AI/LLM security risks and practical experience using AI tools to support offensive security work.
  • Ability to identify and articulate systemic security issues related to threats, vulnerabilities, and risks, and provide clear, actionable recommendations for remediation.
  • Exceptional organizational and communication skills, including the ability to write detailed technical reports and present findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Continuous learner who keeps up with the latest offensive security trends, tools, and techniques.

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills
  • Experience in testing Public cloud environments like AWS, Azure and GCP with proficiency in at least one platform.
  • Hands-on experience testing AI/LLM-enabled applications, and familiarity with frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications or MITRE ATLAS.
  • Experience developing scripts, tools, or automation (including AI-enabled tooling) to scale or streamline penetration testing.
  • Knowledge of cybersecurity practices, operational risk management, and incident response methodologies within the US financial services sector, including relevant regulations, threats, and risks.
  • Proficiency in penetration testing and security concepts for both Windows and Unix-like operating systems.
  • Experience conducting security-focused source code reviews (e.g., Python, Java).
  • Experience in reverse engineering thick-client and mobile applications to identify vulnerabilities.
  • Relevant certifications such as OSWE, CREST (CRT, CCT), OSCP, OSCE, OSAI and GXPN.

title: Senior People Advisor
description:
About DAT

DAT is an award-winning employer of choice and a next-generation SaaS technology company that has been at the leading edge of innovation in transportation supply chain logistics for 45 years. We continue to transform the industry year over year, by deploying a suite of software solutions to millions of customers every day - customers who depend on DAT for the most relevant data and most accurate insights to help them make smarter business decisions and run their companies more profitably. We operate the largest marketplace of its kind in North America, with 400 million freights posted in 2022, and a database of $150 billion of annual global shipment market transaction data. Our headquarters are in Denver, CO, with additional offices in Missouri, Oregon, and Bangalore, India. For additional information, see.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced Senior People Advisor to join our small, high-impact People Partnering team owning programs and relationships independently, exercising sound judgment, and knowing when to escalate.

This role is more strategic than transactional. You’ll resolve day-to-day issues independently, spot patterns across teams, raise them with leaders, and turn them into practical solutions. You’ll identify what needs to happen and drive it.

You’ll also use AI in your daily work to move faster and improve quality, and help the People Partnering team and our managers do the same, with good judgment about where it genuinely adds value.

What You'll Do

Advise and coach leaders

  • Serve as the primary People contact for front-line managers to Director level leaders on performance management, team dynamics, immigration, feedback, and difficult conversations.
  • Coach in a way that builds manager capability and independence rather than handing over answers. Build trust quickly with leaders at every level, and challenge them constructively when needed.
  • Create and maintain practical tools for managers (templates, frameworks, talking points) so they grow competence in how to navigate people related matters on their own.
  • Leverage past experience supporting leaders to identify patterns and skill gaps, propose targeted interventions, and coordinate training, workshops, or reference materials.

Employee relations and compliance

  • Independently manage employee relations matters from intake to resolution, including performance concerns, conduct issues, workplace complaints, and leaves and accommodations.
  • Conduct fair, well-documented investigations and recommend outcomes. Manage performance improvement plans, terminations, and separations consistently across legislative requirements.
  • Follow documentation, timeline, and legal steps without prompting. Use judgment on when to resolve a matter yourself and when to escalate to your manager

Compensation, performance, and talent

  • Guide managers through compensation decisions, including promotions, market adjustments, and internal equity, using our job architecture, leveling, and market benchmarking data.
  • Own execution of the performance review, compensation, and promotion cycles for your client groups end to end, in partnership with People Operations. Anticipate deadlines and dependencies, and flag risks early.
  • Support performance calibration; coach managers on goal setting, rating quality, and development conversations.
  • Support talent reviews, promotion cases, and career pathing, and contribute to succession planning for key leadership roles.

Organization design, workforce planning, and change

  • Advise on org structure, spans and layers, role design, and leveling as teams grow, restructure, or integrate.
  • Partner with Finance and Talent Acquisition on headcount planning, hiring priorities, and workforce forecasts.
  • Partner with the extended People team on reorganizations, acquisitions, and integrations: coordinate timelines, communications, and process, and give managers talking points and resources to lead their teams through change.
  • Identify and mitigate people-related risks early during periods of change.

Employee engagement and People programs

  • Own follow-through on the annual Gallup engagement results with your client teams: help managers interpret results, build a concrete, prioritized action plan, and hold them to their commitments through the year, escalating when teams are off track.
  • Roll out company People programs within your client groups.
  • Identify and resolve gaps in policies, processes, and manager capability that call for scalable fixes.

People data and business insight

  • Pull, analyze, and interpret People data (attrition, engagement, headcount, DEI, performance distribution, pay equity, spans and layers) and raise insights proactively, not only on request.
  • Build recurring and ad hoc reporting for the Senior People Business Partners and business leaders, and translate the data into clear recommendations.
  • Stay current on business goals, structure, and priorities so your recommendations fit each client group instead of being one-size-fits-all.

AI adoption and process innovation

  • Use AI tools every day to draft, summarize, analyze, and research (for example case documentation, manager talking points, survey comment themes, data analysis, and policy research), and review every output yourself before it is used.
  • Identify, pilot, and share AI and automation workflows that remove manual work from People processes. Document what works (prompts, templates, workflows) so the whole team benefits.
  • Help managers use approved AI tools to write clearer, more evidence-based feedback and reviews, while keeping the judgment and the decision with the manager.
  • Protect confidentiality and fairness: keep employee personal and confidential data out of unapproved tools, check outputs for accuracy and bias, and never let AI make hiring, pay, performance, or termination decisions. Work with Legal, IT, and Security on approved tools and on evolving regulation.
  • Bring forward ideas for improving how People Partnering operates, without waiting for direction.

Team collaboration

  • Operate as an integral member of People Partnering: contribute to team initiatives, share knowledge, and mentor more junior People team members as the team grows.
  • Build strong partnerships with People Operations, Recruitment, and Workplace Experience to coordinate cyclical processes, resolve complex issues, and deliver cohesive One DAT People programs.

Required

  • 7+ years of progressive HR experience in SaaS, technology, or high-growth global companies, including at least 4–5 years as an HR Business Partner, People Advisor, or equivalent supporting people leaders.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently as part of a small team, managing a broad and varied portfolio without close oversight, with a strong sense of ownership.
  • Strong employee relations and investigations experience, including handling sensitive matters end to end.
  • Working knowledge of compensation principles: job leveling, market data, pay equity, and merit cycles; familiarity with multi-jurisdictional benefits and compensation practices in the US and Canada.
  • Practical experience with performance management, talent calibration, and organization design.
  • Solid knowledge of US federal and multi-state employment law, and working knowledge of Canadian federal and provincial employment laws.
  • Hands-on comfort with AI: you already use generative AI tools in your work, can show examples of how they improved your speed or quality, and use sound judgment on accuracy, confidentiality, and bias.
  • Strong analytical skills, comfort using data to tell a story, and proficiency with an HRIS and Excel/Google Sheets.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, executive presence, and the ability to influence without authority.
  • Sound judgment, discretion, and the confidence to deliver difficult messages with empathy.

Preferred

title: Senior Manager of FPA
description:
Senior Manager of Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)

Tampa, Florida | $140,000 Base Salary

An Outstanding Opportunity for a High-Performing Accounting & Finance Professional!

Are you a high-performing audit professional looking to take the next step in your career and move into a more strategic finance role?

We are working with a large, privately held, rapidly growing company approaching $500 million in annual revenue that is looking to add a talented Senior Manager of Financial Planning & Analysis to its finance team.

This is an opportunity to join a financially sophisticated organization with an outstanding reputation for its culture and how it treats its employees. The CFO and Controller both came from Big 4 backgrounds. The CFO is particularly well regarded as a leader and mentor and is someone people genuinely enjoy working for.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone with a strong public accounting foundation who wants to move beyond auditing financial statements and become directly involved in helping run and grow a business.

The Opportunity

The Senior Manager of FP&A will report directly to the CFO and play a key role in the company's financial planning, forecasting, budgeting, and strategic decision-making processes.

This is a highly visible position with significant exposure to executive leadership. As the company continues to grow, this individual will have the opportunity to help build and develop the FP&A function, with a clear career path toward a Director of FP&A role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the annual budgeting process and ongoing financial forecasting.
  • Develop and maintain financial models to support business planning and strategic initiatives.
  • Analyze monthly financial results, identify trends, and communicate key variances to senior leadership.
  • Partner with department heads to understand financial performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Prepare executive-level financial reporting, dashboards, and presentations.
  • Evaluate business performance through revenue, expense, margin, and profitability analysis.
  • Provide financial modeling and analysis for new initiatives, investments, and growth opportunities.
  • Develop and improve financial processes, reporting capabilities, and forecasting tools.
  • Work directly with the CFO to support strategic financial decisions.
  • Help build a best-in-class FP&A function as the company continues to grow.

Ideal Background

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.
  • 4+ years of external audit experience with a Big 4 or nationally recognized public accounting firm.
  • Strong understanding of financial statements, accounting principles, and business operations.
  • Experience with financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, or financial modeling is highly desirable.
  • Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to interact with senior leadership.
  • Highly analytical, intellectually curious, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, growing organization.
  • CPA or MBA is a plus.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

  • $140,000 base salary.
  • Join a large, established private company approaching $500M in revenue.
  • Report directly to an outstanding CFO and work alongside an experienced leadership team.
  • CFO and Controller are both former Big 4 professionals.
  • Excellent company culture with a reputation for treating employees exceptionally well.
  • High visibility and direct exposure to executive leadership.
  • Opportunity to help shape the financial direction of a growing business.
  • Clear opportunity to grow into a Director of FP&A position as the company expands.
  • Excellent opportunity to transition from public accounting into a strategic corporate finance leadership role.

If you have a strong public accounting background and are looking for an opportunity to apply your skills in a growing business, work for a great CFO, and build a long-term career in corporate finance, this is absolutely worth a conversation!

title: Kierownik / Kierowniczka Warsztatu pojazdów ciężarowych i naczep

  • umiejętność organizowania pracy i ustalania priorytetów,

  • umiejętności interpersonalne oraz gotowość do przejmowania odpowiedzialności,

  • umiejętność efektywnej współpracy zarówno z zespołem mechaników, jak i klientami,

  • motywacja do rozwoju w obszarze zarządzania zespołem i działalnością serwisową,

  • sprawna obsługa komputera oraz systemów wspierających pracę serwisu,

  • znajomość języka angielskiego na poziomie umożliwiającym podstawową komunikację,

  • prawo jazdy kat. B

Oferujemy

  • zatrudnienie na podstawie umowy o pracę,

  • atrakcyjne wynagrodzenie i pakiet benefitów,

  • prywatną opiekę medyczną,

  • kartę lunchową,

  • kartę sportowo-kulturalną,

  • Pracownicze Plany Kapitałowe,

  • dużą samodzielność w prowadzeniu warsztatu,

  • możliwość zdobycia realnego doświadczenia w zarządzaniu zespołem i wynikiem serwisu,

  • pracę w międzynarodowej organizacji i możliwości dalszego rozwoju wraz z rozwijającą się siecią TIP w Polsce.

Dlaczego TIP?

TIP Trailer Services to jedna z największych firm w Europie specjalizujących się w wynajmie, serwisowaniu i naprawach pojazdów ciężarowych oraz naczep. Obsługujemy klientów z branży transportowej i logistycznej, dysponując flotą liczącą ponad 90 000 jednostek.

Pracując w TIP, dołączysz do międzynarodowej organizacji oferującej stabilne zatrudnienie, ciekawe wyzwania oraz realne możliwości rozwoju zawodowego. Więcej informacji znajdziesz na stronie: .

Rozwiń swoją karierę razem z nami

W związku z rozwojem sieci warsztatów w Polsce poszukujemy osoby na stanowisko Kierownika Warsztatu w Sosnowcu (Stryków).

To doskonała okazja dla osób, które znają realia pracy serwisowej i są gotowe na kolejny krok w swojej karierze. Jeśli obecnie pracujesz jako Doradca Serwisowy, Starszy Doradca Serwisowy, Mistrz Warsztatu, Lider Zmiany lub Koordynator Serwisu i chcesz rozwijać się w kierunku zarządzania, ta rola może być właśnie dla Ciebie.

Nie oczekujemy wieloletniego doświadczenia na stanowisku kierowniczym. Najważniejsza jest dla nas praktyczna znajomość funkcjonowania warsztatu, umiejętność organizowania pracy zespołu oraz budowania dobrych relacji z klientami.

Warsztat TIP w Sosnowcu to nowa lokalizacja, która rozpocznie działalność w najbliższych miesiącach. Poszukujemy osoby, która wesprze proces uruchomienia warsztatu, będzie współtworzyć zespół i standardy pracy oraz odegra kluczową rolę w budowaniu sprawnie funkcjonującego serwisu nastawionego na wysoką jakość usług i satysfakcję klientów.

Kogo szukamy?

Zapraszamy do aplikowania osoby, które:

  • posiadają doświadczenie w pracy serwisowej lub warsztatowej,

  • potrafią skutecznie organizować pracę zespołu i ustalać priorytety,

  • dobrze odnajdują się w kontakcie z klientami,

  • cieszą się autorytetem wśród współpracowników,

  • chcą rozwijać kompetencje menedżerskie i są gotowe przejąć większą odpowiedzialność.

Doświadczenie na stanowisku kierowniczym będzie dodatkowym atutem, ale nie jest warunkiem koniecznym. Jeśli czujesz, że nadszedł moment, aby przejść od koordynowania napraw do prowadzenia własnego zespołu, chętnie Cię poznamy.

Prześlij swoje CV i wykonaj kolejny krok w karierze razem z TIP.

title: Detail Supervisor (2nd Shift) - Tracy, CA
description:
About Carvana
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period. To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website. Using our Carvana Certified 150-point inspection process, we’re able to verify that every vehicle meets our rigorous mechanical and cosmetic standards.

We strive to provide only the highest quality vehicles to our customers in our mission to deliver a no-hassle, better car buying experience. We are actively looking for passionate and talented individuals who can help us deliver on that promise.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Keep reading below to see what we’re looking for!

Position Overview:
The Detail Supervisor role is a front-line supervisor role, responsible for directly managing and developing a team of hourly associates in an Inspection Center to regularly achieve production targets.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Manage the movement of cars into and out of the Inspection Center safely for repairs, while meeting or exceeding set production and quality goals.
  • Meet or exceed inventory production goals on a daily, weekly and monthly basis.
  • Oversee day-to-day activities of assigned team; identify team’s strengths and weaknesses; determine areas of opportunity and the appropriate steps to improve.
  • Engage assigned team, provide appropriate coaching, development and performance management; offer feedback and demonstrate desired skills.
  • Create a work and team environment that inspires positive communication, team cohesion, and adherence to Carvana’s Values.
  • Proactively communicate information to team members, providing clear understanding of expectations, performance measures, and goals.
  • Prevent and resolve conflict among team members.
  • Monitor and ensure adherence to systems, policies, procedures, and performance standards.
  • Review and approve identified mechanical and physical defects of incoming inventory.
  • Lead a team of production associates and partner with the Inspection Center General Manager to repair or reject inventory based on estimated cost of repairs and/or the overall quality of the vehicle.
  • Train a team of production associates using Quality Control standards to identify and complete repairs effectively and efficiently the first time, minimizing re-checks and delays in production.
  • Identify and complete repairs effectively and efficiently the first time, to minimize re-work and delays in production.
  • Conscientiously work in ways that decrease the possibility of injury to yourself or other team members in the shop due to spills or other preventable hazardous conditions.
  • Effectively manage multiple associates, including ensuring appropriate employee development and performance management.

What the job requires:
To be able to do your job at Carvana, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you.

  • High School Diploma or GED equivalent
  • Experience using computers
  • Must be at least 18 years of age
  • Demonstrated functional expertise in one or more areas pertaining to Carvana’s reconditioning process
  • Demonstrated understanding of our current reconditioning processes and lean principles
  • Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record (no DUIs and no more than two moving violations in the last 3 years).
  • Must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently; majority of lifting from knee to shoulder heights; other lifting required from various levels
  • Requires standing for extended periods of time with frequent stretching, reaching, walking, stooping, pushing, and/or pulling in an environment that may be cold, hot, noisy, and wet and may have fumes or odors due to vehicle maintenance.
  • Requires use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment.
  • Ability to maintain high volume and high-quality content in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to effectively delegate tasks to team members.
  • Ability to communicate and interact with others effectively in a professional, courteous manner.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and concisely, both written and oral.
  • Ability to maintain high volume and high-quality content in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize effectively.
  • Ability to resolve complex issues with guidance from others.
  • Ability to work overtime and on weekends.
  • Ability to work variable schedule(s) as necessary.

Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs.

What we’ll offer in return

  • Full-Time Position with a competitive salary
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits
  • 401K with company match
  • A multitude of perks including student loan payments, discounts on vehicles, benefits for your pets, and much more
  • A great wellness program to keep you healthy and happy, both physically and mentally
  • Access to opportunities to expand your skillset and share your knowledge with others across the organization
  • A company culture of promotions from within, with a start-up atmosphere allowing for varied and rapid career development
  • A seat in one of the fastest-growing companies in the country

Legal stuff
Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

title: Document Platform-Product-Senior Associate
description:
As a Senior Associate in Product within the Client Onboarding and Documents Platform, you will help deliver and evolve features of our Document platform. The platform covers document receipt, storage, classification, data extraction, metadata management and enterprise search. Working closely with the Vice President, Product, you will turn the roadmap into well-defined epics, stories and measurable outcomes, and see them through delivery and adoption.

You will combine a product mindset with practical technical understanding to help design service-oriented, rule-driven features that meet regulatory requirements across LOBs. You will work day to day with Engineering, Product Design, UAT, Release Management, Risk, Compliance and Operations to make sure what we build is reusable, well controlled and valued by users.

If you enjoy breaking complex problems into clear requirements, working with data to understand what is really happening, and learning how AI can improve document processing, this role is for you.

Job responsibilities:

  • Contribute to the roadmap for your feature area through user research, journey mapping and analysis of operational pain points.

  • Help define value propositions, success metrics and business cases for new features.

  • Keep track of market and vendor developments in content services, IDP and enterprise search, and support competitive analysis.

  • Own and refine the backlog for one or more features: epics, user stories, acceptance criteria and Definition of Done.

  • Work with Engineering and Product Design to specify API and event contracts, business rules and configuration, using a “build once, configure everywhere” approach.

  • Take part in agile ceremonies, manage day-to-day dependencies, and keep Jira tidy and dashboards up to date.

  • Support UAT by defining test scenarios against acceptance criteria, triaging defects and gathering release-readiness evidence and sign-offs.

  • Maintain definitions for document metadata, extracted entities, taxonomies and data dictionaries in your area.

  • Monitor quality measures (extraction accuracy, exception and reprocessing rates, search relevance) and use telemetry to analyze trends and find root causes.

  • Support AI/ML experiments by preparing evaluation datasets and ground truth, measuring results and helping design human-in-the-loop workflows.

  • Capture control requirements (privacy, access control, auditability, retention) in designs, and prepare evidence for architecture, risk and audit reviews.

  • Track adoption and platform health telemetry, contribute to incident reviews and turn findings into improvement backlog items.

  • Prepare clear status updates, demos and release notes for stakeholders and senior updates.

  • Encourage experimentation and continuous learning, and help onboard new team members.

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

  • 6+ years of experience (or equivalent expertise) in product management, business analysis, product design or software engineering, ideally on platform or shared-service capabilities

  • Experience writing high-quality epics, user stories and acceptance criteria, and managing a backlog in an agile environment (Scrum/Kanban), using Jira

  • Working understanding of service-oriented architecture, REST APIs, event-driven patterns and rule-driven configuration, with the ability to read API specifications and data models

  • Data skills: SQL, noSQL, basic data and domain modelling, and building or reading dashboards and metrics

  • Exposure to at least one document processing area: ingestion and workflow, content storage and metadata, classification, OCR/extraction, or enterprise search

  • Basic AI literacy: understanding model quality concepts (e.g., accuracy, precision/recall, confidence thresholds) and why evaluation and human-in-the-loop controls matter

  • Clear communicator who can explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and raise issues promptly

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

  • Experience in financial services, especially client onboarding or KYC documentation

  • Exposure to audit and control frameworks (privacy, access controls, evidence capture, retention)

  • Familiarity with cloud platforms, containers and CI/CD

  • Experience working in global, distributed teams across time zones

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Product Design or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)

title: M&A Sourcing Analyst (74639)
location: VALCOURT CORPORATE TX WDL - The Woodlands, TX 77381
description:
About Valcourt

Valcourt Group is a leading provider of building-envelope services across North America: Window Cleaning & Exterior Maintenance, Waterproofing & Restoration, and Roofing, operating through a family of local brands across major U.S. metros. Backed by Littlejohn & Company, we operate over 50 locations across the United States, employ more than 3,500 team members, and have completed 30 acquisitions since 2021. Our goal is to be the foremost authority in building-envelope services in North America, and acquisitions are central to that plan. We partner with founder- and family-owned businesses, keep what makes them great, and invest to help them grow.

The role

As M&A Sourcing Analyst you will be the first conversation many business owners ever have with Valcourt. This is an outreach role first: most of your week is spent on the phone, in email and in front of owners, not in spreadsheets. You will find the companies we want to partner with, earn the owner's trust, and build relationships that turn into acquisitions, sometimes over months or years. You will work directly with our SVP of Corporate Development and gain hands-on exposure to how deals are found, structured and closed: an on-the-job education in private equity-backed M&A.

Location. This role is remote, with the option to work from a Valcourt office if there is one in your market. You must have access to a major airport for travel.

What you will do

  • Identify attractive, commercial-focused acquisition targets through primary research by market and service line: window cleaning and exterior maintenance (including pressure washing and fall protection), waterproofing and restoration, and roofing.
  • Own the proprietary target database: company profiles, ownership, estimated size, contact history and next steps. Keep it accurate and current.
  • Reach owners and key executives by phone, email, letter and in person, using a consultative, relationship-first approach.
  • Write professional outreach letters and emails, and help build pitch materials that explain the Valcourt partnership.
  • Qualify opportunities with a light review of size, services, customers and fit, then hand off qualified owners to the corporate development team for valuation and LOI.
    • Note: there is no financial modeling in this role and only light financial statement review.
  • Stay in touch with owners who are "not now" so Valcourt is first in line when timing changes.
  • Work with divisional and regional leaders to prioritize markets and targets, and share pipeline updates and market intelligence.
  • Travel to meet owners, attend industry events and visit Valcourt branches (roughly 20–30%).

We’re looking for a Data Scientist to build and ship models that directly shape how Cinch retains

• Strong Python skills (pandas, scikit-learn, and gradient-boosting libraries such as XGBoost or

LightGBM)

• Advanced SQL, including complex joins, window functions, and working with large, messy tables

• Solid grounding in statistics and experimentation: hypothesis testing, A/B test design, and causal vs. correlational reasoning

• Experience with model evaluation and diagnosing problems such as class imbalance, leakage, and

concept drift

Python SQL scikit-learn / PyTorch / Keras AWS Snowflak

title: GN&C Engineer – Rendezvous & Proximity Operations (RPO)
description:
About Intuitive Machines:

Intuitive Machines is an innovative and cutting-edge space company making cislunar space accessible to both public and private customers. Our mission is to further science and exploration, communications, and economic progress from the Earth to the Moon and beyond. With multiple NASA lunar missions in development and additional private missions on our manifest, we pride ourselves in supporting NASA, our customers, and the nation in paving the way to return humans to the surface of the Moon. Our world-class team includes experts in all aspects of spacecraft subsystems design, development, and test, on-orbit operations, and safety.


This position will work on the JETS ISS Rendezvous, Proximity Operations, and Capture (RPOC) Team providing technical oversight, program integration, and certification of ISS visiting vehicle Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GN&C) systems in support of missions to the International Space Station (ISS).


The selected applicant will:

  • Certify GN&C system requirements compliance through review of analysis and test reports, including assessment of sensor performance, trajectory dispersions, and other GN&C parameters.
  • Certify fault tolerance safety requirements compliance through review of GN&C related hazard reports and associated verification evidence, including communicating issues to a Safety Review Panel.
  • Identify and recommend solutions to GN&C/RPO performance issues.
  • Communicate status of compliance reviews to ISS program management.
  • Conduct performance assessments on visiting vehicle GN&C data for Program compliance.
  • Review Monte Carlo trajectory analyses using independent 6 degrees-of-freedom simulations.
  • Provide input to operational products, such as flight rules and on-orbit demonstration plans.
  • Provide visiting vehicle’s GN&C mission console support during real-time ground monitoring.
  • Maintain relationships with a diverse technical team, including personnel from engineering, safety, flight operations, crew office, and visiting vehicle providers.
  • Perform other duties as required.


Requisition Qualifications:


  • Typically requires a bachelor's degree in engineering and a minimum of 2- 5 years of experience in the field or in a related area.
  • Experience with orbital mechanics and GN&C principles
  • Understanding of orbit, entry, descent, landing GN&C principles
  • Knowledge in the development of GN&C algorithms and spacecraft system analysis
  • Experience with design, verification, testing, and operation of GN&C hardware and software
  • Experience with LINUX, Python, and C/C++
  • Experience with design, verification, testing, and operation of GN&C hardware and software
  • Experience with the development of space system requirements and documents
  • Strong interpersonal skills to enable successful performance on a collaborative engineering team.
  • Ability to organize and prioritize tasks to meet deadlines and schedules with limited supervision.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and presentation skills
  • Ability to work in a team environment consisting of NASA civil servants and contractor employees.
  • Experience with Microsoft Office products


Requisition Preferences:

  • MS in Aerospace Engineering with a focus on GN&C, flight controls, and orbital mechanics
  • Experience with spacecraft rendezvous, proximity operations, and capture/docking
  • Familiarity with spacecraft docking systems.
  • Working knowledge of NASA, JSC, and ISS standard practices and requirements (including safety)
  • Experience with NASA flight operations and procedures
  • Familiarity with NASA/JSC documentation databases and SharePoint sites
  • Experience with MATLAB and Simulink toolboxes
  • Experience with the NASA Trick simulation architecture and JEOD (JSC Engineering Orbital Dynamics)
  • Experience with Git/GitLab version control

title: Lab Instructor – Physiotherapy
location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
description:
Liwa University, Abu Dhabi and Al Ain Campuses

Since 1993, Liwa University has stood as a cornerstone of higher education in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi, nurturing potential and supplying the UAE labour market with skilled professionals. Position’s Summary:

The Lab Instructor is responsible for supporting practical teaching, laboratory instruction, and clinical simulation activities for undergraduate students in the Physiotherapy Program. The position involves demonstrating practical techniques, preparing and managing laboratory equipment, assisting faculty during laboratory sessions, and maintaining a safe, organized, and effective learning environment.


Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Conduct and support practical laboratory sessions, hands-on exercises, and clinical simulation activities under the guidance of course faculty.
  • Demonstrate physiotherapy assessment procedures, therapeutic exercises, rehabilitation techniques, and safe clinical practices relevant to undergraduate Physiotherapy courses.
  • Apply practical knowledge of musculoskeletal anatomy and physiology, neurological rehabilitation, and cardiorespiratory physiotherapy to support laboratory teaching and student learning.
  • Demonstrate the correct use, preparation, and safe operation of physiotherapy equipment, including electrotherapy devices , therapeutic exercise equipment, and rehabilitation devices.
  • Assist faculty members in preparing laboratory manuals, practical activities, teaching materials, assessment tools, and practical examinations.
  • Support the evaluation of students’ practical competencies, monitor their performance during laboratory sessions, and maintain accurate assessment records as required.
  • Prepare and organize laboratory equipment, anatomical models, assessment tools, assistive devices, therapeutic materials, and other supplies before practical sessions.
  • Conduct routine equipment checks, perform basic troubleshooting, and support appropriate equipment maintenance to ensure that laboratory equipment is safe, functional, and ready for use.
  • Organize laboratory sessions, manage equipment and supplies, maintain inventory records, monitor consumable stock, and assist with purchase requisitions when necessary.
  • Assist and support faculty members in visiting students undertaking clinical practice placements in hospitals and rehabilitation centres, monitoring their progress, and conducting follow-up during their training.
  • Assist and support faculty members in supervising undergraduate students conducting laboratory-based research experiments as part of their graduation projects, ensuring appropriate laboratory practices and compliance with safety procedures.
  • Coordinate the appropriate handling, preparation, and transportation of clinical samples required for on-campus practical sessions, ensuring compliance with applicable biosafety, infection prevention, and sample-handling procedures.
  • Ensure compliance with university policies, laboratory safety procedures, infection prevention and control requirements, and applicable health and safety regulations.
  • Provide laboratory orientation and explain equipment-handling procedures and safety requirements to students at the beginning of each academic period.
  • Maintain accurate laboratory documentation and ensure that laboratory facilities, equipment, and supplies remain clean, organized, and suitable for teaching activities.
  • Perform duties at either university campus in accordance with the operational requirements of the programme.


Knowledge & Skills:

  • Good knowledge of musculoskeletal anatomy and physiology, neurological rehabilitation, and cardiorespiratory physiotherapy.
  • Practical understanding of therapeutic exercise, rehabilitation techniques, and physiotherapy assessment procedures.
  • Practical experience in the use and preparation of physiotherapy equipment, including electrotherapy devices, therapeutic exercise equipment, and rehabilitation devices.
  • Ability to prepare laboratory sessions, organize equipment and supplies, manage inventory, and perform basic equipment troubleshooting.
  • Knowledge of laboratory safety, infection prevention and control, and the safe use of physiotherapy equipment.
  • Good communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with faculty and students.
  • Proficiency in basic computer applications, laboratory documentation, and inventory management.


Experience:

  • Professional Experience: Minimum of 2–3 years of relevant hands-on clinical or laboratory experience in a recognized healthcare facility, rehabilitation centre, or academic institution.
  • Preferred Experience: Previous experience supporting practical teaching, clinical skills laboratories, or undergraduate physiotherapy students.
  • Additional Requirement: Strong practical knowledge of physiotherapy equipment, rehabilitation techniques, laboratory preparation, and equipment management.


Academic Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in Physiotherapy ONLY acceptable.

title: Lead Network Engineer / Cybersecurity SME
description:
Description

Required:

Experience with Cisco UCCE or ICM, CVP, CUCM, voice gateways, workforce optimization, and quality-management platforms.

description:

The Hematology-Oncology Specialist maintains strong professional relationships in the patient care continuum and represents the integrity of Karyopharm Therapeutics by providing approved disease and product information and resources to key decision makers and stakeholders within the oncology community practice setting.

  • 2+ years’ oncology or rare disease pharmaceutical sales experience, including product launch(es)
  • Experience in Hematology and/or Multiple Myeloma preferred
  • Existing relationships with oncology practices in territory, preferred
  • Strong business acumen
  • Must reside in close proximity to the geography or be willing to relocate to it
  • Valid driver's license and the ability to travel as necessary

At Karyopharm, base pay is one part of a competitive total rewards package that includes comprehensive benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k), and more), equity and the potential to receive annual target bonuses. Actual pay is based on factors such as location, experience, skills, education, and internal equity. We maintain broad salary ranges to reflect market conditions and the specialized nature of our work. The anticipated base salary range for this position is $170 K - $210 K USD.

Our Value Proposition:

This is a uniquely exciting time to join Karyopharm Therapeutics where we are pioneering the science of nuclear export inhibition to develop differentiated therapies for patients with cancer. We are building upon an established commercial foundation in multiple myeloma while advancing the potential of selinexor across additional hematologic and solid tumor cancers including myelofibrosis and TP53 wild-type endometrial cancer, areas where patients continue to face significant unmet needs.

Learn more at Karyopharm Therapeutics.

title: Clerk #4
description:
Position Title: Justice of the Peace Clerk

Overview: The Justice of the Peace (JP) Clerk in Reeves County provides administrative and clerical support to the Justice of the Peace Court, assisting with the processing of legal documents, maintaining court records, and facilitating court proceedings. This position plays a crucial role in ensuring the efficient operation of the JP Court and the delivery of prompt and effective services to the public.

Responsibilities:

  1. Case Management and Recordkeeping:
    • Receive and review incoming legal documents, including civil complaints, small claims petitions, eviction notices, traffic citations, and arrest warrants, ensuring completeness and accuracy of information.
    • Enter case information into the court's case management system, update case statuses, schedule hearings, and generate court calendars and dockets for upcoming proceedings.
    • Maintain physical and electronic court records, files, and documents in accordance with established retention schedules and archival procedures, ensuring compliance with legal requirements and confidentiality standards.
  2. Customer Service and Public Relations:
    • Serve as the primary point of contact for individuals seeking assistance or information from the JP Court, providing courteous and responsive customer service in person, by phone, and via email.
    • Assist litigants, attorneys, law enforcement personnel, and other court users with inquiries regarding case status, court procedures, filing requirements, and document retrieval, directing them to appropriate resources or personnel as needed.
  3. Courtroom Support and Assistance:
    • Prepare the courtroom for scheduled hearings, trials, and other court proceedings, ensuring availability of necessary equipment, materials, and supplies.
    • Assist the Justice of the Peace during court sessions by administering oaths, swearing in witnesses, recording case dispositions, and maintaining order and decorum in the courtroom.
  4. Document Processing and Filing:
    • Receive, review, and process various legal filings, pleadings, motions, orders, and judgments submitted to the JP Court, verifying compliance with procedural rules, fee schedules, and filing deadlines.
    • Index, file, and docket legal documents in accordance with established filing systems and indexing methods, maintaining accurate and up-to-date records of case activities and developments.
  5. Financial Transactions and Reporting:
    • Collect fees, fines, court costs, and other payments authorized by law, issue receipts for funds received, and reconcile daily cash transactions with accounting records.
    • Prepare financial reports, deposit funds into designated accounts, and submit revenue collections to appropriate county officials or financial institutions in accordance with established procedures.

Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or GED equivalent required; additional education or training in legal studies, court administration, or related field preferred.
  • Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in clerical or administrative support roles, preferably in a court or legal setting.
  • Knowledge of legal terminology, court procedures, and document processing methods, with the ability to interpret and apply relevant laws, rules, and regulations.
  • Proficiency in computer applications, including Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) and court management software systems.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to prioritize tasks, manage multiple assignments, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to communicate effectively with diverse individuals and provide courteous and professional customer service.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality, exercise discretion, and handle sensitive information with tact and professionalism.
  • Flexibility to work occasional evenings or weekends as needed to support court operations and attend special events or training sessions.

Note: This job description is intended to convey information essential to understanding the scope of the position and the general nature and level of work performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and qualifications required of a Justice of the Peace Clerk in Reeves County. Responsibilities and duties may change over time based on the needs of the county and the organization.
