title: Amazon Connect AI Solutions Architect
description:
About SimpliSafe

We’re a high-tech home security company that’s passionate about protecting the life you’ve built and our mission of keeping Every Home Secure. And we’ve created a culture here that cares just as deeply about the career you’re building. Ours is a no ego culture of collaboration and innovation where those seeking their next challenge can find big opportunities and make a huge impact on the lives of all those who we protect. We don’t just want you to work here. We want you to grow and thrive here.

We’re embracing a hybrid work model that enables our teams to split their time between office and home. Hybrid for us means we expect our teams to come together in our office on two core days, typically Tuesday, Wednesday or Thursday, to work together in person, and teams can choose where they work for the remainder of the week. We all benefit from flexibility and get to use the best of both worlds to get our work done.

Why are we hiring?

Well, we’re growing and thriving. So, we need smart, talented, and humble people who share our values to join us as we disrupt the home security space and relentlessly pursue our mission of keeping Every Home Secure.

What You'll Do

You will design and build the AI capabilities that power our Amazon Connect contact center, so customers resolve more on their own and agents and supervisors spend their time where it matters most. Our team creates seamless omnichannel engagement across voice, chat, and email and increases first contact resolution through cloud contact center solutions that support both human and virtual agents. This role centers on applying the AI features of Amazon Connect to self-service, agent support, and quality management.

Primary Responsibilities Include:

  • Design and build AI-powered self-service: Build contact flows, flow modules, Lex bots, and Agentic CX Designer (ACXD) flows in Amazon Connect. Configure intents, utterances, slots, and conversation states for voice and chat bots, then run unit, flow, and end-to-end testing.
  • Connect AI agents and keep the experience consistent: Connect AI agents and generative AI experiences to flows and queues, with clear escalation paths and clean handoffs to human agents. Use shared contact attributes, routing rules, and error handling across voice, chat, and email.
  • Set guardrails and support responsible AI: Build prompts, guardrails, and fallback logic so AI-driven interactions stay accurate, on brand, and safe. Cover data privacy, bias monitoring, and human oversight of automated decisions.
  • Implement and tune AI-assisted agent features: Cover real-time recommendations, knowledge base retrieval, contact summarization, and automated after-contact work. Build the knowledge content, integrations, and agent workspace experiences these features depend on, and use agent feedback and usage data to improve adoption.
  • Build and operate AI-assisted quality management: Set up evaluation forms, automated contact evaluation, and conversational analytics in Amazon Connect, plus sentiment analysis, categorization, and rules that surface compliance risks, coaching opportunities, and emerging customer issues. Partner with operations and quality teams to align criteria with business and regulatory standards, and measure the accuracy of AI-generated evaluations against human review.
  • Develop integrations and platform configuration: Integrate with AWS Lambda, Amazon DynamoDB, API Gateway, and third-party CRM and ticketing systems, and support core configuration including queues, routing profiles, hours of operation, and security profiles.
  • Monitor AI performance: Use Amazon Connect analytics and CloudWatch to track containment, resolution, handle time, and quality outcomes, and recommend improvements. Troubleshoot technical issues and support releases and production incidents.
  • Partner on scope, requirements, and priorities: Work with Program and Product Managers to scope feasibility, prioritize enhancements, and recommend platform optimizations. Translate business requirements from operations and CX teams into clear technical designs, with guidance from senior architects.
  • Work with vendors and evaluate new technology: Work directly with vendor partners to influence product roadmaps, rollouts, and timelines, and evaluate new CCaaS and AI technologies to help the team make informed decisions on tools and approaches.
  • Document and keep learning: Maintain technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, configuration guides, and integration workflows, and stay current on Amazon Connect, AWS AI services, and industry trends.

What You'll Bring

  • BA/BS preferred in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 4-6 years of experience with Amazon Connect, designing and implementing features and writing technical documentation.
  • Hands-on experience with Amazon Connect's AI capabilities, such as Amazon Lex, generative AI and AI agents, agent assist, conversational analytics, and automated quality evaluation, including prompt design, intent modeling, and escalation handling.
  • Experience with APIs and web services, plus working knowledge of AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, and API Gateway.
  • Understanding of AI and large language model best practices, including prompt engineering, grounding with knowledge sources, evaluation of AI output, and responsible AI, plus familiarity with contact center quality metrics such as containment, first contact resolution, and handle time.
  • Familiarity with Agile or Scrum methodologies and best practices for QA and regression testing.
  • A proactive, analytical self-starter who learns quickly, makes data-driven decisions, manages multiple projects, and works comfortably across cultures, locations, and time zones.

What Values You’ll Share

  • Customer Obsessed - Building deep empathy for our customers, putting them at the core of our work, and developing strong, long-term relationships with them.
  • Aim High - Always challenging ourselves and others to raise the bar.
  • No Ego - Maintaining a “no job too small” attitude, and an open, inclusive and humble style.
  • One Team - Taking a highly collaborative approach to achieving success.
  • Lift As We Climb - Investing in developing others and helping others around us succeed.
  • Lean & Nimble - Working with agility and efficiency to experiment in an often ambiguous environment.

What We Offer

  • A mission- and values-driven culture and a safe, inclusive environment where you can build, grow and thrive
  • A comprehensive total rewards package that supports your wellness and provides security for SimpliSafers and their families (For more information on our total rewards please click here)
  • Free SimpliSafe system and professional monitoring for your home.
  • Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that bring people together, give opportunities to network, mentor and develop, and advocate for change.

The target annual base pay range for this role is $121,900 - $162,500

This target annual base pay range represents our good-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this role. We use a market-based compensation approach to set our target annual base pay ranges and make adjustments annually. We carefully tailor individual compensation packages, including base pay, taking into consideration employees’ job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and other relevant business factors.

Beyond base pay, we offer a Total Rewards package that may include participation in our annual bonus program, equity, and other forms of compensation, in addition to a full range of medical, retirement, and lifestyle benefits. More details can be found here.

We’re committed to fair and equitable pay practices, as well as pay transparency. We regularly review our programs to ensure they remain competitive and aligned with our values.

We wholeheartedly embrace and actively seek applications from all individuals, no matter how they identify. We are committed to cultivating a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we believe our work is enriched when we incorporate a multitude of perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences. We want everyone who works here to thrive and contribute to not only our mission of keeping every home secure, but also to making our workplace safe and supportive for others. If a reasonable accommodation may be needed to fully participate in the job application or interview process, to perform the essential functions of a position, or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact careers@simplisafe.com.

title: Project Manager

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

The Project Manager is a key position at Jensen Infrastructure. You’ll design and coordinate multiple product lines for precast concrete products. You’re the point person who determines proper process flow to ultimately manufacture quality products and fulfill on-time deliveries.

Reporting to our Sales Manager, you’ll communicate with our production department regarding schedule requirements, with our customers, outside sales, and engineers regarding project contract, with our delivery and yard departments for safe and on-time delivery, and report progress and challenges to the leadership team.

A highlight of your day-to-day will include:

  • Managing and coordinating all aspects of large and/or custom projects.

  • Managing the work order process to provide accurate work orders and drawings for production.

  • Producing an accurate bill of materials (BOM) for precast concrete structures being planned for production. Inputting BOMs into the manufacturing software to reflect an accurate accounting of the cost associated with each product being manufactured on a job-by-job basis.

  • Managing project take-offs and estimating for projects in the planning and bidding stages.

  • Tracking and reporting project progress from submittal stage to product installation via our Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system.

  • Ensuring deliverables fall within the applicable scope, schedule, and budget.

  • Preparing a weekly sales report for the Sales Manager’s review and distribution to the team.

  • Ensuring that mutually agreed upon contract clearly specifies terms and conditions and all products requested clearly specify requirements per drawings and plans so that the estimates are 100% accurate for each project in support of efficiency, accuracy, and deadline adherence.

  • Communicating the date the product can be manufactured and ready for delivery, changes to orders, add-ons, and any other issues that may arise during the manufacturing process to the customers.

  • Ensuring delivery date is scheduled per customer needs and delivered as requested.

  • Obtaining project site specifications and safety standards to communicate with dispatch for offloading products, and understanding hazards for crane operators.

  • Participating in entertainment functions with customers (e.g., lunches, dinners).

  • Participating in tradeshows, seminars, and classes to improve product knowledge and/or personal skills.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

You’re enthusiastic and motivated in a fast-paced environment. You possess demonstrated project management experience, preferably in a precast concrete or building materials environment (minimum of 3 years). You’re a lifelong learner preferably with a bachelor’s degree in civil engineering or construction management. Your passion for customers comes first and you aren’t bothered by having to manage the details in the CRM. You don’t take shortcuts. You’re safety conscious not just for yourself, but for your team.

We’re open to individuals who aren’t just looking for their next job, they’re looking to build a career. You want an opportunity to showcase your skillset in dispatch/logistics, strategic planning and business development with a solid company who will invest in you. In our culture – everyone matters.

ALL ABOUT JENSEN INFRASTRUCTURE

Much like you, our founder, Don Jensen was looking for a way to support his family, so he started his Company in 1968. Since founded, we’ve been supporting communities across Nevada, California, Arizona, Washington, and Hawaii.

Jensen Infrastructure likely has an impact on your daily life. We build culverts to take water away from your neighborhoods, underground utility boxes to hold cables, and manholes to allow workers access to the sewers deep below the roads we drive on. And that’s just a small sample of what we do at Jensen on a daily basis.

When you work at one of Jensen’s many locations, you will enjoy the close relationships and camaraderie of a small company while being part of a larger, well-established, growing company.

We are committed to ensuring employment practices that promote equal opportunities. Please let us know if you require any reasonable accommodations during your interview process.

title: Lead Software Engineer- (Java Backend, AWS, AI Native)
description:
We have an opportunity to impact your career and provide an adventure where you can push the limits of what's possible.


As a Lead Software Engineer at JPMorganChase within the Consumer and Community J.P. Morgan Wealth Management technology team, you are an integral part of an agile team that works to enhance, build, and deliver trusted market-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. As a core technical contributor, you are responsible for conducting critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm’s business objectives.

In this role, you will lead the architecture and delivery of a high-throughput Investment Book of Record (IBOR) transaction processing platform for Retail clients, leveraging AWS ECS and Aurora PostgreSQL (RDS), with real-time transaction ingestion through Apache Kafka and nightly and intraday batch processing using PySpark.

Job Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable, secure, cloud-native microservices using Java and AWS, applying modern architectural patterns, domain modeling, and engineering best practices.
  • Lead the architecture and 24x7 operational integrity of the IBOR transaction processing platform, ensuring accuracy, availability, scalability, and reliable position-keeping for Retail clients.
  • Define engineering standards and reference architectures across Java, Kafka, Aurora PostgreSQL, PySpark, AWS ECS, and SRE, enabling high-quality and zero-downtime software delivery.
  • Architect and optimize Kafka real-time transaction ingestion, including topics, partitions, consumer groups, delivery semantics, idempotency, dead-letter handling, reconciliation, and performance monitoring.
  • Own Aurora PostgreSQL design and performance, including schemas, indexing, query tuning, connection pooling, high availability, disaster recovery, and capacity planning.
  • Design and optimize PySpark batch pipelines for nightly and intraday processing, incorporating orchestration, reconciliation, and data quality controls to protect the integrity of the book of record.
  • Own AWS ECS container orchestration, deployment, auto-scaling, and release strategies while driving infrastructure capacity planning and cloud cost optimization.
  • Lead production support, observability, incident management, root-cause analysis, and automation of recurring issues to improve platform stability and meet stringent SLA requirements.
  • Partner with Product, Risk, Operations, Compliance, vendors, and engineering teams to deliver robust solutions while driving adoption of enterprise-authorized AI-assisted engineering, automation, testing, and secure software development practices.
  • Drives team adoption of enterprise-authorized AI-assisted engineering practices within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and operational outcomes (e.g., AI-assisted code review/refactoring, test strategy acceleration, incident/root-cause analysis support), while establishing consistent validation standards (secure coding, peer review, automated testing) and promoting reuse of effective patterns across the team.
  • Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation.

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 5+ years applied experience
  • Experience in a technical lead or lead engineer capacity, developing, debugging, and maintaining enterprise applications.
  • Strong hands-on Java, Spring Boot, Python, Shell scripting, microservices, and REST API development, including frameworks and tools such as Maven, Gradle, JUnit, Mockito, pytest, Selenium, Playwright, Cucumber, and SonarQube.
  • Extensive AWS experience , particularly with ECS, S3, Lambda, and Aurora PostgreSQL/RDS, supporting scalable, high-throughput transactional applications.
  • Strong expertise in Apache Kafka for real-time event streaming, including topic design, partitioning, consumer scaling, and distributed system integration.
  • Strong experience with PySpark, SQL, and NoSQL databases for large-scale data processing, job orchestration, and scalable application design.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD, DevOps, Docker, Kubernetes, cloud architecture, networking, security, application resiliency, reliability, and availability.
  • Experience with IBOR, position-keeping, or transaction-processing systems in retail banking, wealth management, or financial services..
  • Proven experience across system design, development, testing, operational stability, Agile/SDLC practices, and effective use of approved AI-assisted development tools, including validation of AI outputs for correctness, performance, and security.
  • Demonstrated experience leading effective use of approved AI-assisted software development tools (e.g., for coding, code review, test acceleration, troubleshooting) with the ability to set team expectations for validating AI outputs for correctness, performance, and security.
  • Strong understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; experience coaching engineers on safe, compliant adoption within delivery practices

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer certification.
  • Experience with microservices architecture and RESTful API design.
  • Experience with logging and monitoring tools such as Splunk, Dynatrace, and Grafana.
  • Prior banking or financial services experience, particularly exposure to investment or trading platform operations — position management, balance reconciliation, and trade execution workflows.
  • Experience with capital markets or retail banking transaction and settlement systems, including real-time data reconciliation and financial data integrity controls.
  • Strong understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency.

title: Supervisor, Maintenance
description:
Overview

About ERMCO

Electric Research and Manufacturing Cooperative, Inc. (ERMCO) is the leading manufacturer of distribution transformers and engineered electrical solutions, serving electric utilities, Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), and industrial customers across North America. Headquartered in Dyersburg, Tenn., ERMCO delivers reliable, high-quality products that power homes, businesses, and communities across North America.

Job Summary

The Maintenance Supervisor leads the safe and effective execution of equipment and facility maintenance. This position supervises and develops maintenance personnel, coordinates maintenance activities with Production, and supports equipment reliability and production uptime.

The supervisor will work with the Manager of Manufacturing Engineering, Reliability and Maintenance and the maintenance team to develop practical planning, scheduling, parts-readiness, job-kitting, autonomous maintenance, and 5S practices that improve workforce productivity and equipment performance.

This role is located on-site in Dyersburg, TN. Relocation assistance is available.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities

  • Supervise, coach, and develop maintenance personnel.
  • Promote safe work practices and ensure compliance with company policies and procedures.
  • Establish daily priorities and provide clear work assignments.
  • Coordinate preventive, predictive, corrective, facility, and emergency maintenance.
  • Support equipment troubleshooting and escalate recurring or high-risk issues.
  • Help develop and sustain maintenance planning, scheduling, parts-readiness, and job-kitting practices.
  • Review work requests for appropriate priority, clear scope, labor needs, materials, and equipment access.
  • Coordinate weekly maintenance schedules with Production based on priorities, available labor, and job readiness.
  • Work with Purchasing and the storeroom to ensure required parts are available before scheduled work begins.
  • Support autonomous maintenance by partnering with Production to establish appropriate operator inspection, cleaning, lubrication, and basic equipment-care practices.
  • Implement and sustain 5S practices within maintenance shops, parts-storage locations, staging areas, and other assigned workspaces.
  • Monitor work progress and remove barriers that delay execution.
  • Ensure work orders accurately document labor, parts, repairs, equipment condition, and follow-up needs.
  • Use CMMS information to improve PM completion, backlog management, schedule performance, and workforce productivity.
  • Coordinate contractors, shutdown work, equipment installations, and assigned maintenance projects.
  • Maintain clear communication regarding equipment status, repair progress, schedule risks, and follow-up needs.

Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • Technical education or industrial-maintenance training preferred.
  • Five or more years of industrial equipment or facility-maintenance experience.
  • Supervisory, lead technician, or maintenance-coordination experience preferred.
  • Experience with CMMS work orders and preventive-maintenance programs preferred.
  • Familiarity with maintenance planning, scheduling, parts readiness, job kitting, autonomous maintenance, or 5S practices preferred but not required.
  • Working knowledge of industrial mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, hydraulic, and control systems.
  • Ability to read equipment manuals, drawings, prints, schematics, and maintenance procedures.
  • Strong leadership, communication, organization, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with Production, Manufacturing Engineering, Reliability, Purchasing, contractors, and vendors.
  • Ability to work safely in an industrial manufacturing environment and access equipment areas as required.
  • Ability to wear required personal protective equipment.
  • Ability to support weekend, shutdown, and on-call maintenance when required.
  • Ability to operate forklifts, aerial lifts, or other equipment when trained and authorized.

Let’s Build the Future TogetherAt ERMCO, your ideas matter, your growth is supported, and your impact is real. Whether you’re building on earlycareer experience or launching your professional journey, you’ll have the opportunity to learn, contribute, andgrow in a manufacturing environment that values innovation and collaboration.

Join ERMCO and TRANSFORM your career!

title: Senior Red Team Operator
description:
JPMC’s Assessment Operations organization is looking to expand its Cybersecurity Red Team with an experienced Senior Red Team Operator. The successful candidate will have a proven track record in conducting red team or network exploitation operations, and be able to demonstrate in-depth knowledge and experience around computer networking fundamentals, modern threats and vulnerabilities, attack methodologies, and red teaming tools.

As an Assessments & Exercises Vice President in the Cybersecurity and Technology Controls line of business, you will make significant contributions to enhancing the firm's cybersecurity posture by using industry-standard assessment methodologies and techniques to proactively identify risks and vulnerabilities in people, processes, and technology. In this role, you will design and execute Red Team assessments to evaluate preventative controls, incident response processes, and detection capabilities, and advise cross-functional teams on security strategy and risk management.

This position is anticipated to require the use of one or more High Risk Role (HRR) systems, which mandates successful completion of enhanced screening, including criminal and credit background checks, before starting employment and annually thereafter.

Job responsibilities

  • Design and execute multi-month, covert red team assessments against JPMorganChase and its subsidiaries to evaluate controls for effectiveness and impact on operational risk, including opportunities to automate control evaluation
  • Contribute to the development and enhancement of assessment methodologies, tools, and frameworks to strengthen the firm’s security posture
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to develop comprehensive assessment reports, including detailed findings, risk assessments, and remediation recommendations
  • Utilize threat intelligence and security research to stay informed about emerging threats, vulnerabilities, industry best practices, and regulations. Apply this knowledge to enhance the firm’s assessment strategy and risk management, and engage with peers and industry groups that share threat intelligence analytics
  • Drive adoption of AI-assisted workflows for control evaluation and reporting automation, ensuring results are validated and aligned to security, resiliency, and compliance expectations


Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • 5+ years of experience delivering covert red teaming, purple teaming, or network exploitation operations using industry-standard tools (e.g., Cobalt Strike or other C2 frameworks), with awareness of op-sec considerations and detection evasion
  • Demonstrated expertise in one or more security domains (e.g., exploitation of networks, operating systems, applications, cloud and DevOps security, Active Directory, physical security, or social engineering); experience developing custom implants, loaders, or post-exploitation tools for covert red team engagements; and an active interest in the offensive security community (e.g., through a blog, conference attendance or speaking, or open-source contributions)
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and report writing skills, with the ability to influence and engage stakeholders across various functions and levels, including senior leadership; ability to collaborate with high-performing global teams and individuals throughout the firm to accomplish common goals
  • Demonstrated experience using AI capabilities to support assessment workflows (e.g., analysis support and report drafting), with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity
  • Knowledge of US financial services sector cybersecurity or resiliency practices, operational risk management processes, principles, regulations, threats, risks, and incident response methodologies


Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Background in the Intelligence Community and/or relevant hands-on certifications, such as those offered by Offensive Security, CREST, or SANS
  • Experience with coding and developing new offensive security tools or proof-of-concept exploits, or modifying existing internal or open-source tooling
  • Experience operating within financial services environments and knowledge of sector-related cybersecurity or resiliency organization practices, operations risk management processes, principles, regulations, threats, risks, and incident response methodologies
  • Experience delivering regulatory-driven red team testing such as CBEST, TIBER, and iCAST
  • Experience conducting assessments of cloud environments, including Azure and AWS, and technologies such as Kubernetes
  • Experience assessing AI/ML-related attack techniques and controls, such as prompt injection and deepfake-enabled social engineering

The Cybersecurity & Technology Controls group at JPMorganChase aligns the firm’s cybersecurity, access management, controls and resiliency teams. The group proactively and strategically partners with all lines of business and functions to enable them to design, adopt and integrate appropriate controls; deliver processes and solutions efficiently and consistently; and drive automation of controls. The group’s number one priority is to enable the business by keeping the firm safe, stable and resilient.

We are looking for multi-disciplined forward-looking technologists like you with diverse backgrounds and experiences including in areas such as cybersecurity, big data, machine learning risk management and controls, compliance and oversight, and cloud security.

When you work at JPMorganChase, you’re not just working at a global financial institution. You’re an integral part of one of the world’s biggest tech companies. In 14 technology hubs worldwide, our team of 60,000+ technologists design, build and deploy everything from enterprise technology initiatives to big data and mobile solutions, as well as innovations in electronic payments, cybersecurity, machine learning, and cloud development. Our $15B+ annual investment in technology enables us to hire people to create innovative solutions that will not only transform the financial services industry, but also change the world.

At JPMorganChase. we value the unique skills of every employee, and we’re building a technology organization that thrives on diversity. We encourage professional growth and career development, and offer competitive benefits and compensation. If you’re looking to build your career as part of a global technology team tackling big challenges that impact the lives of people and companies all around the world, we want to meet you.

title: Workplace Equity Consultant
description:
Overview

Our mission at Legacy Health is to make life better for others. That mission drives everything we do. As one of the largest employers and health care providers in the Portland metro area, people trust Legacy with their lives and livelihoods. Upholding our mission of making life better for others means that we must move beyond traditional Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI) work toward being an anti-racist organization. At Legacy, we believe racism is a public health issue and we acknowledge that systemic racism exists throughout society, our industry, and even within our own organization. Our journey will require an openness and commitment to deep reflection, learning and action in support of our transformation into a health care provider and employer who honors the trust put in us by demonstrating diversity, equity, inclusion, and transparency in tangible and meaningful ways. We seek an individual who can bring their passion, knowledge and lived experience to our organization, to be a trusted expert and partner supporting, educating, and leading the Legacy community in the areas of employment equity, civil rights, and restorative justice.

If you want to use your talents to make a difference in the lives of our patients and the community we serve, we invite you to consider this opportunity. We strive to be a diverse, culturally responsive, anti-racist organization, and encourage individuals with diverse backgrounds and those with experience with restorative justice facilitation to apply.

Responsibilities

The Workplace Equity Consultant is a key role in our diversity, health equity, and inclusion (DEI) strategy and vision to be essential to the health of the region. This role helps to develop, revise and enforce policies addressing harassment, discrimination, and anti-racism, and collaborate with teams across regulatory, risk management, employee relations, and compliance while also championing principles of restorative justice and “just culture,” encouraging personal accountability and growth from mistakes to build a workplace free of discrimination, harassment and bias whether explicit or implicit.

Primary responsibilities involve managing the confidential intake process for complaints regarding discrimination, harassment, and retaliation; gathering relevant information, evaluating jurisdiction, and conducting impartial investigations. These investigations include interviewing involved parties and witnesses, reviewing documentation, analyzing evidence, and preparing comprehensive findings reports. The role requires maintaining investigative records with accuracy and confidentiality, as well as monitoring case timelines to ensure prompt resolution and effective communication. This role serves as a subject matter expert to leadership, supervisors, investigators, and staff by providing balanced, timely, meaningful, and actionable information, even in challenging circumstances. This position also necessitates travel to various Legacy sites and community partner locations to support DEI-related initiatives.

Qualifications

Education/Certification:

  • Bachelor’s degree required. Juris Doctor degree preferred.

Experience:

  • Minimum 3 years of experience relating to resolution of civil rights complaints (Title VI, VII, ADA, etc.), and minimum 3 years developing and delivering harassment and discrimination prevention and response trainings in-person and virtually.
  • Must have demonstrated experience interacting with constituents that are diverse in characteristics such as age, race, ethnicity, religion, gender identity and expression, ability, and socioeconomic backgrounds, in a culturally- competent manner.
  • Experience in a hospital, medical center, or other health care entity, or in conducting investigations in the clinical (health care) setting is strongly preferred.

Skills:

  • Proven ability to understand and analyze complaints of harassment and discrimination (including cases qualifying as disparate impact), partner with compliance, legal, safety, and employee relations officers, maintaining objectivity and fairness and treating confidential matters responsibly.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of best practices and methodologies for conducting fair investigations, including interviewing, gathering and analyzing evidence, and writing investigation reports. Ability to effectively work with hostile and emotional individuals in a firm but compassionate manner and to diffuse and manage situations involving intense conflict.
  • Has comprehensive knowledge of federal, state, and local laws, regulations, and guidelines related to civil rights enforcement, especially in recruitment, hiring, promotion, discipline and retention of employees. Can lead or assist in system or department audits and assessments.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of the complexities of harassment and discrimination in healthcare environments, and able to advise clinical and non-clinical leaders on how to protect the civil rights of clinicians and other hospital staff while meeting legal obligations to patients.
  • Skilled in active listening, mediation, and facilitation. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Project/process management skills and strong problem-solving skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to collaborate effectively with diverse groups. Has high degree of competency in culturally and population-specific best practices, especially when working with people who have engaged in interpersonal harm.
  • Effective written and oral communication skills. Ability to present information in a clear and concise manner both in writing and verbally.
  • Utilizes web-based data management system and applicable technologies to conduct and document work.
  • Analyze data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for proactive intervention.

Licensure

  • Certification in mediation and Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) strongly preferred.

Pay Range

USD $49.89 - USD $74.34 /Hr.

Our Commitment to Health and Equal Opportunity

Our Legacy is good for health for Our People, Our Patients, Our Communities, Our World. Above all, we will do the right thing.

If you are passionate about our mission and believe you can contribute to our team, we encourage you to apply—even if you don't meet every qualification listed. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can grow and succeed.

Legacy Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits unlawful discrimination and harassment of any type and affords equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion or creed, citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Retention Specialist
description:
At ELVTR, we're transforming online education by connecting ambitious professionals with industry leaders from companies like Nike, Netflix, Google, Amazon, and more.

Since launching in 2020, we've grown into a global learning community with over 300 expert instructors, delivering more than 200 live online courses across 12 industries. To date, we've helped 22,000+ graduates worldwide gain the skills, confidence, and connections needed to advance their careers.

Now we're looking for a Retention Specialist to help our learners find the right solution when they consider leaving, while protecting revenue and keeping customer satisfaction high. If you're a natural communicator, enjoy turning difficult conversations into positive outcomes, and like hitting clear targets, we'd love to meet you.

This is a full-time, remote role with a working schedule of 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST.

Why This Role Is Different

At ELVTR, customer relationships don't end after enrollment—they're just beginning. As a Retention Specialist, you'll handle refund requests and overdue payments day to day, offering the right alternatives, resolving billing questions, and keeping learners on track to finish what they started. Reporting to our Retention Lead and working alongside Sales, Customer Success, and Billing, you'll have a direct, measurable impact on revenue and on how our learners feel about ELVTR.

You'll Love This Role If You:

  • Enjoy turning challenging customer conversations into positive outcomes
  • Thrive in a fast-paced, KPI-driven environment with clear daily targets
  • Are a persuasive communicator who can find win-win solutions
  • Stay calm, empathetic, and professional under pressure
  • Are highly organized and keep accurate records of every interaction
  • Like learning from feedback and sharpening your skills over time
  • Enjoy working as part of a team and helping colleagues succeed
  • Believe outstanding customer experiences drive long-term business success

What You'll Do

  • Handle incoming refund and cancellation requests by phone, email, and chat, aiming to retain revenue while delivering a positive customer experience
  • Understand each learner's reasons for leaving and offer suitable alternatives, including account credits, payment plans, partial refunds, course transfers, and deferrals
  • Follow up on overdue installment payments, reminding customers, resolving billing questions, and agreeing on realistic repayment arrangements
  • Work with the Billing team to resolve failed payments and help prevent chargebacks
  • Log every interaction, outcome, and agreement accurately in the CRM
  • Follow retention scripts, workflows, and policies, and suggest improvements based on what you hear from customers
  • Flag recurring refund reasons and customer pain points to your Lead so they can be shared with Sales, Product, and Operations
  • Escalate complex or sensitive cases to the Retention Lead with clear context and a recommended solution
  • Meet individual targets for retention rate, retained revenue, and installment recovery
  • Coordinate with Sales, Customer Success, and Finance to make sure each customer's issue is fully resolved

Requirements

  • 1-2+ years of experience in Customer Retention, Sales Retention, Customer Success, Collections, or a related customer-facing role
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken
  • Experience supporting customers in the US market
  • Strong negotiation and objection-handling skills, with a track record of saving customers or recovering payments
  • Comfort handling refund requests, billing questions, and payment follow-ups
  • Ability to navigate difficult conversations with empathy while protecting company interests
  • A results-oriented mindset and comfort working toward daily and monthly targets
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, especially in CRM record-keeping
  • Openness to coaching and feedback, with a drive to keep improving

Nice to Have

  • Experience in the online education or EdTech industry
  • Experience in high-ticket B2C sales or retention environments
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar systems
  • Experience working with subscription or installment payment models
  • Basic knowledge of billing operations, chargebacks, and payment recovery
  • Familiarity with AI-powered customer support or sales tools, including conversation intelligence platforms
  • Interest in growing into a senior or lead retention role

Benefits

  • Competitive Compensation: Competitive salary, performance-based bonuses, and a clear path to senior and lead roles as ELVTR continues to grow globally
  • Learn and Grow: Free access to ELVTR courses, ongoing training and coaching, and career growth within one of the world's fastest-growing online education companies
  • Remote-First Culture: Work from wherever you're most productive, in a flexible and supportive environment with a collaborative international team
  • Health & Wellbeing: Gym membership reimbursement, mental health support, and a generous paid vacation allowance

Why Join ELVTR?

  • Make an Impact: Every learner you help stay on track gets closer to building new skills, advancing their career, and unlocking opportunities they never thought possible
  • Grow Your Career: We're committed to developing our people. As ELVTR continues to expand globally, you'll have opportunities to grow professionally, take on new challenges, and shape the future of online education
  • Join a Winning Team: Work alongside passionate educators, creators, marketers, and innovators who are committed to delivering world-class learning experiences and making education more accessible around the world

Ready to Help Shape the Future of Online Learning?

If you're looking for more than just another customer service role—if you want to build meaningful customer relationships, solve real challenges, and see the measurable impact of your work every day—we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and become part of ELVTR's next chapter of growth.

ELVTR is proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace for all.

title: Counterparty Credit Risk Lead - Vice President
description:
Bring your expertise to JPMorganChase. As part of Risk Management and Compliance, you are at the center of keeping JPMorganChase strong and resilient. You help the firm grow its business in a responsible way by anticipating new and emerging risks and using your expert judgement to solve real-world challenges that impact our company, customers and communities. Our culture in Risk Management and Compliance is all about thinking outside the box, challenging the status quo and striving to be best-in-class.

As an Vice President in the Counterparty Credit Risk team, you will play a key role in managing and mitigating counterparty credit risk across a diverse portfolio. You identify, analyze, and escalate exposures, validate risk reporting, and act as a subject matter expert on margin methodologies and processes. You partner with Credit Officers, Sales and Trading, Market Risk, and senior management to ensure robust risk governance and timely escalation. You help us strengthen risk controls, challenge assumptions, and drive improvements in exposure metrics and reporting.

Job responsibilities:

  • Act as Counterparty Credit Risk coverage supporting Prime Brokerage
  • Identify, analyze, monitor, and escalate counterparty exposures, including concentrations and stress vulnerabilities
  • Validate daily risk and exposure reporting, escalating concerns to Credit Officers, senior management, and the front office
  • Serve as subject matter expert on Prime Brokerage margin methodologies, processes, and supporting systems
  • Review client margin requests, assess adequacy versus stress exposures, and provide recommendations for approval
  • Maintain strong knowledge of Prime Brokerage clients and business activity, formulating risk appetite views and challenging risk requests
  • Monitor margin adequacy and risk across top Prime Brokerage counterparties and portfolios
  • Apply Counterparty Stress Analysis framework to analyze and monitor exposures
  • Partner with business and risk stakeholders on exposure topics, methodology releases, model limitations, and policy enhancements
  • Contribute to firmwide initiatives related to counterparty credit exposure metrics, reporting, and technical enhancements

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

  • 5 plus years of experience in risk management and/or counterparty credit risk, including exposure monitoring, margining, stress analysis, and risk governance
  • Strong understanding of financial markets and ability to assess the impact of market moves on counterparty exposures
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with ability to synthesize complex data into clear risk conclusions and recommendations
  • Proven ownership mindset with ability to operate independently in a dynamic environment
  • Strong judgment and ability to challenge assumptions and escalate issues with clarity and professionalism
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to senior stakeholders
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with ability to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines
  • Proficiency in using large language model (LLM) and AI toolsets
  • Experience in risk management and/or counterparty credit risk, including exposure monitoring, margining, stress analysis, and risk governance (Prime Brokerage Risk Management)

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

  • Experience in risk management and/or counterparty credit risk, including exposure monitoring, margining, stress analysis, and risk governance (Prime Brokerage Risk Management preferred)

title: Instructor - Health Care Administration

title: Benefits Specialist
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are seeking a Benefits Specialist to join our US Benefits team who will administer and manage all aspects of our employee benefits programs. This critical role will support employees as we rapidly grow and scale as a company. The ideal candidate will be a self-starter, capable of quickly integrating into our team, managing multiple priorities, and having a knack for details

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for employee benefit-related inquiries, escalating issues to the appropriate team members and/or third-party vendors as needed. Provide accurate, empathetic, and timely resolution to benefit-related questions and issues.
  • Become the benefits guru, fielding inquiries in Slack, Jira, and email while coordinating with third-party vendors to keep our team covered.
  • Assist with Open Enrollment.
  • Create, update, and maintain benefits-related content, including Confluence, benefits guides, and new hire orientation.
  • Spearhead benefits onboarding at HQ, turning new hires into Anduril enthusiasts from day one
  • Support the planning and participation of onsite benefits-related events, such as wellness fairs, benefit presentations, and Q&A sessions. Help prepare and distribute clear and concise benefit communications.
  • Collaborate closely with various People teams to ensure smooth execution of operational processes, emphasizing employee experience and maintaining data accuracy.
  • Support off-boarding/leavers as needed (COBRA benefits and unemployment EDD claims).
  • Utilize and maintain the HRIS for benefits administration tasks, including data entry, eligibility tracking, and generating reports.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience: 6+ years of progressive experience in benefits administration, preferably in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong proficiency with HRIS systems for benefits administration.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot complex benefit issues.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex benefit information clearly and concisely to diverse employee populations.
  • Strong customer service orientation with a high degree of empathy, discretion, and confidentiality.
  • Exceptional organizational skills, meticulous attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines effectively
  • Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience in defense, manufacturing, technology, or other related field.
  • Experience with Rippling, Workday, or similar HRIS system.
US Salary Range
$108,000—$143,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit .

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

title: Project Architect
description:

title: Industrial Designer
description:
About The Studio:

The Studio, a Sigma Alimentos and IDEO collaboration, we focus on human-centered design and food innovation, while we’re based in Monterrey, we work with Sigma’s offices in Europe, Latin America and the United States. As a unique initiative, The Studio combines the expertise of IDEO and Sigma to co-create consumer-centric products, services, brands and experiences.


About the job:

We are looking for a hands-on Industrial Designer who can turn emerging opportunities into products, services, experiences, and prototypes people can see, touch, use, and respond to. You will work across the full innovation journey, from open-ended exploration to the disciplined work of refining strong concepts for commercialization.


Main activities

  • Translate consumer insights into compelling product, packaging, service, and experience concepts.
  • Communicate ideas through sketches, storyboards, models, renderings, journey maps, scenarios, and physical or experience prototypes.
  • Build and test prototypes at different levels of fidelity to support consumer learning, experimentation, and decisions.
  • Design beyond the object by considering the full consumer journey, interactions, touchpoints, environments, and systems around it.
  • Work directly with consumers and use observations and feedback to evolve the design.
  • Collaborate with research, graphic design, business design, culinary, R&D, engineering, marketing, operations, and commercial teams.
  • Navigate manufacturing, cost, technical, operational, and business constraints while protecting the core consumer benefit and design intent.


Qualifications / Experience

  • A strong portfolio demonstrating industrial or product design, visualization, prototyping, making, and creative problem-solving.
  • Strong sketching and communication skills, with the ability to express ideas in multiple formats and at different levels of fidelity.
  • Experience designing physical products as well as services, experiences, or broader product ecosystems.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward learning through making, testing, and iteration.
  • Experience partnering with technical teams to move concepts toward commercialization and production.
  • Confidence designing with food as a material and exploring food form, format, flavor, preparation, packaging, and eating experience alongside culinary and R&D partners.
  • Experience in food, consumer products, packaging, appliances, retail, hospitality, services, or other consumer-facing environments is highly valued.
  • Comfort working primarily in English, traveling approximately one week per month, and using AI-enabled tools with sound design judgment.
  • Portafolio is a must

title: U.S. Private Bank - Private Banker - Executive Director
description:
We are actively looking for exceptionally talented individuals who are collaborative, confident and motivated to provide a first-class experience to clients within J.P. Morgan’s U.S. Private Bank. If you have an entrepreneurial mindset and are looking to constantly challenge yourself, J.P. Morgan is the place for you. You will be working alongside a team of talented colleagues from other markets, businesses and functions to provide you with the opportunity to take your career to the next level.

  • Connect your clients across all lines of business of J.P. Morgan Chase & Co.

  • Experience with and in-depth knowledge of the equity and fixed income markets and alternative investments, including Hedge Funds, Private Equity and Real Estate

title: Odoo Functional Analyst
description:
About Building Blocks

Building Blocks manufactures architectural facade systems in Glass Fiber Reinforced Concrete (GFRC) and Ultra-High Performance Concrete (UHPC) for commercial, institutional, and high-end residential projects across the U.S.


Building Blocks Facades is a building-facades manufacturer in the Build phase of a single-entity Odoo 19 Enterprise implementation, replacing Precoro, QuickBooks, and Expensify. We're looking for an Odoo Functional Consultant to own day-to-day configuration, user support, and continuous improvement across the live and in-progress modules, working alongside our Odoo Technical Architect, our in-house developer team, and our implementation partner.


This position is based in Merritt Island, Florida and is not a remote role. The selected candidate will be expected to work on-site during regular business hours.


Key Responsibilities

This role covers functional configuration and support across our full Odoo module footprint:


Finance (Accounting, Invoicing, Taxes)

  • Maintain chart of accounts, tax configuration, and GL account mapping for a project-based manufacturing business
  • Support analytic accounting: project/job-level analytic plans and cost-category distribution models
  • Own the Odoo Expenses rollout - employee reimbursables and company-card expense flows
  • Assist with month-end close support and inventory-to-GL reconciliation

Procurement (Purchase, vendor management)

  • Configure and support purchase requests, RFQs, three-way match, and vendor management workflows
  • Maintain procurement approval workflows and purchase agreement configuration
  • Support vendor master data governance and purchasing policy enforcement

Inventory

  • Configure warehouses, locations, and routes for a per-project warehouse model plus a central spares warehouse
  • Support lot/serial tracking and traceability from raw material through finished goods
  • Maintain landed cost configuration and stock valuation accuracy

Quality

  • Build and maintain Quality Control Points (QCPs), quality checks, and alerts for receiving inspection and key manufacturing gates
  • Support non-conformance tracking and corrective-action workflows

Project

  • Configure project templates, stages, and the project-as-job-costing model (analytic account per project)
  • Support project profitability reporting (committed vs. actual cost by job and cost category)
  • Support the timesheet/analytic labor bridge

Manufacturing (MRP)

  • Configure and maintain Bills of Materials, routings, and work centers for an engineer-to-order facades environment
  • Support manufacturing order (MO) analytic distribution so material and work-center cost post correctly to the job
  • Support the EBOM-to-MBOM structured import process and part-numbering governance
  • Support Shop Floor app adoption for production and receiving/QC transactions

Cross-cutting responsibilities

  • Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for functional support tickets and training across all departments using Odoo

title: Head of Digital Platform & Data
description:
PHENOGY AG is a leading innovator of battery energy storage technologies and solutions for the green electrification of the planet. Our team members work on future-proof and sustainable battery systems that are powerful, safe, and robust – with circularity as a central principle. Our technology partner network spans leading battery research institutes. PHENOGY is an environmentally and socially conscious enterprise. We are committed to fostering prosperity for the people and our planet, ensuring sustainable growth – starting in the area of our greatest expertise and impact: energy storage solutions.

We energize the future.

PHENOGY is seeking curious, entrepreneurial-minded energy pioneers to help shape our vision, systems, and growth; playing a key-role as we launch into our ambitious future. If you’re inspired by our mission, values, and drive to change how we energize the future — we’d love your application.

About the Role At PHENOGY, we energize the future—sustainably. In this role you will define and execute our digital engineering strategy, owning the architecture, security, quality, and lifecycle of our cloud, edge, and data products.

Operating at the intersection of clean energy and industrial IoT, you will lead the digital ecosystem for our Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) from the gateway upward—connecting Edge/Gateway → Cloud Infrastructure → APIs → Monitoring/NOC → Customer Applications & Data Platforms. Working in close alignment with our Embedded Systems lead, Product, Cybersecurity, Operations, and Quality teams, you will turn complex energy and regulatory requirements into scalable, high-availability software and data platforms.

What You Will Own & Lead

  • Platform & Data Strategy: Define our technology roadmap, sourcing model (in-house vs. external), and application/data architecture. Establish clear boundaries, data models, APIs, and technical standards from the gateway layer through edge computing, cloud services, data pipelines, and customer/Battery Passport platforms.
  • Engineering, DevOps & Quality: Lead internal engineers and external partners. Govern the full software lifecycle—from requirements and Git workflows to automated CI/CD pipelines, environment segregation, release/rollback procedures, and end-of-life decommissioning. Champion automated testing (unit, integration, performance, regression) and proactively manage technical debt.
  • Product Cybersecurity & Compliance: Embed Security-by-Design via a Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC). Oversee secure coding, secrets/certificate management, SBOMs, open-source licensing, vulnerability remediation (SAST/DAST/SCA), and penetration testing across our edge and cloud stack in alignment with ISO/IEC 27001, IEC 62443, NIST SSDF, OWASP, NIS2, and the EU Cyber Resilience Act.
  • Connected Fleet & Data Ecosystem: Drive high-throughput telemetry ingestion, operational data processing, analytics, remote diagnostics, gateway/edge over-the-air (OTA) updates, and secure remote access across our connected storage fleet.
  • Cross-Functional & Embedded Interface Alignment: Partner closely with the Embedded Systems lead (who owns BMS, controllers, and string-level firmware) to define clean gateway protocols and data contracts—ensuring seamless integration without overlapping responsibilities.
  • Team & Supplier Leadership: Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing platform and data engineering organization. Manage external development partners from technical due diligence and contracting through delivery, ensuring clean IP ownership, documentation, and zero single-vendor lock-in.
  • Executive Governance & IT Alignment: Hold decision-making authority over digital platform architecture, tech stacks, repositories, CI/CD, and technical debt. Partner closely with the Head of IT to maintain a clear boundary between product software and enterprise IT while jointly governing shared domains (IAM, cloud infrastructure, networking, incident response, and disaster recovery).

What You Bring

Required Qualifications

  • Education: Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, IT, or a related technical field.
  • Leadership & Strategy: Proven track record leading software/data teams, complex engineering programs, and external development vendors, translating business goals into clear roadmaps and architectural decisions.
  • Modern Cloud, API & Data Tech: Deep expertise in cloud-native software architecture, data pipelines/telemetry processing, integration patterns, REST/streaming APIs, DevOps, CI/CD automation, and full-lifecycle release management.
  • Security Mindset: Strong command of secure software engineering practices, vulnerability management, and risk-based decision-making.
  • Communication: Ability to bridge deep technical execution with executive stakeholder alignment—balancing speed, cost, quality, and operational risk.

Strongly Preferred

  • Domain experience in Energy Tech, BESS, Industrial IoT, Edge computing, or connected fleet platforms.
  • Hands-on familiarity with Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps, C#/.NET, Python, modern data stacks, and REST APIs.
  • Working knowledge of IEC 62443 and cybersecurity standards for connected industrial products.
  • Experience managing high-availability operational systems and formal product lifecycle management (PLM).

How Success Is Measured You will have clear ownership backed by transparent engineering metrics, including:

  • Delivery & Reliability: Roadmap predictability, release frequency, deployment success/rollback rates, platform availability, and incident trends.
  • Code, Data & Security Health: Automated test coverage, data pipeline reliability/latency, CI/CD maturity, defect rates/MTTR, critical vulnerability remediation speed, and technical debt reduction.
  • Governance & Efficiency: Architecture documentation completeness, supplier delivery quality, and R&D resource efficiency.
  • Workload: Full-time | Level: Senior Management / Head
  • Reporting to: Executive Management (CTO / COO)

We offer you:

  • Join a high-caliber environment that enables you to develop your full potential, shape your job, and take ownership.
  • Participate in the development of PHENOGY and inspire the world to transition to sustainable energy.
  • Become part of our eco-passionate expert team - a first-class team all around.
  • Benefit from flexible work hours as well as remote and on-site working in a modern sustainable office
  • Enjoy various events, an amazing coffee machine, and the occasional coffee from our CEO (acting Barista)

At PHENOGY, we highly value diversity, equality, and inclusion. It makes our company stronger. Our philosophy: one mindset, many minds.

For recruitment and staffing agencies: PHENOGY works exclusively with selected recruitment partners under formal agreements. We do not accept unsolicited candidate submissions from agencies and assume no liability for claims made by unauthorized recruiters regarding our recruitment processes.

title: Investment Associate
description:
Investment Associate | Dallas, TX


Dallas, TX | $3bn+ AUM | January–July 2027 Start


Dartmouth Partners is working with a Dallas-based private investment firm with over $3bn in AUM that is looking to add an Associate to its investment team.


The firm invests across a range of industries, including manufacturing, healthcare, consumer, food, and building materials. Unlike a traditional private equity fund, the firm invests its own capital, allowing it to take a longer-term approach to investments without the constraints of external fundraising or fixed holding periods.


This is a lean investment team, with Associates working directly alongside Partners and taking on significant responsibility across the investment process, from evaluating new opportunities and executing transactions through to portfolio company involvement.


The Role

  • Evaluate new platform and add-on investment opportunities.
  • Build financial models, including LBO, valuation, and returns analyses.
  • Conduct due diligence and prepare investment materials.
  • Support transaction execution and work closely with external advisors and management teams.

The firm offers direct exposure to senior investment professionals, the opportunity to take ownership of transactions early in your career, and experience across both new investments and existing portfolio companies.

With a longstanding investment track record, low turnover, and a flexible approach to holding investments, the role offers the opportunity to build a long-term career within a well-established platform.

title: Senior Applied AI Engineer
description:
Hyliion is committed to creating innovative solutions that enable clean, flexible and affordable electricity production. The Company’s primary focus is to develop distributed power generators that can operate on various fuel sources to future-proof against an ever-changing energy economy.

Job Purpose

The Senior Applied AI Engineer position drives Hyliion's enterprise AI adoption by designing, building, and supporting AI solutions, partnering with every department to turn AI tools into measurable gains in speed, quality, and capacity. Hyliion designs and builds the KARNO™ Power Module, a fuel-agnostic linear generator for data center, commercial and industrial, and defense applications, and is working toward commercialization with a lean team. This position helps identify the highest-value AI opportunities across Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, Commercial, Finance, Legal, and HR, then designs, deploys, and scales the workflows, assistants, agents, and automations that capture that value. This is a hands-on individual contributor role: the Senior Applied AI Engineer builds solutions directly, integrates them with Hyliion's Microsoft 365 and enterprise systems, supports training, and works with Hyliion's AI Ambassadors so adoption sticks after go-live. Working closely with IT leadership, Legal & Compliance, and functional leaders, the position also applies the governance, security, and data practices that let Hyliion move fast with AI while protecting intellectual property and meeting government contract requirements.

AI at Hyliion

At Hyliion, AI is core to how we work. We equip every team member with leading AI tools and count on you to use them — to move faster, solve harder problems, and help us realize the full potential of KARNO technology for the world.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • AI strategy and roadmap: Develop and maintain Hyliion's enterprise AI roadmap in partnership with executive leadership; prioritize use cases by business value, effort, and risk, and tie each initiative to KARNO commercialization goals and departmental objectives.
  • Departmental partnership: Serve as the embedded AI partner to each department; map current workflows with functional leaders, identify where AI can remove manual effort or improve decisions, and agree on success metrics before work begins.
  • Solution design and delivery: Design, build, and deploy AI solutions end to end, including prompt libraries, custom assistants, agents, retrieval-based knowledge tools, and workflow automations, integrated with Microsoft 365 and enterprise systems using APIs; take solutions from prototype to daily production use and own their performance after launch.
  • Testing and quality: Test solutions for accuracy, reliability, and cost before and after launch; monitor performance in production and refine prompts, configuration, and design.
  • Engineering and operations enablement: Partner with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and Supply Chain on use cases such as test data analysis, technical documentation, design review support, supplier and procurement analysis, nonconformance and root cause analysis, and production planning.
  • Business function enablement: Partner with Commercial, Finance, Legal & Compliance, and HR on use cases such as proposal and RFP drafting, market research, financial analysis and reporting, contract review, policy research, recruiting, and employee self-service.
  • Adoption and change management: Support measurable adoption of company AI tools; help deliver role-based training, office hours, and playbooks, and provide technical coaching to Hyliion's AI Ambassadors who sustain usage and surface new opportunities.
  • Tool evaluation and platform management: Evaluate, select, and manage AI platforms and vendors with IT.
  • Governance, security, and compliance: Apply and help maintain Hyliion's AI Responsible Use Policy, data classification guidance, and review process with IT team and Legal & Compliance; protect intellectual property and ensure AI use meets export control and government contract requirements, including those tied to U.S. Navy work.
  • Measurement and reporting: Define and track AI KPIs, including adoption, active usage, hours saved, cycle-time reduction, and quality improvements; report results and ROI to executive leadership on a regular cadence.
  • Emerging technology: Monitor developments in AI models, agents, and tooling; run controlled pilots and recommend where Hyliion should adopt, wait, or pass.
  • Cross-functional influence: Lead company-wide AI initiatives without direct authority, influence senior leaders, and model AI-first ways of working across the organization.
  • Additional duties and responsibilities as assigned, needed, or required for the business.

Qualifications

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Qualifications include:

  • Education, Experience and Certifications
    • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience, required; advanced technical or business degree beneficial.
    • 5+ years of experience in software engineering, technology, data, or automation roles, including 2+ years building AI, machine learning, or automation solutions.
    • Demonstrated track record of deploying generative AI solutions (LLM-based assistants, agents, or automations) into daily business use with measurable results.
    • Experience leading enterprise-wide technology adoption across multiple departments, including training and change management.
    • Experience in manufacturing, energy, aerospace, defense, or another engineering-driven industry preferred.
    • Experience in a pre-commercial, startup, or high-growth environment preferred.
    • Experience with AI governance and data security in regulated environments, including export control (ITAR/EAR) or government contract requirements, preferred.
  • Skills and Abilities
    • Hands-on proficiency with leading generative AI platforms and enterprise AI tools, including prompt design, custom assistants, and agent configuration.
    • Working knowledge of APIs, low-code/no-code automation platforms, and scripting (Python or equivalent).
    • Understanding of retrieval-augmented generation, data pipelines, and integration of AI with enterprise systems such as Microsoft 365, ERP, and PLM.
    • Sound engineering practices, including version control, testing, and documentation.
    • Ability to translate business problems into practical AI solutions and quantify the value before and after implementation.
    • Strong facilitation and teaching skills, with the ability to train audiences ranging from technicians to executives.
    • Clear, direct communicator, credible with engineers, operators, and business leaders alike.
    • Ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive change without direct authority.
    • Sound judgment on risk, privacy, and intellectual property protection when applying AI.
    • Comfort operating with ambiguity and building solutions from the ground up rather than inheriting them.

Role Classification and Working Conditions

This is a salaried, exempt-level position. This position typically works in an office environment; and given the nature of our business is also exposed to operations/warehouses/production environments.

Physical/Other Requirements

  • Ability to sit and work at a computer for extended periods.
  • Ability to walk production and lab areas and wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) when on the floor, following Hyliion safety procedures.
  • Ability to travel, as needed, by plane, automobile, etc., including periodic travel between the Cedar Park, Texas headquarters and the Milford, Ohio development facility (estimated ~25%).

We are not accepting candidates who require sponsorship for this role at this time.

Benefits:

  • Dental Plans, with buy-up option

  • Short Term Disability, paid for by the company

  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)

  • Voluntary Accident Plans

title: Director of Security Engineering
description:
We are hiring a Director of Security Engineering to build and lead the Cyber Security and tech controls Architecture Engineering Services (CAES) team at JPMorgan Chase. This is a people-manager role at Senior Executive Director scope, accountable for a team with the following mandates:

Lead CTC Architecture Engineering Services. Direct the centralized engineering organization that builds and owns every CTC Architecture software product, spanning threat modeling platforms, architecture platforms and automation, and test and quality platforms. Own how its capacity gets allocated. Match pooled capacity to the annual Operating Plan, portfolio priority, business value, and risk reduction in partnership with the CAES Product Director.

description:
Job title: Senior DevOps Engineer / Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
