The detailer will use their manual dexterity and bodily coordination to perform an array of tasks, including washing the exterior of vehicles using various cleaning solutions, may also wax and buff vehicles using cloths and buffing machines, vacuum interior of automobiles to remove dirt and debris, clean upholstery and surfaces, use air compressors and cloths to dry surfaces and apply preservation chemicals to surfaces for protection against spots and stains. May be required to use different types of dyes, paints and waxes to protect the leather or fabric of vehicles. May also be required to clean and remove grease on engines or engine compartments. Must be flexible and willing able to carry out additional duties as assigned by management due to operational needs.

Working Conditions:

  • This physically demanding position requires frequent movement; i.e. bending, lifting, reaching, squatting, and getting into and out of various vehicles repeatedly during the work shift.
  • May require completion of work outdoors and under varying climate conditions.
  • Will work with and move numerous vehicles during the course of the working day.
  • Use of safe and OSHA approved waxes and cleaners such as, window cleaner, tar remover, tire shine, etc.
  • Frequent and continual flexing of spine, hands, wrists and fingers.
  • Occasional pushing, pulling, lifting, or carrying of up to 50 lbs.
  • Constantly receiving detailed information through oral communication.
  • Clarity of vision and hearing.
  • Ability to distinguish small imperfections in your work, such as, streaks left on windows, smudges on windows or painted surfaces, areas of missed vacuuming, etc.
  • Ability to quality inspect your work as well as that of other team members.
  • Work with a sense of urgency that demonstrates the value we place on our customers' time.

  • Strict adherence to our uniform and grooming standards.

Compensation: FLAT RATE

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have

  • A valid driver's license and a good driving record.
  • Ability to learn quickly.
  • Ability to work as part of a team.
  • Ability to read and comprehend instructions

  • Desire to treat each customer’s personal vehicle with great care and respect

  • The willingness to come to work on time and stay on task when on the clock

  • The ability to drive both automatic and manual shift vehicles

  • The availability to work Saturday or Sunday and holidays as deemed necessary to meet production needs
  • Commitment to report to work on time and stay on task during shift

Teph Seal is a Drug-Free Workplace. All employment is contingent on successful completion of drug and background screening.

We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package and all the tools necessary to be successful. Our offerings include: Medical, Dental, Vision Plans, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off and 401(k) Retirement Plan with company match.

We provide a collaborative work place with growth opportunities for career minded individuals.

title: Northeast Florida Transportation Market Sector Leader
description:
Job Description

Dewberry is seeking a Regional Market Sector Leader in our Jacksonville, FL office. This is an excellent career opportunity to lead the local growth of an established firm with a strong Transportation design reputation in Florida and nationwide. Dewberry has provided planning and design services to FDOT, municipal agencies, and toll authorities throughout Florida for decades and has a strong backlog of work. The successful candidate will leverage Dewberry’s current capabilities to grow our Jacksonville team and northeast Florida transportation practice, with opportunities to advance into increasingly senior leadership roles.

At Dewberry, we seek out exceptional talent and strive to deliver the highest quality of services to our clients. Whether you’re an experienced professional or a new graduate, you’ll have the chance to collaborate with the best and brightest and work on innovative and complex projects at the forefront of the industry. Our commitment to excellence stems from our personal integrity and from other defining attributes, which we call “Dewberry at Work,” that have inspired our employees to be successful for more than a half-century.

What We Offer

  • A culture that prioritizes our most important asset – our people – and a multi-disciplinary Florida Transportation team of high-performing engineers and professionals who genuinely enjoy working together
  • A long-established Florida transportation practice with successful project histories at agencies across the state, a steady backlog of ongoing projects, and a strong pipeline in place to win future projects
  • The resources of a large firm, such as access to national subject matter experts, the ability to effectively workshare across offices/geographies, and systems/people in place that support our marketing, accounting, and recruiting functions
  • A variety of opportunities – our projects range from major highway widenings & new construction to innovative intersections & interchanges to trails & safety improvements. Our client base is diversified between FDOT, CFX, Counties across the state, and Contractor teams constructing large design-build projects
  • Competitive compensation and benefits packages, numerous formal training programs, and clear opportunities for growth in technical, project management, and organizational management career paths

Responsibilities

  • Become a Leader within our Florida Transportation team by proactively building connections with current Staff in our Jacksonville, Orlando, and Pensacola offices in order to build up our northeast Florida practice
  • Lead project pursuit efforts to win new projects, with support from Marketing Staff, Discipline Leads, and other Project and Client Managers
  • Lead the delivery of complex transportation design projects, working with current Discipline Leads and project teams to prepare deliverables and managing project quality, scopes, schedules, and budgets
  • Expand Dewberry’s presence and reputation in northeast Florida by regularly meeting with clients, representing Dewberry at industry events, making teaming arrangements with other firms, recruiting quality people, and performing other general market-facing activities

Required Skills & Required Experience

  • A northeast Florida Leader who is eager to build on Dewberry’s existing reputation and staff to grow our local team and project portfolio in northeast Florida
  • 15+ years of progressive experience leading transportation projects for FDOT and other agencies in northeast Florida
  • Existing client relationships and familiarity with the organizational structures, staff, project procurement, and project delivery processes of the local FDOT District offices and counties.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or a related field and a Florida Professional Engineer (PE) license

Make an Impact

If you're a transportation leader looking for the opportunity to shape strategy, grow a thriving practice, and deliver impactful infrastructure projects, we'd love to talk with you.

Don’t meet every single requirement? At Dewberry we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace for our employees. These screenings will be conducted by Dewberry’s background vendor of choice and will be conducted in compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local law.

title: ServiceNow Senior Solution Architect
description:
Make an Impact with Us

As a Solution Architect, you will take a front seat in customer-facing roles, guiding organizations through their ServiceNow journey. You will work closely with business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable, sustainable solutions—leveraging the ServiceNow platform to its fullest potential, while minimizing unnecessary customization.


About us

We are a Norwegian-owned company – and the only pure-play ServiceNow partner in the market. Our unique culture has been the key to our success: we genuinely believe that work should be fun in order for people to perform at their very best.

With strong growth over the past six years, we are now more than 400 ServiceNow consultants across Europe and Brazil.

What You will Do

Lead Solution Design: Translate complex business needs into functional, scalable ServiceNow solutions, leveraging out-of-the-box capabilities wherever possible.

Collaborate with Stakeholders: Conduct workshops and clarification sessions to gather, validate, and refine requirements.

Own the Architecture: Define and enforce architecture standards, best practices, and implementation approaches that align with enterprise goals.

Document Everything: Create and maintain solution documentation—ranging from high-level designs (HLDs) to detailed low-level designs (LLDs) and agile artifacts (Epics/User Stories).

Support Estimations & Scoping: Lead the effort in defining implementation phases, estimating effort, and shaping project scope for both ongoing and future engagements.

Quality & Governance: Oversee solution quality, ensure alignment with business processes, and take corrective actions when needed.

Knowledge Sharing & Training: Empower clients through training and workshops. Participate in internal expert communities to share knowledge and grow your expertise.

Contribute to Presales (Occasionally): Provide support with demos, estimates, and solution design during presales activities as needed.


What we are looking for

Proven experience as a Solution Architect or similar role within ServiceNow projects.

Expertise in at least one major ServiceNow solution area (e.g., ITSM, ITOM, HR, CSM, IRM).

Relevant ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certification(s).

Strong understanding of both the business and technical sides of ServiceNow solutions.

Experience with agile delivery methods, story writing, and iterative design.

Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.

Ability to create detailed documentation and ensure system maintainability.

A strong focus on best practices, out-of-the-box configurations, and scalable architecture.

Fluent in Norwegian and English


What we offer

Competitive salary

Brand new, modern offices in Skøyen, Oslo – including a rooftop terrace, gym, and bike parking with locker rooms

Parking space available if needed

Subsidized canteen

Weekly personal training sessions during working hours

Excellent pension and private health insurance plans that ensure quick access to private healthcare

A young and inclusive work environment with a dedicated social committee

Great opportunities for professional development and career growth

The TCP Culture

Becoming a part of The Cloud People means joining a team where the culture is built on the four F’s:

Fun: We enjoy ourselves at work – every day – and foster a social and inclusive work environment

Fair: We have a fair and transparent development system that rewards skills and knowledge, giving everyone equal opportunities to grow through courses and certifications

Focus: We focus exclusively on one leading platform – ServiceNow – to ensure we offer our clients the best expertise on the market

Future: We believe the workplace of the future is modern, flexible, and simple – allowing space for creativity and minimizing time spent on unnecessary reporting

title: Sr. Family Program Director
location: Clark County Family YMCA - Jeffersonville, IN 47130
description:
Position Summary
As the nation’s leading nonprofit committed to strengthening communities through youth development, healthy living, and social responsibility, the Y offers an opportunity to make a lasting difference.


The Senior Family Program Director provides strategic and operational leadership for the Clark County Family YMCA’s youth and teen programs, including Licensed Before and After School Care (SACC), licensed and unlicensed summer day camps, teen programming, youth sports, and Kids’ Club, including birthday parties and special events.


A primary responsibility of this position is to directly supervise, coach, and develop the Assistant Directors while also assuming direct responsibility for assigned programs as needed. The Senior Director establishes a shared vision and consistent expectations for safety, program quality, staff performance, and participant experience while overseeing approximately $700,000 in combined program budgets.

  • Lead and oversee 40+ staff, with Assistant Director support across various program areas.
  • Supervise, coach, and evaluate assigned staff, establishing clear goals and supporting professional development.
  • Maintain direct responsibility for assigned programs and guide daily operations in collaboration with Assistant Directors and other program leaders.
  • Oversee staff recruitment, hiring, and training, building an accountable, collaborative team that delivers safe, welcoming, and engaging programs.
  • Ensure staff complete required screenings, certifications, training, and continuing education.

Key Responsibilities

  • Mission and strategy: Model the YMCA mission, promise, values, and voice. Align programs with branch and Association strategic priorities and community needs.
  • Program development and quality: Guide curriculum, activities, and new program opportunities that promote academic achievement, character development, leadership, and positive youth outcomes. Use participation data, family feedback, and measurable results to improve programs.

  • Operational oversight: Work through Assistant Directors and Camp Directors to oversee scheduling, enrollment, transportation, facilities, communication, recordkeeping, and program readiness.

title: Main Street Manager
description:
POSITION TITLE: Main Street Manager


DEPARTMENT: Administration


RATE CLASS: Non-Exempt


REPORTS TO: EDC Executive Director


SHIFT: Generally, 8AM-5PM, M-F, however, may vary to include weekends or evenings as needed to meet events and venues management responsibilities.



EDUCATION and EXPERIENCE:


High School Diploma or equivalent; Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Business, Hospitality, Communications, Economics, Design/Architecture or a related field required. Requires two years previous experience involving Main Street management duties, or similar experience. A strong background in Microsoft Office is required. Valid Texas drivers' license, or ability to obtain one within 90-days of hire, is required.



JOB SUMMARY:


Represents and promotes Freeport Main Street to the general public through promotional planning and web/digital and print marketing in accordance with the Texas Main Street program guidelines. Including event planning, marketing, business development and retention.



DUTIES & RESPOSIBILITIES:



  • Coordinates and manages Texas Main Street Program activities for the City of Freeport.

  • Manage administrative aspects of the program.

  • Develop appropriate downtown revitalization strategies within the context of historic preservation.

  • Develop and conduct ongoing public awareness and education programs.

  • Collaborate with Freeport EDC regarding business and property improvement projects in the Main Street area.

  • Foster cooperation with area Chambers of Commerce and other entities.

  • Develop and maintain a data system to track the program's progress.

  • Develop in conjunction with the Board, appropriate downtown revitalization strategies:


    • Identification of Unique assets and resources.

    • Identification of concerns and issues.

    • Development of a work plan that focuses on all four program areas, (Promotion, Design, Organization, and Economic Restructuring).




  • Develop and conduct, in conjunction with the Main Street Board ongoing public awareness and education programs:


    • Foster public understanding of the Main Street program.

    • Keep the program in a positive light in the public eye.

    • Develop a cooperative relationship with the media.


  • Assist businesses, property owners and potential developers with business and property improvement projects:


    • Develop and maintain database on existing buildings, owners and uses.

    • Provide ongoing communication, advice and guidance.

    • Coordinate and manage technical services of state/city program.

    • Enlist professional consultation as appropriate.

    • Provide contact information on available resources statewide.


  • Encourage a cooperative climate with other downtown or community organization:


    • Build opportunities for partnership with area Chambers of Commerce and the Texas Downtown Association.

    • Identify and associate with any other key downtown/neighborhood organizations and stakeholders.


  • Develop and maintain a data system to track the progress of the local program:


    • Develop and maintain a data system on reinvestment in the downtown.

    • Develop and maintain a data system on available properties.

    • Develop and maintain a data system on downtown property owners.


  • Work toward developing skills as a Downtown Management Professional:


    • Attend Texas Main Street Program training opportunities.

    • Attend Texas Downtown (formerly Texas Downtown Association) programs.

    • Seek out and attend conferences or workshops on downtown revitalization.

    • Must be willing and capable of completing all required courses and classes for certification requirements.


  • Manage administrative aspects of the program:


    • Ensure maintenance of files, records, policies, procedures, and other reference material important to the efficient operations of Freeport Main Street.

    • Assist the City in the budget planning and preparation for Main Street each year.

    • Plan, prepare, update, and distribute Event Set-Up, Detailed Data, and Work Schedule to City staff as needed.

    • Maintain inventory of office supplies, action plan and event materials for each event hosted by Freeport Main Street.

    • Record keeping and accounting.

    • Guiding/coordinating volunteers.

    • Maintain an internal and public calendar for reservations and events made for Freeport Main Street.

    • Coordinate activity of Main Street program committees including ensuring communication is established, assists with implementation of a working plan and provide ongoing volunteer support and encouragement.

    • Provide excellent customer service and respond courteously and professionally by phone, mail, email, and in person to inquiries and other requests regarding events in a timely manner.




OTHER IMPORTANT DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:



  • Main Street Manager will be required to work outside the traditional work week/schedule.

  • Must be able to maintain confidentiality in all assigned areas.

  • Organization of special projects as directed which may include special event planning, volunteer recognition, annual reports budgets, web site information, and other projects that may occur.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.



SPECIFIC SKILLS INCLUDE:



  • Knowledge of applicable local, state, and Federal statutes, rules, regulations, ordinances, codes, City of Freeport policies and procedures and other potentially governing documents.

  • Knowledge and understanding of the mission and guidelines.

  • Knowledge of the principles of files and records management and of modern office principles and techniques.

  • Knowledge of the basic principles of bookkeeping/accounting.

  • Skill in assessing information, situations and circumstances and prioritizing activities.

  • Skill in establishing and maintaining effective working relations with all City employees, volunteers, vendors, contractors, public, the news media and others having interaction or business with the City of Freeport

  • Skill in compiling, developing, and presenting written reports, correspondence, and other work for internal and public distribution.

  • Skill in communicating professionally and effectively

  • Skill in operating a computer while utilizing a variety of software applications including proficiency with social media and website updating.



WORKING CONDITIONS


Environmental Conditions:


Office and field environment; may work in inclement weather conditions in outdoor venues.


Physical Conditions:


Essential and marginal functions require maintaining physical condition necessary for sitting, standing or walking for prolonged periods of time; and operating motorized vehicles. Must have the ability to lift/move up to 50 pounds.



ACKNOWLEGMENT:


All municipal employees will be expected to show and maintain a high level of initiative, enthusiasm, and motivation towards the improvement of ALL aspects of the Freeport community. Employees will also be expected to be available for work, to report to work in a dependable and timely fashion, and to be physically and mentally fit to do their assigned work.



Must pass a drug analysis test, physical exam, and successfully complete a background check.

title: Experience & Market Research, Senior Associate - Payments
description:
Bring your industry trends and knowledge to our team and shape exceptional user experiences through cutting-edge research, influencing product design and functionality.

As an Experience & Market Research Senior Associate in the Corporate Investment Bank Payments Experience Design team, you will design and execute mixed-methods market and experience research that helps shape products and services for our clients. You will combine qualitative and quantitative approaches—developing questionnaires and discussion guides, conducting interviews, analyzing survey and behavioral data, and translating findings into clear, actionable recommendations. You will determine the methods best suited to key business and design questions and contribute to research programs that inform product strategy, experience design, and customer outcomes.

In this role, you will join our growing global Payments Experience Research team, supporting products used by large, global clients. You will partner closely with Design, Product Management, Engineering, Research Operations, and fellow researchers, and may help run and manage client or participant panels that support ongoing research.

Job responsibilities

  • Design and execute end-to-end mixed-methods market and experience research, using qualitative and quantitative approaches such as surveys, interviews, focus groups, ethnography, concept testing, and secondary research
  • Draft clear, unbiased questionnaires, discussion guides, screeners, and other research instruments aligned to business and research objectives
  • Analyze quantitative and qualitative data, identify meaningful patterns and trends, assess the strength of findings, and translate results into actionable recommendations
  • Produce well-structured, accurate, and compelling reports, presentations, and executive summaries tailored to stakeholders at all levels
  • Manage research projects with strong attention to detail, including study planning, fieldwork, data quality checks, documentation, timelines, and stakeholder communication
  • Support the operation and governance of research panels, including participant recruitment, panel health, communications, data integrity, compliance, and vendor coordination
  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners to integrate customer and market insights into product strategy, prioritization, and experience design
  • Connect research questions and findings to business goals, customer outcomes, and relevant success metrics
  • Champion customer needs, behaviors, and pain points, and stay current on market trends, research methodologies, and analytical practices

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • 3+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in market research, experience research, insights, or a related field
  • Demonstrated ability to independently design and execute both qualitative and quantitative research studies from scoping through reporting
  • Strong questionnaire-development skills, including writing clear and unbiased questions, selecting appropriate response scales, structuring surveys, and applying sound survey-design principles
  • Experience analyzing quantitative data using tools such as Excel, Qualtrics, or statistical software, with the ability to clean data, create cross-tabulations, interpret results, and identify meaningful differences and trends
  • Experience planning and conducting qualitative research, including interviews or focus groups, and synthesizing findings across multiple sources
  • Excellent writing, editing, and storytelling skills, with the ability to communicate complex findings clearly, concisely, and accurately
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to data quality, research rigor, and accurate documentation
  • Strong project-management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple studies, timelines, stakeholders, and deliverables
  • Demonstrated success collaborating with cross-functional teams, including Design, Product Management, Engineering, and Research Operations
  • Proficiency with PowerPoint, Excel, Qualtrics, AI-enabled productivity tools, and related research platforms

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Experience managing customer, participant, or research panels, including recruitment, engagement, governance, privacy, compliance, and data-quality practices
  • Working knowledge of statistical analysis, including significance testing, weighting, segmentation, or multivariate techniques
  • Experience with market sizing, competitive research, brand or relationship tracking, or customer segmentation
  • Experience with data-visualization or statistical-analysis tools
  • Experience in payments, financial services, or research with B2B enterprise audiences
  • A collaborative, curious, and proactive approach to solving research and business problems

title: ServiceNow Senior Platform Developer
description:
Contractor of vaste aanstelling

Location: Netherlands

Voor een toonaangevende organisatie in Nederland zijn wij op zoek naar een ServiceNow Senior Platform Developer met een sterke focus op digitale transformatie en platform optimalisatie.

In deze rol ondersteunt en adviseert de consultant de klant bij de verdere uitrol en strategische doorontwikkeling van het ServiceNow-platform. ServiceNow vormt een essentieel onderdeel van de organisatie en wordt organisatiebreed gebruikt via het IT- en HR-portaal, waardoor efficiëntie, gebruikerservaring en standaardisatie centraal staan.

Onze klant werkt op basis van een heldere visie en roadmap voor het ServiceNow-platform. Binnen het Center of Excellence (CoE) wordt gewerkt aan innovatie, optimalisatie en beheer van het platform. De ServiceNow Senior Platform Developer speelt hierin een sleutelrol en levert een directe bijdrage aan het realiseren van bedrijfsdoelstellingen.

Als senior developer werk je nauw samen samen met stakeholders, functionele teams en andere ServiceNow-specialisten en fungeert als trusted advisor op het gebied van platform architectuur, best practices en continue verbetering. Met behulp van ServiceNow wordt de digitale transformatie van de organisatie versneld en toekomstbestendig ingericht.

De kerntaken van deze rol:

  • De ServiceNow Senior Platform Developer ontwerpt en implementeert workflows, integraties, meldingen en flow automatisering.

  • Werkt samen met stakeholders gedurende implementatie, technische inzichten te bieden en ervoor te zorgen dat de functionaliteiten voldoen aan de business behoeften.

  • Ondersteunt implementatie via Source Control, update sets en CI/CD- pipelines, en zorgt voor soepele overgangen van ontwikkeling naar productie.

  • De senior developer levert een actieve bijdrage aan het formuleren van de visie, met gebruikmaking van ervaring opgedaan bij andere klanten en de mogelijkheden die ServiceNow-technieken bieden.

Benodigde kennis en ervaring:

  • 8+ jaar ervaring met het ServiceNow-platform, met een sterke specialisatie in ITSM en Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM)

  • Aantoonbare ervaring in het implementeren van ServiceNow

  • Ruime ervaring met integraties, waaronder Service Connector/APIM, CMDB, Platform Core en Service Workflows, aangevuld met diepgaande scripting-expertise.

  • Gedegen kennis van Configuration Management, Application Portfolio Management, widgets (basis en geavanceerd), IT Operations Management (basis en geavanceerd), IRM/SecOps, HRSD en TPRM.

  • Beschikt over sterke mentorvaardigheden, thought leadership en uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden

  • ServiceNow-certificeringen (zoals CIS-ITSM en CIS-SPM) vormen een duidelijke meerwaarde

  • Ervaring met Agile werken, een proactieve en resultaatgerichte houding en uitgebreide scriptingkennis.

  • Vloeiend Nederlands (moedertaal)

Over ons:
The Cloud People is een van Europa’s grootste onafhankelijke ServiceNow Elite Partners. Daarnaast zijn wij erkend als een van de weinige ServiceNow ServiceOps- en Customer Experience Specialization Partners in de EMEA-region.

The Cloud People beschikt over een team van meer dan 350 gecertificeerde ServiceNow-consultants, en ondersteunt meer dan 150 klanten in uiteenlopende sectoren. Wij bieden een breed scala aan diensten rondom het ServiceNow-platform, variërend van consultancy en implementatie, tot migratie en managed services.

Onze unieke cultuur gebaseerd op de 4F’s (Fun, Focus, Fair, Future) is de sleutel tot ons succes: wij geloven oprecht dat werk leuk moet zijn, zodat mensen optimaal kunnen presteren.

Wat wij bieden:

  • Een aantrekkelijk salaris, inclusief pensioenregeling en mobiliteitsvergoeding

  • Een hybride werkmodel voor werken op locatie en op afstand, klant wil graag dat voor deze functie de consultant twee dagen / week op een centrale locatie in het land werkt

  • Een energieke werkomgeving met veel sociale activiteiten

  • Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling, waaronder trainingen en certificeringen

  • Een bring your own device-beleid met bijbehorende vergoeding

  • 25 vakantiedagen

  • Voor contractors gelden er andere vergoedingen, welke wij graag willen toelichten


The TCP Cultuur

Deel uitmaken van The Cloud People betekent dat je aansluit bij een enthousiast team waarvan de cultuur is gebouwd op de vier F’s:

Fun: We hebben plezier in ons werk, elke dag, en stimuleren een sociale en inclusieve werkomgeving.

Fair: We hanteren een eerlijk en transparant ontwikkelsysteem dat vaardigheden en kennis beloont en iedereen gelijke kansen biedt om te groeien via opleidingen en certificeringen.

Focus: We richten ons uitsluitend op één toonaangevend platform, ServiceNow, zodat we onze klanten de beste expertise in de markt kunnen bieden en onze consultants diepgaande kennis en expertise kunnen opdoen

Future: Wij geloven dat de werkplek van de toekomst modern, flexibel en eenvoudig is, met ruimte voor creativiteit en minimale tijdsbesteding aan onnodige rapportages.

title: Experimental Test Pilot UAE, Omen
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Team

At Anduril we are developing unmanned aerial systems capable of terminal guidance, long range intelligence collection, precision relative and global navigation, and unsupervised autonomy. The Test and Evaluation team works across the entire spectrum of products ranging from Lattice Ghost UAS, Sentry Tower, cUAS, missile, Fury and many of our other platforms.
Omen is Anduril’s hover-to-cruise autonomous air vehicle (AAV) that packs the endurance, payload, and mission flexibility of much larger airplanes into a novel runway-independent Group 3 platform. Omen can operate from ship decks, beaches, or remote island clearings, providing true runway independence and freedom of maneuver across defense and civilian domains. Omen is the first tail-sitter aircraft with a mass-production contract, with an order of 50 systems representing a decisive investment that anchors production and accelerates the development of future systems.

This role is part of the new Omen flight test team in the UAE. The team runs Omen ground and flight testing in the UAE alongside our U.S. flight test team, using the same aircraft configuration, procedures and test plans, and works closely with our UAE partners.

About the Job


As an Experimental Test Pilot, you will support the development and field testing of Omen, Anduril’s hover-to-cruise autonomous aircraft, in the UAE. In this position you will prepare aircraft for flight, conduct flight tests of the aircraft as the test pilot, and support the test engineering team during product development through the life of the developmental aircraft.
You will report to the Omen Systems Engineering, Integration and Test (SEIT) Lead in the UAE, work closely with the Omen SEIT Lead in the U.S., and support the Test Director during test activities.

You will be based in Abu Dhabi and travel regularly within the UAE, mainly to our remote test range (long days and early starts, with overnight stays when needed). Before flight testing starts in the UAE, you will spend an extended period in the United States (expected to be several months) training with the Omen flight test team at our Costa Mesa headquarters and U.S. test sites during the first prototype flight campaign. Expect further U.S. trips after that.

UAE nationals are encouraged to apply.

What You’ll Do

  • As a Test Pilot for the Omen developmental aircraft system you will be involved in Design Reviews and working groups.
  • As an experimental test pilot, you will often push the boundaries of what is considered safe or normal flight.
  • You will help develop system test procedures and be directly involved in laboratory environment and surrogate open-air environment testing.
  • You will be expected to perform as a member within the Test and Evaluation team and regularly interface with the Director of Flight Operations, Head of Test, Chief Engineer, Lead Flight Test Engineer, and customer representatives.
  • You are directly responsible for the safe flight of the aircraft and will hold an advisory position on various safety reviews, design reviews, and Airworthiness reviews.
  • You will be directly involved with ground and flight testing of developmental aircraft to determine compliance with specification, validation of Airworthiness and operational suitability.
  • You will work side-by-side with the Flight Test Engineers and Discipline Engineers to develop safe, effective and efficient test procedures, evaluate system and test safety, and verify the functional design of the system.
  • Faced with technical and execution challenges, you will be expected to develop creative solutions to unique problems. You will be biased for action, empowered to engage your team to solve and fix any problem you encounter.
  • Fly Omen and our smaller surrogate test aircraft from the ground control station during ground and flight tests in the UAE and the U.S.
  • Support UAE flight approvals by providing pilot qualifications, procedures and operating limits to the Test Director for the UAE Military Airworthiness Authority and the range operator
  • Help train UAE team members on aircraft operation, emergency procedures and crew coordination

Required Qualifications

  • Graduate of a recognized military or civilian test pilot school (TPS), e.g. USAF TPS, USNTPS, ETPS, EPNER or NTPS, or meet DCMAINST 8210.1 series alternate education and experience qualifications for contractor UA pilot/operator
  • 10+ years flight test experience, including first flight of new aircraft and envelope expansion.
  • 1,000 hours Pilot-in-Command time or 500 hours in unmanned aircraft.
  • Qualifying hours must include 200 hours of Pilot-in-Command time during engineering flight test, and 10 hours during experimental flight test.
  • Commercial pilot certificate (FAA, UAE GCAA or another ICAO state) with Instrument rating
  • FAA or UAE GCAA Class 2 Medical (or equivalent), maintained annually
  • Ability to travel as required to support off-site aircraft testing, including regular trips to our UAE test range and extended periods in the U.S.
  • Must possess the ability to understand new concepts quickly; apply them accurately; organize, schedule, and coordinate work phases; and determine the appropriate approach at the task level or, with assistance, at the project level to provide solutions to a range of complex problems.
  • Must have strong communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills, with emphasis on technical subjects and the authoring of numerous technical documents which support the safe operation of the aircraft.
  • Experience providing direct support authoring flight manuals and technical documentation necessary to operate developmental aircraft, and delivering configuration controlled publications to the customer.
  • Specialized training and experience in flying and evaluating new or significantly modified aircraft, systems, or technologies.
  • Strong computer and technical software experience (JIRA, MS Office, Jama, and Nominal).
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team; able to perform complex tasks.
  • Able to work extended and irregular hours.
  • This role requires access to U.S. export-controlled technology. Eligibility depends on your citizenship(s) and will be confirmed before an offer is made; you may be asked to sign an export compliance statement
  • Able to pass Anduril pre-employment screening and the UAE security checks needed for access to military test ranges and partner sites
  • Able to qualify as a remote pilot under UAE Military Airworthiness Authority (UAEMAR UAS) rules
  • Right to work in the UAE, or able to obtain a UAE residence visa sponsored by Anduril
  • Valid passport and able to obtain U.S. visas for extended stays (Anduril will support the visa process)
  • Valid UAE driver’s license, or able to obtain one shortly after joining
  • Able to work outdoors in extreme heat and humidity in desert and coastal conditions, wearing the required PPE
  • Able to work early starts, some evenings and some weekends when range time or calls with U.S. teams (11 to 12 hours behind the UAE) require it
  • Fluent spoken and written English

Preferred Qualifications

  • 15+ years experience as a test pilot working with developmental aircraft
  • 2,000 hours Pilot-in-Command time or 500 hours in unmanned aircraft.
  • US, UAE or allied military Weapons School Graduate
  • ATP certificate with Class 1 medical.
  • Masters in Aerospace Engineering, or engineering related technical discipline
  • Previous experience as PIC of high performance turbine aircraft, especially tactical military aircraft.
  • Previous experience as a Test Pilot on a manned or large UAS aircraft
  • First flight experience on a developmental manned or large UAS aircraft
  • Certified Flight Instructor / Instrument
  • Experience flying VTOL, tiltrotor or hover-to-cruise aircraft, including the transition between hover and forward flight
  • Experience flying with the UAE Armed Forces or at UAE ranges, and familiarity with UAE military airspace and airworthiness rules
  • Familiarity with JARUS SORA risk assessments
  • Arabic language skills

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. title: Assessments & Exercises Senior Associate
description:
Contribute to leading-edge security and resilience efforts, advancing protective strategies and propelling continuous improvement.

As an Assessments & Exercises Senior Associate in Cybersecurity & Tech Controls, you will contribute significantly to enhancing the firm's cybersecurity or resiliency posture by using industry-standard assessment methodologies and techniques to proactively identify risks and vulnerabilities in people, processes, and technology. Design and deploy risk-driven tests and simulations (or manage a highly-skilled team that does) and inform analysis to clearly outline root-causes. In this role, you will evaluate preventative controls, incident response processes, and detection capabilities, and advise cross-functional teams on security strategy and risk management.

Job Responsibilities

Design and execute offensive security–led testing and simulation activities—such as Purple Team engagements and adversary emulation used to validate defensive controls and detection/response capabilities—and contribute to the development and refinement of assessment methodologies, tooling, and frameworks to ensure alignment with the firm’s strategy and compliance with regulatory requirements.
Use enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to accelerate synthesis of test evidence and draft executive-ready assessment reporting, validating outputs and handling data according to sensitivity and security requirements.
Evaluate controls for effectiveness and impact on operational risk, as well as opportunities to automate control evaluation.
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to develop comprehensive assessment reports—including detailed findings, risk assessments, root cause analysis, and remediation recommendations—making data-driven decisions that encourage continuous improvement.
Utilize threat intelligence and security research to stay informed about emerging threats, vulnerabilities, industry best practices, and regulations and apply this knowledge to enhance the firm’s assessment strategy and risk management, including engagement with peers and industry groups that share threat intelligence analytics.
Drive reuse-first adoption of AI-assisted workflows for control evaluation and reporting automation, ensuring results are validated and aligned to security and compliance expectations.
Perform hands-on offensive security activities as part of Purple Team engagements (e.g., adversary emulation and detection/response validation) in close partnership with relevant stakeholders, including the SOC.


Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Data Science, or related disciplines (or equivalent experience).
  • Demonstrable experience in cybersecurity, with demonstrated exceptional organizational skills to plan, design, and coordinate offensive security assessments and simulation exercises.
  • Demonstrated experience using enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to support assessment workflows (e.g., analysis support and report drafting) with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity.
  • Ability to review and validate AI-assisted findings and remediation recommendations before use, escalating when uncertain and following security and data handling requirements.
  • Knowledge of US financial services sector cybersecurity organization practices, operations risk management processes, principles, regulations, threats, risks, and incident response methodologies.
  • Ability to identify systemic security issues as they relate to threats, vulnerabilities, or risks, with a focus on recommendations for enhancements or remediation.
  • Experience working in information security within in cloud-based environments (Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) and Platform as a Service (PaaS)) in both private and public environments (AWS, Azure).
  • Demonstrated experience in one or more of the following: Red Team/Purple Team operations, adversary emulation, threat hunting enablement, technical controls assessments, detection engineering validation, incident response readiness activities, and/or network exploitation operations.
  • Strong understanding of: Windows/Linux/Unix/macOS operating systems; OS and software vulnerability and exploitation techniques; commercial or open-source offensive security tools for reconnaissance, scanning, exploitation, and post-exploitation; networking fundamentals (all OSI layers, protocols); IaaS/PaaS concepts; DevOps; incident response; threat hunting; and familiarity with interpreting log output from networking devices, operating systems, and infrastructure services.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and report writing skills, with the ability to influence and engage stakeholders across various functions and levels.


Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Relevant certifications such as those offered by Offensive Security (e.g., OSCP, OSEP, OSED, OSCE) and/or other comparable offensive security or adversary emulation certifications.
  • Knowledge of malware tradecraft (e.g., packing, obfuscation), persistence, and exfiltration techniques.
  • Experience working in the financial sector or other large-scale security and IT infrastructures.
  • Technical knowledge or experience developing proof-of-concept exploits and in-house scripting using interpreted languages such as Python, Ruby, or Perl, and/or compiled languages such as C, C++, C#, or Java.
  • Familiarity with security tools/technologies such as firewalls, IDS/IPS, web proxies, and DLP, and the ability to articulate and visually present complex Purple Team results.

title: PDS - Service Manager (Charlotte, NC)
description:
Field Service Manager – Piedmont Door Solutions
Location: Charlotte, NC (on-site, with regular travel to satellite offices and job sites)
Job Type: Full-time

About Piedmont Door Solutions
Piedmont Door Solutions (PDS) sells, installs, and services automatic and pedestrian door systems for commercial, healthcare, retail, government, and institutional customers across the Southeast, Mid-Atlantic, and Texas. Our service teams keep entrances safe, compliant, and running every day, and our hub-based model puts local leaders close to the customers and technicians they support.

The Role
We're looking for a hands-on Field Service Manager to lead our Charlotte hub's service operation, including technicians, dispatch, and service profitability. This role is for someone who has run a field team, not just worked on one. You'll build and develop a team of AAADM-certified techs, keep the schedule and trucks moving, own the hub's service results, and serve as the go-to contact for key service customers.

What You'll Do

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of service technicians and lead techs through one-on-ones, ride-alongs, and performance reviews
  • Own dispatch and scheduling in ServicePro, balancing customer priority, SLAs, tech skill, and geography
  • Manage the preventive maintenance (PM) schedule and the on-call / after-hours rotation
  • Supervise dispatch/service coordinators and make sure work orders, time, and parts are closed out accurately
  • Approve weekly timesheets and manage truck stock, parts, vehicles, and tools
  • Own the hub's service P&L: revenue, gross margin, labor utilization, and billing
  • Build the monthly service forecast and drive timely, accurate invoicing
  • Partner with Sales on repair, upgrade, and replacement opportunities; grow PM agreements and service contracts
  • Serve as senior service contact for key healthcare, retail, and national/multi-site accounts, and handle escalations through to resolution
  • Recruit, hire, and onboard technicians, and make sure every tech earns and keeps their AAADM certification
  • Lead a strong safety culture and make sure every door left in service is safe, code-compliant, and documented

What You Bring

  • 5+ years in field service operations, including 3+ years directly managing 10 or more field technicians
  • Proven experience running dispatch and scheduling for a mobile workforce
  • Experience owning or contributing to a service P&L or budget
  • Strong customer-facing skills with commercial and institutional accounts
  • Working knowledge of electro-mechanical systems and the ability to support techs on troubleshooting
  • Proficiency with field service software and Microsoft Office (Excel, Outlook, Teams)
  • High school diploma or GED
  • Valid driver's license, acceptable driving record, and ability to pass a background check and drug screen

Nice to Have

  • Automatic or commercial door industry experience
  • AAADM certification (or ability to obtain within 6 months)
  • Experience with ServicePro and/or NetSuite
  • Associate's or Bachelor's degree in business, construction management, or a technical field
  • Experience managing subcontractors and multi-site/national accounts

Work Environment
This role splits time between the office and the field, with regular travel across the hub territory and occasional overnights. You'll be part of the on-call structure for after-hours escalations. Field work may involve lifting up to 50 lbs, climbing ladders, and working outdoors in varying weather.

What We Offer

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k)
  • Paid time off and holidays
  • Life and disability insurance

Piedmont Door Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

title: Bridge Inspection Team Leader (Potential Diver)
description:
What Your Day Will Look Like:

As a Bridge Inspection Team Leader and Engineer-Diver for our Structural Assessment team at Consor in Honolulu, you will be responsible for performing and/or leading a variety of inspections on various structures. You will also be preparing for and/or working on underwater bridge inspection dive teams for our structural assessment contracts locally and in the western US. You will assist in planning, scheduling and coordinating dive field assignments. You will serve as a bridge inspection team leader, diver and be engaged in field inspections as well as reporting tasks. You may also assist on a load ratings for a variety of structures across the Western US, focusing on Hawaii’s inventory.

What You'll Do:

• Lead teams on a variety of above and below-water structure inspections and develop reports in accordance with applicable standards to protect public safety and owner investment. • Schedule field work and reporting tasks for 1-4 sta members. • Manage and perform underwater bridge inspections. • Load rating analysis of existing bridges. • Maintain and prepare equipment for field inspections including dive equipment, vehicles and boats. • Performs additional structural assessment-related duties as assigned or required. • Staff supervision including general instruction, assigning work, coaching, and providing input on staging decisions and performance management.

What You'll Need:

• Association of Diving Contractors International (ADCI) Commercial Diving certification is preferred, if not must be willing to attend ADCIcompliant dive training. • BS Degree in Engineering (Civil or Structural preferred) from an accredited University. • Current or eligible for NBIS Team Leader qualifications per CFR 650.309 • Proficient technical writing skills. • CAD skills preferred. • Load rating experience preferred. • Must be physically able to perform bridge inspections in the field. • Valid driver’s license required. • Must be open to occasional travel within Hawaii or mainland US. • Engineer in Training (EIT) or Engineering Intern (EI). • Professional Engineer (PE) license preferred (Hawaii PE preferred). • Ability and experience to leading teams, communicating and maintaining client relationships.

What Benefits You’ll Enjoy:

We invest in us. Because our team members go above, below, and beyond the surface to care for our communities (inside and out), we do our best to take care of you by providing a comprehensive benefits package! Eligibility for some of the benefits outlined below is based on full-time work status; part-time and contingent positions are only eligible based on hours worked. If you have questions, contact careers@consoreng.com.

  • Career Growth & Development – Tuition reimbursement program, paid professional training, major license achievement bonus, extensive on-demand learning center, and paid professional memberships.

  • Wellness – Medical, dental and vision insurance, employee assistance program, fitness and wellness reimbursement, and HSA and FSA options.
  • Life – Employer-paid STD and LTD, employer-paid term life insurance, and retirement 401(k) with company match.
  • Community – Quarterly social events, paid group volunteering events, and employee networks and groups.

How Your Career Will Grow:

We know career growth is not always linear or streamlined—it’s often squiggly. You may want to explore a management track, try a new technical track, or move laterally to reposition your skills and talents. No matter what level you join us at or how you want to shape your career, we want Consor to be a place where you can learn and grow.

Why You’ll Love Consor:

At Consor, you’ll work with a network of water and transportation professionals who specialize in planning, engineering design, structural assessment, and construction services. Across geographies, you’ll have access to the resources and nationwide expertise found in a large consulting firm, while experiencing a community feel at the local level. You’ll experience a culture where we share in our successes and support one another through challenges. Here, there are countless opportunities to explore your career path by working on projects that help you expand your potential and take your career to new heights! Join our diverse team of experts who live and work alongside client partners, providing thoughtful solutions to create inspiring communities together.

title: Senior Integration & Testing Engineer - UAV Systems
location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
description:
Experience: 5-8 Years

Location: Abu Dhabi

Job Function: Engineering

Department: Research & Development

Notice Period: Immediate joiners or candidates with a notice period of up to 30 days are preferred.



About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced Senior Integration & Testing Engineer with hands-on expertise in UAV system integration, validation, and flight testing. The ideal candidate will play a critical role in integrating mechanical, electrical, avionics, propulsion, and payload systems into UAV platforms and ensuring successful ground and flight validation.

The candidate must possess prior experience working on multirotor, fixed-wing, or VTOL UAV platforms and be capable of troubleshooting complex system-level issues across hardware, avionics, and software interfaces.

Previous UAV industry experience is mandatory.


Key Responsibilities

System Integration

  • Lead end-to-end UAV integration activities for prototype and assistance in production platforms.
  • Integrate airframe assemblies, propulsion systems, avionics, flight controllers, communication systems, additional sensors, and payloads.
  • Perform mechanical fitment, wiring harness integration, and subsystem validation.
  • Ensure proper interface compatibility among mechanical, electrical, and avionics components.


Propulsion

  • Hands on experience in electric and IC engine
  • Experience in propulsion system integration, installation, testing, and troubleshooting.
  • Knowledge of propulsion performance evaluation, tuning, and validation.
  • Experience in conducting ground runs, endurance tests, and performance testing of propulsion systems.
  • Ability to diagnose and resolve propulsion-related mechanical and electrical issues.
  • Familiarity with propulsion safety procedures and maintenance practices.


Avionics Integration: (Basic Understanding Required)

  • Integrate and configure flight controller systems.
  • Configure GPS, IMU, ESCs, telemetry radios, RC systems, ADS-B modules, and onboard computers.
  • Validate sensor performance and communication protocols including CAN, UART, SPI, I2C, Ethernet, and RS-232/RS-485/RS-422.
  • Support autopilot tuning and mission configuration activities.


Testing & Validation

  • Develop integration and qualification test plans, procedures, and reports.
  • Conduct subsystem, system-level, environmental, ground, and flight testing.
  • Execute pre & post-flight inspections, flight readiness reviews, and post-flight analysis.
  • Validate reliability, safety, and performance requirements of UAV systems.
  • Perform root cause analysis and troubleshoot system failures during testing.


Flight Test Operations

  • Support and coordinate UAV flight test campaigns.
  • Analyse flight logs.
  • Identify system anomalies and recommend corrective actions.
  • Work closely with UAV pilots and design engineers during testing activities.


Documentation & Compliance

  • Maintain integration records, test reports, configuration documents, and validation records.
  • Support certification, airworthiness, and regulatory compliance activities where applicable.
  • Ensure adherence to engineering processes, quality standards, and safety procedures.


Required Qualification

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Aeronautical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5-8 years of experience in UAV integration and testing.
  • Hands-on experience working with UAV platforms in an R&D environment.
  • Strong understanding of UAV architecture, avionics, propulsion systems, and flight dynamics.
  • Experience with ground testing, flight testing, and system troubleshooting.
  • Basic exposure to avionics, communication protocols and embedded systems.


Required Technical Skills

Mechanical Integration

  • Airframe assembly and integration
  • Composite structures and mechanical systems
  • Propulsion system assembly and integration
  • Payload assembly and integration
  • Mechanical troubleshooting and root cause analysis


Testing Tools & Software

  • Basic Test Equipment (Multimeter, Oscilloscope)
  • Hand and power tools
  • Data Acquisition Systems


Avionics Integration:

  • Basic understanding of UAV avionics systems, including flight controllers, navigation sensors (GPS, IMU, Compass), telemetry systems, power systems (ESCs, batteries, power distribution), RF communication systems, and embedded electronics integration.


Protocols

  • Basic CAN Bus
  • UART
  • SPI
  • I2C
  • Ethernet


Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in aeronautical engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience with Multirotor, Fixed-Wing, and VTOL UAV platforms.
  • Knowledge of autonomous flight systems and UAV mission planning.
  • Familiarity with UAV regulations and operational safety procedures.
  • Experience with hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) and simulation testing.


Key Competencies

  • System-level thinking
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Analytical troubleshooting
  • Flight test execution
  • Technical leadership
  • Documentation and reporting
  • Problem-solving under field conditions

title: Performance Designer - Paid Creative
description:
About Manukora

Manukora is a global wellness brand, leading the fast-growing US Mānuka honey category. We're on a mission to preserve the power of Mānuka and deliver it to the world in pure, functional formats at uncompromising quality, purity and potency.


Born in the wilds of New Zealand, we harvest one of the planet's rarest natural resources: raw Mānuka honey. This creamy caramel super honey contains unique antioxidants, prebiotics, and a special antibacterial compound called "MGO."


Established in 2015, we are a founder-led, family-owned business headquartered in New Zealand with operations globally in the United States and Europe. Manukora is a certified B Corporation, working with locally-based master beekeeping partners to produce the highest quality Mānuka, leading through ethical beekeeping practices and investing in our bees, their environment and the communities that surround them.


We are a team of beekeepers, herbalists, food scientists, and wellness professionals working to deliver this one-of-a-kind honey and reimagine the immune and digestive wellness categories.


The role

We're bringing our paid ad creative in-house, and this is the hire that makes it happen. You'll be the dedicated designer for our paid team: statics and light motion for Meta, Amazon and our landing pages, briefed by our US-based creative strategists and built to one visual standard across brand and performance. You'll report to our Senior Design Lead for design craft, brand standards and development, and work with the strategists and paid creative team day to day.


This is a performance designer role, not a brand designer who happens to make ads. You've designed a lot of paid creative, you think in hooks, hierarchy and thumb-stop on a phone screen, and you're happy making 20 variants of a winner. You're brand-fluent enough to hold a premium standard: no meme ads, no two visual worlds.


We're open to two kinds of people:

  • A strong paid creative designer with real experience designing ads that ran, great craft and attention to detail, who knows what a good ad looks like and wants to keep growing.
  • A designer who's also a strategist: you go into the results, test ideas on purpose and want to know why version C beat version A.


What matters most in both cases is attitude. The people who've done best on our team are hungry, work really hard, adapt fast, care about every pixel and genuinely grow into the role.


What you'll do

  • Paid statics - design static ad concepts for Meta feed, TikTok, YouTube and other ad placements from creative strategist briefs, plus Amazon A+ content and landing page heroes
  • Light motion - bring statics to life with subtle animation: short, looping, ~5-second assets, not full video edits
  • Rapid iteration - most of the work is variants of what's already winning. Turn around fast, clean variant sets on new hooks, headlines, visuals and formats
  • Own the paid template system - build and maintain a documented static system (formats, sizes, brand-safe layouts, claim placements) that makes speed and consistency the default
  • Get it right on-canvas - apply our claims and compliance rules (MGO grades, product claims) and brand guidelines to every asset, every time
  • Read your own results - go into Motion, see how your ads performed, and work with the strategists on why - then design the next round off that
  • Deliver to spec and deadline - work through the production queue with the creative strategists, Creative Producer & Ops, and the growth/paid team
  • When there's capacity, support the wider design team on landing pages, retail and other digital assets


What you'll bring

  • 3+ years designing paid social creative for US, UK or Australian DTC or CPG brands, in-house or at an agency, running high volumes of paid ads
  • A portfolio of ads that actually ran, ideally with results or context on what worked. A portfolio link is required, and it must include paid social ads that ran. Applications showing only brand, packaging or organic work will not be reviewed.
  • A strong understanding of how paid ads work - hooks, formats, placements, creative testing, and what moves the numbers
  • Excellent hierarchy, typography and layout instincts at thumbnail size
  • Fluency in Figma, plus After Effects or similar motion
  • Comfort with AI tools in the workflow (we use Higgsfield and CapCut) - used with judgement, never at the expense of craft
  • Speed without sloppiness - you can hit a volume target and still care about every pixel
  • A hunger to learn and grow, and the drive to do your best work every week
  • Brand-standard discipline - you respect a guideline and know how to push inside it
  • English good enough to work live with our US-based creative strategists every day
  • At least 4 hours a day overlapping with 9am to 5pm Pacific, Monday to Friday, to work live with our US-based creative strategists


Nice to have

  • Experience with creative testing and the numbers behind your ads (cost per purchase, ROAS, win rate), and being able to explain why an ad won
  • Results or context on what worked, shared alongside your portfolio


What this role is not

  • Long-form video editing
  • Packaging or brand campaign concepting
  • Organic social
  • Junior/entry-level - you should be able to take a brief and run
  • A role where we'll teach you paid creative. We need you producing to brief, at our standard, within your first two weeks
  • A slow-paced role. We're a high-volume, fast-scaling business and the work needs focus


What success looks like in your first 90 days

  • All paid statics and light motion made in-house, at or above our current weekly volume
  • A documented static template system the whole team can work from
  • Your static win rate tracked against our current baseline


Why you'll love it

  • Your work ships weekly - you'll see what you made go live, and see exactly how it performed
  • A brand worth designing for - premium product, distinctive identity, and an audience that genuinely loves what we make. A chance to work with a leading US wellness brand.
  • One team, one standard - you'll sit in the design team (4 other global team members), close to the brand, with the paid team as your daily connect
  • Fully remote - at least 4 hours' overlap with 9am to 5pm Pacific


How to apply

Email marlen@manukora.com with the subject line “Performance Designer - Paid Creative - [Your Name]” and include your CV, your portfolio link (it must include paid social ads that actually ran), and short answers to these 2 questions:

  1. Which US, UK or Australian DTC/consumer brands have you designed paid social ads for? For each one, tell us roughly how long you worked on it and whether it was in-house, at an agency or freelance.
  2. Roughly how many finished ads (including variants) were you designing per week, and which 2–3 ads in your portfolio actually ran as paid ads?


Important: applications that don’t answer both questions won’t be considered.

title: Scientific Technical Writer

Disclaimer: The above description is meant to illustrate the general nature of work and level of effort being performed by individuals assigned to this position or job description. This is not restricted as a complete list of all skills, responsibilities, duties, and/or assignments required. title: Director of Graduate Studies
description:
NYBG Job Description

Title

Reports to

Director of Graduate Studies

Dean and Chief Science Officer

Position Summary:

The Director of Graduate Studies leads the New York Botanical Garden’s Graduate Studies Program and oversees the academic, financial, and administrative matters associated with graduate students conducting research and training at NYBG. The Director serves as NYBG’s principal coordinator for graduate education across its partner universities and programs and provides administrative oversight for the Science Internship Program and other related student training activities. As a member of the Science leadership team, the Director also shares responsibility for coordinating and overseeing selected Science administrative functions, institutional processes, and divisional initiatives.

The Director works closely with approximately 25 graduate students, their NYBG faculty advisors, and their partner academic programs, as well as NYBG administrative departments, to support student recruitment, funding, appointments, academic progress, research, and professional development.

Although primarily an administrative position, the Director is expected to maintain an active research program as time allows. The position requires hands-on research experience and the academic qualifications necessary for appropriate adjunct or other faculty appointments at NYBG partner universities.

Specific Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Lead and administer NYBG’s Graduate Studies Program, providing overall direction for graduate education, student support, and program development.
  • Oversee graduate admissions and work with Curators and partner universities to recruit and support highly qualified graduate students.
  • Oversee multiyear graduate student funding commitments and the Graduate Studies fellowship budget, coordinating support from institutional fellowships, faculty grants, partner universities, and other sources.
  • Partner with Institutional Advancement and Science leadership to cultivate donors, develop funding proposals, and secure philanthropic support to sustain and expand graduate fellowships, research opportunities, and program activities.
  • Advise and support graduate students throughout their programs, working with faculty advisers and university partners to monitor academic progress, research training, and degree requirements.
  • Maintain strong relationships with university partners and represent NYBG in matters related to graduate education, faculty participation, and collaborative programs.
  • Teach graduate courses and coordinate Curator participation in teaching through affiliated academic programs.
  • Foster a collegial and collaborative graduate community by providing opportunities for students and researchers to learn about one another’s work, exchange ideas, develop collaborations, and participate in shared research and professional development activities.
  • Coordinate graduate student administration with Human Resources, IT, and Security departments and oversee other institutional processes necessary to support students and research trainees.
  • Participate in the leadership and administration of the Science Division, coordinating selected administrative functions and contributing to Science-wide planning, institutional initiatives, and professional service.
  • Other related duties.

Qualifications:

Required

  • Ph.D. in botany, plant science, biology, or a closely related field.
  • Hands-on research and teaching experience and a record of scientific scholarship appropriate to the position.
  • Qualifications appropriate for adjunct or comparable faculty appointments at NYBG partner universities.
  • Experience in graduate education, scientific research, research training, or academic program administration.
  • Understanding of doctoral education and the academic expectations of graduate study in the biological sciences.
  • Ability to work effectively with students, faculty advisers, university partners, and institutional administrative departments.
  • Strong organizational, financial, written, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple funding sources, appointments, deadlines, and multiyear commitments.

Preferred

  • Experience advising or mentoring graduate students.
  • Experience with university partnerships, graduate student funding, fellowships, or research grants.
  • Experience with consortium-based graduate education and an appreciation of the role of botanical gardens, museums, or other research institutions in university graduate training.

Physical Demands & Work Environment:

This position will require work in an office environment, with extended periods sitting or standing at a desk, using a computer, and attending meetings virtually and in person with other people. Some travel will be required within the United States and overseas. Valid driver’s license is required for on-campus transportation of personnel and materials.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

Baseline Work Schedule:

Position is full-time; Monday–Friday 9 am to 5 pm, with extended days as needed to fulfill job responsibilities. Occasional evenings and weekends.

Salary: $150,000

description:
Voyager is an innovative defense, national security and space technology company committed to advancing and delivering transformative, mission-critical solutions. We tackle the most complex challenges to unlock new frontiers for human progress, fortify national security, and protect critical assets to lead in the race for technological and operational superiority from ground to space.

The future belongs to those who build it. At Voyager Technologies, we’re building technologies that protect lives, expand frontiers and prepare us for what’s next. And we’re doing that with people who are wired to solve, build, adapt and lead. These roles are not for the faint of heart.

__________________________________________________________________________________

Job Summary:

We are seeking a Staff Computational Scientist to define and lead our research program in accelerated, differentiable multiphysics: GPU-native physics kernels that are fast, verified, and differentiable, and that can be fit to experimental data through inverse design. You will build these solvers and deliver them as a shared core platform service that drives the labeled-data factory behind our surrogates and our platform's fidelity ladder. Ideal candidates will have direct experience building kernels that underpin structural, thermal, plasma, and materials modeling.

You will be joining a new, early-stage team within Voyager's Advanced Technology Group building an AI-native engineering platform. We hire curious, highly motivated domain experts who already build with AI and have the taste to know what good looks like.

Responsibilities:

  • Build differentiable physics kernels for aerospace and defense problems.
  • Use profilers to find computational bottlenecks in solver code and identify the most impactful kernels to accelerate.
  • Port solvers to GPU (CUDA, JAX, Taichi, Warp) using mixed precision, multigrid/sparse solvers, and adaptive meshing.
  • Create solvers as tools with representations that are suitable for agentic workflows and architect a system of agents working with solvers to accelerate simulation and design.
  • Verify accelerated and differentiable paths against baselines and reference solutions, with regression benchmarks.
  • Develop inverse-design workflows that use differentiable solvers to fit model parameters to experimental data, calibrating simulations against test measurements and quantifying the fit.
  • Build sweep orchestration capabilities on cloud and GPU resources.
  • Deliver accelerated solvers as a shared core platform service for aerospace and defense needs, including the labeled-data factory behind our surrogates.
  • Set research direction, mentor junior members of the broader team, and directly contribute to building an agentic engineering platform.

Required Qualifications:

  • PhD in Computational Physics, Aerospace or Mechanical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or related field with 6–10 years of experience in computational physics or engineering.
  • Differentiable programming and adjoint methods for design optimization and inverse problems.
  • Has written GPU-accelerated solvers for plasma, CFD, electromagnetics, or other domains.
  • JAX, Taichi or PyTorch for differentiable simulation; CUDA or JAX/Warp for GPU programming; C++ and Python; GPU profiling and performance optimization.
  • Deep understanding of the underlying mathematics for physical systems modeling.
  • Has built automated parametric sweep pipelines on clusters or cloud.
  • Publication or shipped-product record.
  • Demonstrated AI-first workflow: builds with AI coding agents daily, with a shipped speedup you can show and explain how you verified.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen and able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance at the level required for the position and applicable government contract. The position also requires appropriate access eligibility and a need-to-know. Clearance eligibility is determined by the U.S. Government.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Plasma modeling (PIC or hybrid fluid-kinetic), ideally electric propulsion.
  • Multiphysics coupling (plasma, thermal, structural), including stress and thermal modeling.
  • Experience leading a research program or team.

Remote (U.S.), with periodic travel to Voyager locations (Los Angeles, CA; Washington, D.C.; Seattle, WA) for lab work, hardware test events, and technical reviews.

The Respiratory Therapy Manager is responsible for the overall function and professional growth of the respiratory therapy department.   • Overseeing the daily operations of the respiratory therapy department, to include: staff interviews, employment decision, orientation, performance evaluations, employee training and development, as well as inventory, equipment and instrument issues.

title: Wealth Management Advisor
description:
Wealth Advisor | Questmont Virtual Family Office

Tampa, FL

Bring your point of view. Be willing to change it.

At Questmont, we work with business owners and families through some of the biggest decisions of their lives. Selling a company. Turning a lifetime of work into lasting financial independence. Figuring out how to pass on wealth in a way that strengthens the family.

That work takes an advisor who can spot an opportunity, ask the question everyone else is dancing around, and bring the right people together to get it done. If you take initiative, welcome direct feedback, and care as much about the team’s success as your own, we’d like to meet you.

  • Authenticity. We speak plainly, ask for help when we need it, and welcome feedback. Everyone here has something to teach and something to learn.

To apply, send your résumé and a few sentences about a time you saw something a client needed, took ownership, and brought others in to get it done.
