title: Senior Spacecraft Mechanisms Engineer (NASA Moon Base Transportation)
description:
Senior Spacecraft Mechanisms Engineer (NASA Moon Base Transportation)

Onsite at Kennedy Space Center in Merritt Island, Florida


We are seeking a Senior Spacecraft Mechanisms Engineer to support NASA’s Transportation Engineering Support (TENS) effort and the Moon Base Transportation (MBT) Office at Kennedy Space Center.


This role will provide independent engineering assessment of spacecraft mechanical systems and flight hardware supporting future lunar transportation and sustained Moon operations. Systems may include deployment mechanisms, actuators, latches, release and separation systems, payload restraints, doors, hatches, docking interfaces, and other spacecraft mechanisms.


Responsibilities:

  • Evaluate spacecraft mechanisms, mechanical systems, and flight hardware throughout design, integration, testing, qualification, and operation
  • Review engineering analyses, drawings, CAD models, requirements, test plans, test results, and verification evidence
  • Assess mechanism performance including loads, kinematics, clearances, alignment, tolerance stack-ups, interfaces, reliability, and failure modes
  • Perform targeted CAD assessments including fit checks, interface evaluations, envelope studies, and tolerance reviews
  • Evaluate qualification and environmental testing including vibration, shock, thermal-vacuum, deployment, and lifecycle testing
  • Investigate mechanical anomalies, interface issues, design changes, and test discrepancies
  • Participate in design reviews, test readiness reviews, technical meetings, and engineering working groups
  • Communicate technical risks, findings, and recommendations to NASA, commercial partners, and multidisciplinary engineering teams


Qualifications:

  • U.S. Citizenship is required by Federal Law
  • Must successfully complete a U.S. government background investigation
  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related engineering discipline and 10+ years of relevant mechanical or aerospace engineering experience
  • Experience with spacecraft mechanisms, flight hardware, or complex aerospace mechanical systems
  • Strong knowledge of mechanical design, loads, kinematics, interfaces, tolerances, bearings, actuators, and structural behavior
  • Experience reviewing engineering analyses, drawings, CAD models, and test results
  • Experience with Siemens NX, SolidWorks, or comparable CAD software
  • Experience supporting aerospace hardware development, integration, testing, or verification
  • Strong technical communication and independent engineering judgment
  • Ability to work full-time onsite at Kennedy Space Center and travel as required


Desired Qualifications:

  • Direct spacecraft, launch vehicle, lunar lander, payload, or other spaceflight hardware experience
  • Experience with deployment, latching, separation, docking, berthing, or payload restraint mechanisms
  • Experience with vibration, shock, thermal-vacuum, qualification, deployment, or lifecycle testing
  • Proficiency with Siemens NX and/or SolidWorks
  • Familiarity with NASTRAN or similar finite element analysis tools
  • Knowledge of NASA flight-hardware development, verification, qualification, and design-review practices


This is an opportunity to contribute directly to the engineering behind NASA’s effort to establish a sustained human presence on the Moon. The Moon Base Transportation Office is helping address the end-to-end challenge of transporting spacecraft, payloads, logistics, infrastructure, and other critical elements from Earth to lunar destinations as NASA develops the transportation capabilities needed to build and sustain future lunar operations.


Company Info:

We are a woman-owned space and technology company headquartered in Houston, TX. Our primary objective is to support the Department of Defense and NASA in achieving their missions to defend the security of our country, reach new heights and to discover the unknown. We employ some of the brightest, most experienced engineering and technology experts in the U.S.

title: Client Onboarding and Documents Platform - Product - Vice President
location: Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires, Argentina
description:
As a Vice President in Product within the Client Onboarding and Documents Platform, you will own a core capability area of our Document platform. Examples include document ingestion and classification, data extraction, metadata management or enterprise search. Your goal is to turn high-volume, unstructured onboarding documentation into trusted, searchable, permissioned data at scale. Working within the platform strategy set by the Product Director, you will turn the vision into a sequenced roadmap. You will make sure your capabilities are designed for scale, configurability and speed.

With a product-first mindset and strong technical fluency, you will design service-oriented, rule-driven capabilities that adapt to complex regulatory requirements across Lines of Business (LOBs). You will work closely with Product Owners, Product Design Leads, Engineering, UAT, Release Management, Risk, Compliance and Business stakeholders. Together you will define platform capabilities, deliver modernization and build reusable enablers that speed up delivery across the enterprise.

If you think in terms of customer journeys, API and event contracts, business rules, content lifecycle, intelligent document processing (IDP) and AI-enabled workflows, and you can lead a team from idea to measurable outcome, this role is for you.

Job responsibilities:

  • Own the roadmap, backlog priorities, risk management and business targets for your capability area, in line with the overall Documentation Processing platform vision.

  • Turn onboarding and regulatory needs into clear value propositions and success metrics: reusability, speed-to-market, lower cost-to-serve and stronger controls.

  • Lead discovery with LOB stakeholders and operations users to map customer journeys, find pain points and prioritize by value.

  • Monitor market trends and vendor capabilities in content services, IDP and enterprise search. Contribute to competitive analysis and build-vs-buy recommendations.

  • Work with Engineering and Architecture to define capability boundaries, API and event contracts, and rule and decisioning patterns.

  • Apply a “build once, configure everywhere” approach: favor configuration over customization and use asynchronous events to reduce coupling.

  • Lead the product lifecycle (discovery → delivery → adoption). Own the quality of epics, features and acceptance criteria, and manage delivery risks and dependencies.

  • Work with UAT and Release Management on test strategy, entry and exit criteria, go/no-go decisions and release readiness.

  • Define and maintain canonical models for document metadata and extracted entities in your area (schemas, taxonomies, lineage), keeping them consistent across LOB implementations.

  • Own quality measures for your pipelines and set and report targets. Examples: extraction accuracy and coverage, exception rates, reprocessing rates, search relevance and time-to-find.

  • Work with engineering and data/AI teams to shape applied AI/ML use cases such as classification, extraction, validation and semantic search. This includes evaluation approaches, human-in-the-loop controls and ongoing quality monitoring.

  • Make sure capabilities meet firmwide standards for privacy, access control, auditability and retention. Lead readiness for architecture reviews, risk assessments and audit evidence.

  • Drive platform health and cost optimization through SRE practices and telemetry: throughput, latency, failure modes, backlog and reprocessing, and cost per document.

  • Explain progress, trade-offs and options in business terms to the Product Director, senior stakeholders and steering committees.

  • Coach and mentor Associates and Senior Associates in product best practices, including story mapping, prototyping, adoption strategies and outcome-driven roadmaps.

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

  • 8+ years of experience (or equivalent expertise) in product management, product design or technology delivery, including ownership of a platform or shared-service capability

  • Track record in platform product management: value propositions, user journeys, iterative roadmaps and driving adoption

  • Proven ability to influence and align stakeholders across multiple functions and LOBs in a matrix organization

  • Strong technical fluency in modern architectures and delivery practices:

    • Service-oriented architecture, API design, event-driven patterns, rule engines and decisioning (e.g., Drools, DMN, OPA)

    • Modern tech stacks (e.g., Java, Node.js, Python), cloud platforms, containerization and CI/CD

  • Strong data and product analytics skills:

  • Document processing experience in at least one of these areas:

    • Document ingestion/receiving and workflow orchestration

    • Content storage and metadata management

    • Taxonomy and classification

    • OCR/ICR and extraction pipelines, including validation and exception handling

    • Indexing and enterprise search, including access-control-aware search patterns

  • Enough AI literacy to make product decisions: evaluating model usefulness and quality, defining evaluation approaches and designing human-in-the-loop controls

  • Familiarity with LLM-enabled document understanding patterns and their practical trade-offs (accuracy, cost, latency, controls)

  • Strong agile delivery practice (Scrum/Kanban; SAFe a plus) and strong Jira skills

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

  • Financial services experience and knowledge of regulatory and banking environments

  • Experience implementing controls and auditability for document content and extracted data (privacy, access controls, evidence capture, retention)

  • Experience with vendor evaluation and build-vs-buy decisions for content, IDP or search platforms, including total cost of ownership (TCO) and integration patterns

  • Strong knowledge of platform health metrics and operational telemetry, including extraction quality and search KPIs

  • Experience working in global, distributed teams across multiple time zones

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Product Design or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)

title: People Generalist
description:
People Generalist

About us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you’re given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world.

In our warm, collaborative culture, you’ll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing.

Your future at the FT will be filled with opportunities that challenge and inspire you. With no fixed path, you’ll discover new skills and forge a career that can take you anywhere.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

Our commitment to inclusion and fairness

We believe everyone should have a fair opportunity to contribute, succeed, and reach their full potential. That means ensuring everyone is heard, respected, and valued, while identifying and removing barriers that may get in the way. Our commitment is to be an employer role model, grounded in inclusion and fairness for all.

We want every application to receive fair and thoughtful consideration; therefore, all applications are reviewed by a member of our recruitment team, not by AI.

The role

We are looking for a proactive and collaborative People Generalist to join our US People team, playing a key role in delivering an excellent employee experience across the Financial Times' US business.

This is a varied role combining hands-on People operations with practical advice and support for managers and employees. You will take the lead on US employee benefits administration, oversee key People processes and manage the People & Benefits Assistant, ensuring our employees receive a responsive, consistent and high-quality service.

Working closely with colleagues across the US and global People teams, you will also support employee relations, engagement initiatives and wider People projects. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on how we support our people, while helping to improve processes, introduce new ways of working and contribute to the delivery of our US People strategy.

Key responsibilities

Benefits management and administration

  • Lead the day-to-day administration and delivery of US employee benefits, including medical, dental, retirement and other benefit programs.

  • Act as the main People team contact for benefits-related queries and escalations, working closely with brokers, providers and internal stakeholders.

  • Coordinate annual benefits renewals, open enrollment, plan changes and employee communications.

  • Oversee benefits compliance, reporting, vendor administration and reconciliations, including coordinating 401(k) administration with Payroll.

  • Identify opportunities to improve benefits processes, employee understanding and the overall service experience.

People operations and team management

  • Manage, support and develop the People & Benefits Assistant, providing guidance, coaching and clear priorities.

  • Oversee core People administration, including onboarding, offboarding, employee lifecycle changes and associated documentation.

  • Ensure People processes are accurate, efficient and supported by appropriate controls and service standards.

  • Oversee employee leave administration, working with internal colleagues and external providers to meet applicable requirements.

  • Partner with the payroll-focused People Generalist to ensure accurate and timely information sharing across People operations, benefits and Payroll.

Manager partnering and employee relations

  • Provide practical guidance to managers on employee relations matters, including performance management, disciplinary processes, grievances and workplace concerns.

  • Support organizational changes, employee transitions and other people-related initiatives.

  • Work collaboratively with the global People team to deliver consistent and effective support.

  • Coordinate the operational administration and reporting associated with US union agreements, including dues, reporting and labor-management committee activities.

Employee experience and continuous improvement

  • Coordinate follow-up activities from US employee engagement surveys and support the delivery of agreed actions.

  • Partner with the global Learning & Talent team to support local development needs and global learning initiatives.

  • Contribute to employee engagement, wellbeing, People policy development and other initiatives supporting the US People strategy.

  • Support local and global People projects, identifying opportunities to improve service delivery through automation, AI and more effective use of technology.

Required skills and experience

  • Experience in a People Generalist, HR Operations or similar role, with a strong understanding of US HR practices and employee lifecycle processes.

  • Practical experience administering US employee benefits, including health insurance, retirement plans and benefits-related compliance.

  • Good working knowledge of US employment practices and regulations, with the ability to provide sound, practical guidance to managers and employees.

  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities in a busy environment.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to build relationships and work effectively with stakeholders at different levels.

  • A collaborative, proactive and solutions-focused approach, with a commitment to delivering a high-quality employee experience.

  • Experience improving HR processes and using HR systems and technology to support efficient service delivery.

  • The ability to handle sensitive employee information with discretion, professionalism and sound judgment.

What's in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, health coverage, 401k and company match, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

We currently operate a hybrid model which requires staff to work onsite 50% of the time, subject to role requirements & regular review. While flexible working requests will be considered, not all patterns are suitable for all roles. We believe this balanced approach supports flexibility and protects our culture, making collaboration and communication easier, building stronger relationships and team cohesion, and supporting peer learning. We reserve discretion on reasonable notice to change this approach either generally or for specific individuals or teams.

Accessibility

We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory.

Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments/personalisation as part of the application process or to enable you to attend an interview. If you would like to discuss your requirements or have any questions, email talent@ft.com and a member of our team will be happy to help.

Further information

A reasonable estimate of the salary range for this role is $86,000 - $96,000. To ensure pay fairness, the successful candidate will be offered a salary within the estimated salary range based on a number of considerations including but not limited to: skill set; experience and training; certifications; and other business and organisational needs. The disclosed range estimate is for our NYC office and has not been adjusted for other locations.

At the FT, we embrace innovation and the use of technology and appreciate that individuals may leverage AI tools as part of their job application process. Whilst we are happy for you to use AI to assist with your application, it is essential that all information provided is authentic and accurately represents your skills, experience, and qualifications.

Candidates should be aware that the use of AI throughout the application process may be monitored to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process for all.

Please beware of fraudulent job postings and offers claiming to be from the Financial Times. All legitimate opportunities will direct you to apply through the official Financial Times careers site, and the FT will never ask for financial information, payments, or referrals to third parties during the hiring process. If you have any concerns about the legitimacy of a job posting or suspect any scam activity, please contact talent@ft.com.

title: Rotating Equipment Engineer
description:
Location: Altamira, Mexico (Offshore FLNG)

Schedule: 21 days on / 21 days off

Reports to: Maintenance Supervisor

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Rotating Equipment Engineer to work offshore aboard an offshore Fast Client facility on a rotational schedule of 21 consecutive days on duty followed by 21 consecutive days off. The position requires the employee to live and work aboard the offshore facility throughout each 21-day assignment. Crew changes, travel, and work schedules will be based on operational requirements, weather conditions, and marine transportation availability. The role may periodically require travel to an onshore office, vendor facilities, repair shops, or other locations. The Rotating Equipment Engineer will provide onsite technical leadership and engineering support for the facility's critical rotating equipment, including gas turbines, refrigerant compressors, feed gas booster compressors, boil-off gas compressors, pumps, fans, gearboxes, and associated auxiliary systems. This position will focus on equipment reliability, condition monitoring, troubleshooting, defect elimination, maintenance strategy, outage planning, and continuous improvement. The successful candidate must be a hands-on, field-oriented engineer who is comfortable working in an offshore operating environment. The individual will work closely with Operations, Maintenance, Reliability, Engineering, OEMs, and contractors to evaluate equipment performance, identify developing problems, lead failure investigations, and implement practical solutions that improve safety, availability, reliability, and lifecycle cost.

Key Responsibilities

Provide direct, onsite engineering coverage during the assigned 21-day offshore rotation, including support for equipment trips, abnormal operating conditions, emergency repairs, startups, shutdowns, and planned outages.

Participate in the offshore duty and emergency-response structure as assigned and remain available to respond to critical rotating equipment issues outside normal working hours while onboard the facility.

Complete effective rotational handovers documenting equipment condition, active failures, temporary repairs, outstanding technical issues, planned maintenance, operational risks, and required follow-up actions.

Coordinate with the opposite-rotation engineer and onshore support teams to ensure continuity of technical ownership and rotating equipment priorities between crew rotations.

Qualifications & Requirements

Willingness and ability to work offshore on a fixed rotational schedule of 21 consecutive days on duty followed by 21 consecutive days off.

Ability to live and work onboard an offshore FLNG facility for the full duration of each 21-day assignment.

Ability to work extended offshore shifts and respond to urgent equipment problems outside regularly scheduled hours when operationally required.

Willingness to travel by marine vessel, helicopter, or other company-approved transportation to and from the offshore facility.

Ability to meet all company, flag-state, coastal-state, medical, security, immigration, and offshore training requirements necessary for assignment to the facility.

Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline from an accredited institution.

A minimum of seven years of rotating equipment engineering, maintenance, reliability, or technical support experience within Client, oil and gas, petrochemical, refining, power generation, marine, or another heavy industrial environment.

Strong working knowledge of gas turbines, centrifugal and reciprocating compressors, pumps, fans, gearboxes, couplings, bearings, lubrication systems, dry gas seals, and associated auxiliary systems.

Direct experience with aero-derivative or industrial gas turbines; experience with Client/Baker Hughes LM6000 PF+ and Siemens SGT-400 equipment is strongly preferred.

Experience supporting critical process compressors, including mixed-refrigerant, feed gas booster, and boil-off gas compressor applications, is strongly preferred.

Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot vibration, bearing failures, seal failures, lubrication issues, alignment problems, performance degradation, abnormal temperatures, and other rotating equipment conditions.

Experience with predictive and condition-monitoring technologies, including vibration analysis, lubricating oil analysis, thermography, borescope inspections, performance trending, and remote monitoring systems.

Experience developing preventive and predictive maintenance strategies, inspection plans, overhaul scopes, and condition-based maintenance requirements.

Experience leading or participating in root cause failure analyses and translating findings into practical and sustainable corrective actions.

Working knowledge of rotating equipment installation, shaft alignment, balancing, commissioning, performance testing, inspection, repair, overhaul, and return-to-service requirements.

Familiarity with applicable API, ASME, ISO, NFPA, marine, and offshore standards and recommended practices.

Experience reviewing OEM documentation, repair proposals, inspection findings, engineering drawings, equipment data sheets, service bulletins, and technical reports.

Experience using CMMS applications to manage maintenance history, equipment records, inspection findings, bills of material, and spare-parts information.

Strong analytical, troubleshooting, organizational, communication, and technical-writing skills.

Level 2 vibration analysis and Lube oil analysis MLA 1

Good understanding of alignment, both laser and dial indictor

Ability to calculate and plot system curves and performance points for compressor and pumps.

Ability to work independently offshore while coordinating effectively with technicians, operators, facility leadership, OEM representatives, contractors, and onshore engineering teams.

Offshore, marine, Client, or cryogenic facility experience is strongly preferred.

Professional Engineer registration or relevant rotating equipment, vibration analysis, reliability, or condition-monitoring certification is a plus.

Bilingual English/Spanish capability is a plus.

Work Conditions

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is often required to stand, walk, sit, climb stairs, work at height above ground on stairs and catwalks, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, talk or hear, smell, type and write.

Must be able to board a ship via a gangway, climb to the top of a tank (200+ steps), scale vertical steel ladder up to forty feet or more in height and lift and move objects weighing up to 30 pounds.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee will work indoors & outdoors, and be exposed to year-around weather conditions, ocean environment, and noise. There is a considerable number of outdoor activities involved.

  • Use process maps to highlight risks, handoffs, failure points, and control gaps; partner with stakeholders to validate and improve accuracy.
  • Support a sustainable “process inventory” and mapping cadence (updates aligned to change, incidents, audit feedback, regulatory needs).
  • Partner with Client Service and to support root cause analysis and identify opportunities to improve processes and controls.

  • Contribute to Client Service introduction materials and structured packs that explain process/control coverage clearly to reviewers.

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Demonstrated experience in a banking/financial services environment in an operations, client service, governance, or controls-adjacent role.

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

title: Transfer Specialist I
description:
Position Classification:

Regular, full-time, salaried, exempt and benefit-eligible staff position. For more benefit information visit Why Work at UCO?

General Schedule:

Position typically works Monday-Friday from 8am-5pm, some evenings and weekends may be required.

Primary Work Location:

Rose State College

Position Overview:

Advises prospective students and their parents about the University's programs and educational opportunities. Recruits students by developing and managing recruitment initiatives, coordinating travel, attending college fairs, visiting high schools and community colleges, and participating in on- and off-campus recruitment activities. Effectively carries out prospective student territory management responsibilities.This position is physically housed at Rose State College and serves as a University of Central Oklahoma (UCO) Admissions Recruiter. While based at Rose State College, the employee performs the same recruitment, admissions, territory management, and student engagement responsibilities as other UCO Admissions Recruiters and is responsible for recruiting prospective students within assigned territories.Collaborates with other functional departments (e.g., University Communications, academic colleges, and UCO Administration) to ensure accurate and up-to-date information is provided to prospective students. Assists with recruitment-related events and programs, including daily campus tours. Participates in recruiting, advising, and orientation programs for prospective domestic students. May develop orientation materials, handouts, and other resources for prospective students.

Department Specific Essential Job Functions:

  • Responsible for territory management through best practices in relational marketing and outreach, requesting and scheduling visits to high schools and/or community colleges within assigned territory throughout the academic year.
  • Responsible for management and general business operations related to in-state and/or out-of-state recruitment planning within assigned territories, while complying with approved frameworks provided by the Recruiter Director. This includes identifying viable recruitment opportunities, creating travel plans and schedules, and developing targeted programming.
  • Travels to and participates in community events, college fairs, and other opportunities to identify, attract, and recruit prospective students. Coordinates admissions workshops on campus, at high schools, community colleges, community centers, and related venues to disseminate information about UCO to prospective students and/or parents.
  • Provides effective and engaging presentations to prospective students, parents, and counselors. Plans, organizes, travels to, and participates in recruitment events and private visits. Meets recruitment objectives as determined by University and Enrollment and Student Success (ESS) leadership.
  • Independently develops and fosters relationships with prospective students and other constituents, including family members, parents/guardians, counselors, and community members. Provides excellent customer service when responding to questions, inquiries, and general interactions with prospective students and their constituents.
  • Assists with campus programs and projects related to recruitment, including campus tours. Serves as a primary contact for prospective students and guides them through the enrollment process. Develops and engages in programming to assist students with completing all steps of the enrollment process, including the application for admission, FAFSA, financial aid documentation, and housing.
  • Responsible for outreach efforts to obtain missing documents needed to complete application files. Manages assigned recruitment territory by effectively utilizing the CRM platform, including automated emails, phone calls, handwritten postcards/letters, and text messaging. Responsible for documenting all communication with prospective students in the CRM.
  • Explains admission procedures and requirements and determines admissibility of freshman, concurrent, and transfer students in accordance with professional association guidelines, state mandates, institutional policies, and leadership directives.
  • Reviews admission applications for completeness and accuracy and evaluates transcripts for curricular and performance requirements. Enters admissions data into the Student Information System (SIS) or CRM system and assists with processing applications for admission.
  • Exercises discretion, critical thinking, and independent judgment when conducting comprehensive reviews of applicant files and making admissions decisions, recognizing the importance of these decisions to University enrollment and sustainability.
  • Coordinates with other departments for large admissions events to maximize opportunities to identify, attract, and enroll future students. Discusses future enrollment options with students who do not initially meet admission requirements. Exercises critical thinking and independent judgment when making admissions decisions that support enrollment goals and align with the University's mission.
  • Position requires frequent evening and weekend work depending on recruitment and event schedules and workload. Use of a personal cell phone to conduct University business is required.
  • Frequently moves boxes weighing up to 20 pounds to and from the work location.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Qualifications/Experience Required:

  • Requires a bachelor's degree from an accredited institution.
  • Must have a valid driver's license, clean driving record, and be able to operate a typical motor vehicle.

Qualifications/Experience Preferred:

Admissions or Enrollment Management experience is preferred. Experience with Banner and CRM solutions is preferred.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Strong decision-making and organizational skills delivered from a client-centered perspective.
  • Ability to work well under pressure and give attention to detail.
  • Excellent oral and written communication and personal computing skills.
  • Ability to relate to applicant/student population as well as to various members of the higher education community.
  • Ability to work independently, manage an assigned territory, and build relationships with prospective students and community partners.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with UCO departments and external partners while representing the University professionally.

Will This Employee Supervise Others?

No, this position will not supervise others.

Physical Demands:

Reasonable accommodations (in accordance with ADA requirements) may be made, upon request, to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

title: Data Analytics Lead, Corporate Planning & Operations
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Team

The Corporate Planning & Operations team builds and defines how the company plans, forecasts, and makes operational decisions across teams, turning strategy into day-to-day execution.

We sit at the center of the business and take on high-impact, often ambiguous problems that directly affect growth, efficiency, and how the business scales. That means deep-dive analysis, process re-design, and building pragmatic solutions that make the company run better.

We work closely with senior leaders, move quickly, and focus on outcomes. This is a team for people who like solving hard problems, building and iterating, and leaving things better than they found them.

The Data Analytics arm serves as the analytical and data engineering backbone for corporate planning. We build the dashboards, metrics, and tooling that power planning cycles, executive reviews, and day-to-day operational decision-making.

About the Job

We’re hiring a Data Analytics Lead at Anduril HQ in Costa Mesa, CA to support and scale Anduril’s corporate planning and operating cadence through high-quality data engineering, visualization, and quantitative analysis. In this role, you will lead the direction for translating planning and operational questions into metrics, dashboards, and analyses that inform decision-making. You will be responsible not only for producing rigorous analytical work, but also for ensuring the analytics products the team owns are reliable, well-understood, and have a solid roadmap for improvement and added functionality into the future. As the Lead in this role, you will also bring structure, visibility, and disciplined execution to the team. This role is ideal for someone who is technically strong, thoughtful about system design, scrappy and has experience employing these skills in high visibility, heavily cross-functional environments.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and iterate dashboards and analytical tools that drive recurring planning and operational reviews. Overlay quantitative analytics on data-sets and design tooling for forecasting, trend analysis, and scenario planning.
  • Drive roadmap of new initiatives from ideation through adoption — incorporate feedback from users and evolving requirements as planning processes mature. Serve as a key thought partner to other leads across the team on data unlocks & systematic improvements that would future-proof & scale current processes.
  • Partner cross-functionally with data engineering and platform teams to develop a deep understanding of company-wide data tools, taxonomies, ontologies & best practices.
  • Facilitate documentation and knowledge transfer so architecture decisions, dependencies, assumptions, and best practices remain accessible and durable.
  • Continuously improve how the team plans, tracks, and communicates its work while adapting quickly to changing business priorities.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years work experience in technical operating roles, working on user-facing processes and applications
  • Engineering fundamentals - Computer Science, Engineering, Analytics Engineering or similar background
  • You're intellectually curious about the intersection of analytics & business, and are motivated by Anduril's mission
  • You're energized by business impact & a self-starter: you'd rather build an imperfect solution quickly that is used by many people than a perfect solution that collects dust
  • Coding experience - used python, SQL, react, typescript or equivalent
  • Data system exposure: dbt, Redshift, Looker/Tableau, Palantir Foundry
  • Must be a US Person as defined by ITAR (22 CFR §120.62) — US citizens, US nationals, lawful permanent residents, or individuals granted asylum/refugee status
US Salary Range
$145,000—$185,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit .

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

title: Aircraft Technician UAE, Omen
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Team

Omen is Anduril’s hover-to-cruise autonomous air vehicle (AAV) that packs the endurance, payload, and mission flexibility of much larger airplanes into a novel runway-independent Group 3 platform. Omen can operate from ship decks, beaches, or remote island clearings, providing true runway independence and freedom of maneuver across defense and civilian domains. Omen is the first tail-sitter aircraft with a mass-production contract, with an order of 50 systems representing a decisive investment that anchors production and accelerates the development of future systems.

You will work on new aircraft development in a lean, high-ownership culture where you directly shape the product and operate at a velocity to fly new designs within months, not years.

This role is part of the new Omen flight test team in the UAE. The team runs Omen ground and flight testing in the UAE alongside our U.S. flight test team, using the same aircraft configuration, procedures and test plans, and works closely with our UAE partners.

About the Job

We are seeking an Aircraft Technician to join the Omen flight test team in Abu Dhabi, UAE. In this role, you will play a critical part in the hands-on build, preparation and maintenance of our test aircraft, with a central focus on structures alongside broader vehicle integration. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to assemble, inspect, and troubleshoot hardware in a fast-paced flight test setting. Your versatility and attention to detail will directly ensure the quality, safety, and flight-readiness of our novel platform.

You will report to the Omen Systems Engineering, Integration and Test (SEIT) Lead in the UAE, work closely with the Omen SEIT Lead in the U.S., and support the Test Director during test activities.

You will be based in Abu Dhabi and travel regularly within the UAE, mainly to our remote test range (long days and early starts, with overnight stays when needed). Before flight testing starts in the UAE, you will spend an extended period in the United States (expected to be several months) training with the Omen flight test team at our Costa Mesa headquarters and U.S. test sites during the first prototype flight campaign. Expect further U.S. trips after that.

What You’ll Do

  • Review blueprints and instructions
  • Trim and finish each composite piece
  • Inspect components to ensure they meet specifications
  • Maintain equipment and tools
  • Document your work according to company guidelines
  • Follow all safety protocols
  • Prepare aircraft for flight: pre-flight and post-flight inspections, servicing (fuel, batteries, fluids) and ground handling to and from the launch area
  • Keep accurate ‘as maintained’ records so the UAE aircraft stay in the same configuration as the U.S. aircraft, and download flight data and logs after each flight
  • Pack, ship, receive and inventory aircraft, spares and test equipment moving between the U.S. and the UAE
  • Work on high voltage systems only after Anduril high voltage training, and always with a second person present when systems are energized

Required Qualifications

  • 1+ years of experience working in a manufacturing setting (aerospace, electronics, or medical industry is preferred) performing mechanical and/or electrical assemblies
  • Proficient with common hand tools and power tools such as pliers, wrenches, screwdrivers, depth micrometers, calipers, dial indicators, pressure gauges, multimeters, test boxes or specialized test equipment
  • Proficient with computer use (standard browser, word processing applications)
  • Able to read wiring diagrams and follow assembly instructions
  • Ability to rapidly change roles and responsibilities while working in a high-paced, challenging work environment
  • Ability to effectively communicate (verbal and written) with engineering and production
  • This role requires access to U.S. export-controlled technology. Eligibility depends on your citizenship(s) and will be confirmed before an offer is made; you may be asked to sign an export compliance statement
  • Able to pass Anduril pre-employment screening and the UAE security checks needed for access to military test ranges and partner sites
  • Right to work in the UAE, or able to obtain a UAE residence visa sponsored by Anduril
  • Valid passport and able to obtain U.S. visas for extended stays (Anduril will support the visa process)
  • Valid UAE driver’s license, or able to obtain one shortly after joining
  • Able to work outdoors in extreme heat and humidity in desert and coastal conditions, wearing the required PPE
  • Able to work early starts, some evenings and some weekends when range time or calls with U.S. teams (11 to 12 hours behind the UAE) require it
  • Fluent spoken and written English

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in an R&D setting
  • Demonstrated experience with many aspects of aircraft or ground systems fabrication, repair, assembly, and operation including structural fabrication, integration, composites fabrication, and avionics build/integration/test
  • Mechanically assemble complex electro-mechanical assemblies, high quality wire harnesses, test racks, junction boxes, and associated components involving hand soldering and component fabrication
  • Perform validation and testing of various electronic components using equipment such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, network analyzers, and test racks
  • Experience with common air-frame construction techniques such as rivets, mechanical fasteners, nut plates, etc.
  • Prior hands-on experience with kit, model, or experimental aircraft builds
  • Electronic box assembly troubleshooting, and writing detailed issue tickets for failures
  • Running functional checkouts and tests, and diagnosing issues discovered during these processes
  • PCBA integration and troubleshooting
  • Basic understanding of LEAN manufacturing principles
  • Holds an Airframe and Powerplant (A&P) license, a UAE GCAA (CAR-66) or EASA Part-66 aircraft maintenance license, or has similar training
  • Forklift certification
  • Experience maintaining military aircraft or UAS (for example with the UAE Armed Forces or an allied air force)
  • IPC J-STD-001 (soldering) or IPC/WHMA-A-620 (cable and wire harness) certification
  • Experience shipping lithium batteries and other dangerous goods
  • Arabic language skills

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

title: Senior ServiceNow  ITSM Developer (Dutch speaking)
description:
Voor een toonaangevende organisatie in Nederland zijn wij op zoek naar een Senior ServiceNow ITSM Developer met een sterke focus op digitale transformatie en platform optimalisatie.

In deze rol ondersteunt en adviseert de consultant de klant bij de verdere uitrol en strategische doorontwikkeling van het ServiceNow-platform. ServiceNow vormt een essentieel onderdeel van de organisatie en wordt organisatiebreed gebruikt via het IT- en HR-portaal, waardoor efficiëntie, gebruikerservaring en standaardisatie centraal staan.

Onze klant werkt op basis van een heldere visie en roadmap voor het ServiceNow-platform. Binnen het Center of Excellence (CoE) wordt gewerkt aan innovatie, optimalisatie en beheer van het platform. De ServiceNow Senior ITSM Developer speelt hierin een sleutelrol en levert een directe bijdrage aan het realiseren van bedrijfsdoelstellingen.

Als senior developer werk je nauw samen samen met stakeholders, functionele teams en andere ServiceNow-specialisten en fungeert als trusted advisor op het gebied van platform architectuur, best practices en continue verbetering. Met behulp van ServiceNow wordt de digitale transformatie van de organisatie versneld en toekomstbestendig ingericht.

De kerntaken van deze rol:

  • De ServiceNow Senior ITSM Developer ontwerpt en implementeert workflows, integraties, meldingen en flow automatisering.

  • Werkt samen met stakeholders gedurende implementatie, technische inzichten te bieden en ervoor te zorgen dat de functionaliteiten voldoen aan de business behoeften.

  • Ondersteunt implementatie via Source Control, update sets en CI/CD- pipelines, en zorgt voor soepele overgangen van ontwikkeling naar productie.

  • De senior developer levert een actieve bijdrage aan het formuleren van de visie, met gebruikmaking van ervaring opgedaan bij andere klanten en de mogelijkheden die ServiceNow-technieken bieden.

Benodigde kennis en ervaring:

  • 8+ jaar ervaring met het ServiceNow-platform, met een sterke specialisatie in ITSM en Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM)

  • Aantoonbare ervaring in het implementeren van ServiceNow

  • Ruime ervaring met integraties, waaronder Service Connector/APIM, CMDB, Platform Core en Service Workflows, aangevuld met diepgaande scripting-expertise.

  • Gedegen kennis van Configuration Management, Application Portfolio Management, widgets (basis en geavanceerd), IT Operations Management (basis en geavanceerd), IRM/SecOps, HRSD en TPRM.

  • Beschikt over sterke mentorvaardigheden, thought leadership en uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden

  • ServiceNow-certificeringen (zoals CIS-ITSM) vormen een duidelijke meerwaarde

  • Ervaring met Agile werken, een proactieve en resultaatgerichte houding en uitgebreide scriptingkennis.

  • Vloeiend Nederlands (moedertaal)

Over ons:
The Cloud People is een van Europa’s grootste onafhankelijke ServiceNow Elite Partners. Daarnaast zijn wij erkend als een van de weinige ServiceNow ServiceOps- en Customer Experience Specialization Partners in de EMEA-region.

The Cloud People beschikt over een team van meer dan 350 gecertificeerde ServiceNow-consultants, en ondersteunt meer dan 150 klanten in uiteenlopende sectoren. Wij bieden een breed scala aan diensten rondom het ServiceNow-platform, variërend van consultancy en implementatie, tot migratie en managed services.

Als onderdeel van NTT Data Business Solutions (NDBS), een wereldwijde technologieleider die hoogwaardige IT-diensten en innovatie levert in meer dan 80 landen, heeft TCP toegang tot nog eens 1.000 toegewijde ServiceNow-consultants om onze missie te realiseren: klanten succesvol maken met ServiceNow als motor voor Digitale Bedrijfstransformatie.

Met het uitgebreide bereik van NTT DATA binnen grote ondernemingen en de bewezen capaciteit om complexe transformatieprogramma’s te realiseren, gecombineerd met TCP als speerpunt in hun ServiceNow-groeistrategie, beschikken wij over een uniek krachtige marktpropositie en uitzonderlijke toegang tot enterprise-klanten in heel Europa.

Onze unieke cultuur gebaseerd op de 4F’s (Fun, Focus, Fair, Future) is de sleutel tot ons succes: wij geloven oprecht dat werk leuk moet zijn, zodat mensen optimaal kunnen presteren.

Wat wij bieden:

  • Een aantrekkelijk salaris, inclusief pensioenregeling en mobiliteitsvergoeding

  • Een hybride werkmodel voor werken op locatie en op afstand, klant wil graag dat voor deze functie de consultant twee dagen / week op een centrale locatie in het land werkt

  • Een energieke werkomgeving met veel sociale activiteiten

  • Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling, waaronder trainingen en certificeringen

  • Een bring your own device-beleid met bijbehorende vergoeding

  • 25 vakantiedagen

  • Voor contractors gelden er andere vergoedingen, welke wij graag nader willen toelichten


The TCP Cultuur

Deel uitmaken van The Cloud People betekent dat je aansluit bij een enthousiast team waarvan de cultuur is gebouwd op de vier F’s:

Fun: We hebben plezier in ons werk, elke dag, en stimuleren een sociale en inclusieve werkomgeving.

Fair: We hanteren een eerlijk en transparant ontwikkelsysteem dat vaardigheden en kennis beloont en iedereen gelijke kansen biedt om te groeien via opleidingen en certificeringen.

Focus: We richten ons uitsluitend op één toonaangevend platform, ServiceNow, zodat we onze klanten de beste expertise in de markt kunnen bieden en onze consultants diepgaande kennis en expertise kunnen opdoen

Future: Wij geloven dat de werkplek van de toekomst modern, flexibel en eenvoudig is, met ruimte voor creativiteit en minimale tijdsbesteding aan onnodige rapportages.

title: Central Florida Transportation Market Sector Leader
description:
Job Description

Dewberry is seeking a Regional Market Sector Leader in our Orlando, FL office. This is an excellent career opportunity to lead the local growth of an established firm with a strong Transportation design reputation in Florida and nationwide. Dewberry has provided planning and design services to FDOT, municipal agencies, and toll authorities throughout Florida for decades and has a strong backlog of work. The successful candidate will leverage Dewberry’s current capabilities to grow our Orlando team and Central Florida transportation practice, with opportunities to advance into increasingly senior leadership roles.

Dewberry is a leading, market-facing professional services firm with more than 60 locations and 2,500 professionals nationwide. What sets us apart from our competitors is our people. At Dewberry, we seek out exceptional talent and strive to deliver the highest quality of services to our clients. Whether you’re an experienced professional or a new graduate, you’ll have the chance to collaborate with the best and brightest and work on innovative and complex projects at the forefront of the industry. Our commitment to excellence stems from our personal integrity and from other defining attributes, which we call “Dewberry at Work,” that have inspired our employees to be successful for more than a half-century.

Responsibilities

What We Offer

  • A culture that prioritizes our most important asset – our people – and a multi-disciplinary Florida Transportation team of high-performing engineers and professionals who genuinely enjoy working together
  • A long-established Florida transportation practice with successful project histories at agencies across the state, a steady backlog of ongoing projects, and a strong pipeline in place to win future projects
  • The resources of a large firm, such as access to national subject matter experts, the ability to effectively workshare across offices/geographies, and systems/people in place that support our marketing, accounting, and recruiting functions
  • A variety of opportunities – our projects range from major highway widenings & new construction to innovative intersections & interchanges to trails & safety improvements. Our client base is diversified between FDOT, CFX, Counties across the state, and Contractor teams constructing large design-build projects
  • Competitive compensation and benefits packages, numerous formal training programs, and clear opportunities for growth in technical, project management, and organizational management career paths

What You'll Do

  • Become a Leader within our Florida Transportation team by proactively building connections with current Staff in our Jacksonville, Orlando, and Pensacola offices in order to build up our northeast Florida practice
  • Lead project pursuit efforts to win new projects, with support from Marketing Staff, Discipline Leads, and other Project and Client Managers
  • Lead the delivery of complex transportation design projects, working with current Discipline Leads and project teams to prepare deliverables and managing project quality, scopes, schedules, and budgets
  • Expand Dewberry’s presence and reputation in northeast Florida by regularly meeting with clients, representing Dewberry at industry events, making teaming arrangements with other firms, recruiting quality people, and performing other general market-facing activities

Required Skills & Required Experience

What We're Looking For

  • A central Florida Leader who is eager to build on Dewberry’s existing reputation and staff to grow our local team and project portfolio in northeast Florida
  • 20+ years of progressive experience leading transportation projects for FDOT and other agencies in northeast Florida
  • Existing client relationships and familiarity with the organizational structures, staff, project procurement, and project delivery processes of the local FDOT District offices and counties.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or a related field and a Florida Professional Engineer (PE) license

Make an Impact

If you're a transportation leader looking for the opportunity to shape strategy, grow a thriving practice, and deliver impactful infrastructure projects, we'd love to talk with you.

Don’t meet every single requirement? At Dewberry we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace for our employees. So if you’re excited about this role, but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the position description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may just be the right candidate for this or other opportunities.

*At this time, Dewberry will not sponsor a new applicant for work authorization.

*Dewberry is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or sexual orientation.

*Only recipients of an offer of employment from Dewberry, will be required to submit to a background screening which may include, but is not limited to, employment verification, educational and other credential verification, driving record check, criminal background check, and an investigative consumer report. These screenings will be conducted by Dewberry’s background vendor of choice and will be conducted in compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local law.

title: Financial Data Analyst
description:
Caldwell University invites applications for a Financial Data Analyst. Reporting to the Accounting Manager, the Financial Data Analyst will work independently on assigned analyses, and collaboratively with Finance colleagues and other departments. The Financial Data Analyst turns the University’s financial data into reporting, forecasts, and analytical tools that leadership uses to make decisions. The analyst builds and maintains financial models, automated reports, and data-quality checks drawn from the Jenzabar ERP and related systems, while supporting month-end close, daily accounting operations (including journal entries and reconciliations), and audit preparation.

The position applies quantitative methods, database querying, statistical analysis, and programming (SQL, Microsoft Access, advanced Excel) to budgeting, forecasting, analysis, monitoring, and internal-control testing. It also contributes to the University’s financial-systems projects, including the Jenzabar Budget and Purchasing module implementation and future reporting enhancements.


Job duties include but are not limited to:


Financial Modeling, Budgeting and Forecasting

  • Build and maintain financial models for revenue, AR, expenses, and cash flow forecasting using historical data, enrollment metrics, and budget assumptions.

  • Prepare budget-to-actual analyses for departments and the University as a whole; quantify and explain variances.

  • Support the annual budget cycle: compile departmental submissions, validate data, and prepare consolidated budget schedules.

  • Develop analytical reports, dashboards, and visualizations for management review.


Financial Data Analytics and Reporting Automation

  • Extract, clean, and structure financial datasets from Jenzabar and other University systems using SQL, Microsoft Access, and Excel/Power Query.

  • Build and maintain Microsoft Access databases and queries that combine Jenzabar extracts with departmental data for recurring reports and reconciliations.

  • Prepare recurring management reports that track budget performance, cash position, and key financial indicators.

  • Apply statistical and quantitative techniques to identify trends, outliers, and relationships in financial data.

  • Automate recurring reports and reconciliations using SQL and advanced Excel to reduce manual processing time and error rates.


Financial Systems and Data Integrity

  • Develop standardized reporting templates and analytical tools for the Finance Office and campus budget managers.


Transaction Analytics and Internal Controls

  • Analyze monthly University credit-card activity across departments and cardholders for accuracy, coding, documentation, and policy compliance.

  • Prepare monthly transaction analysis reports for Finance and departmental management, recommending control improvements where appropriate.


Accounting Operations and Reconciliations

  • Record day-to-day accounting transactions in Jenzabar as assigned, ensuring complete supporting documentation.

  • Perform monthly bank reconciliations and reconcile assigned funds, endowment, investment, and departmental accounts to the general ledger.

  • Prepare journal entries, accruals, and account adjustments for month-end and year-end close.

  • Maintain assigned subsidiary schedules (prepaid expenses, accruals, receivables, and fixed assets) and tie them to the general ledger each month.

  • Research and resolve accounting discrepancies within individual ledgers.


Audit Support and Other Duties

  • Prepare reconciliations, schedules, and data extracts for the annual financial statement audit and other external reviews.

  • Respond to financial questions from faculty, staff, and budget managers; maintain strict confidentiality of financial and institutional information.



Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Finance, Accounting, Statistics, or a related quantitative field. Coursework or a concentration in analytics is required if the degree is in Accounting or Finance. Recent graduates are welcome to apply; internship or student-worker experience in a university business office is a plus. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (pivot tables, Power Query, lookup and array functions, and financial modeling). Working knowledge of SQL and Microsoft Access. Understanding of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and account reconciliation procedures.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with higher-education ERP systems (such as Jenzabar, PeopleSoft, or Workday).

  • Experience with fund, endowment, or non-profit accounting.

  • Experience supporting financial system implementations or reporting enhancement projects.

title: IT Architect
description:

Patria on kansainvälinen puolustusteollisuus- ja teknologiayhtiö, jolla on yli 100 vuoden kokemus alalta. Patrian huippuluokan osaajien ja Protected Mobility, Defence and Weapon Systems ja Sustainment Solutions -liiketoiminta-alueiden avulla varmistamme asiakkaillemme luotettavan toiminnan ja olemme kumppanina kriittisissä toiminnoissa maalla, merellä ja ilmassa – kun kaiken on pakko toimia. Haemme nyt Espooseen henkilöä nimikkeellä

Tietojärjestelmäarkkitehti

toimimaan osana Patrian IT osastoa – tule rakentamaan turvallista ja modernia verkko-infraa!

Etsimme kokenutta tietojärjestelmäarkkitehtia, jonka vastuulla on itse asennettavien paikallisverkkojen perusratkaisujen määrittely, suunnittelu ja arkkitehtuurityö. Tehtävässä pääset vaikuttamaan kriittisten järjestelmien turvallisuuteen, skaalautuvuuteen ja toimintavarmuuteen.

Tietojärjestelmäarkkitehtina vastaat:

  • Ratkaisujen suunnittelusta ja määrittelystä yhteistyössä eri sidosryhmien kanssa

  • Modernin on-premises IT-infran kehittämisestä

  • Multitenant-ympäristöjen roolipohjaisesta suunnittelusta ja käyttötapausten hallinnan kehittämisestä

Etsimme useamman vuoden kokemuksen omaavaa tietojärjestelmien ammattilaista, jolla on silmää kokonaisuudelle. Sinulla on näkemystä parhaista ratkaisuista niin tekniseltä osalta kuin palvelun kannalta. Toimit tiiviissä yhteistyössä muun tiimin kanssa suunnitellen parhaita ratkaisuja asiakkaillemme.

Odotamme sinulta

  • Soveltuvaa korkeakoulutusta (esim. tietotekniikka, kyberturvallisuus)

  • Seuraavien osa-alueiden hallintaa:

    • Zero-trust-ajattelumallin soveltaminen

    • Multitenant-ratkaisujen vaatimusten ymmärrys ja toteutus. Asiakkuuksien erottaminen toisistaan hallitusti

    • Kokemusta Geohajautettujen palveluiden suunnittelusta ja toteutuksesta

    • Prosessien kehittäminen ja tukeminen osana IT-palveluita, tiedät mikä SLA ja OLA on.

    • Asiakaslähtöistä ajattelutapaa

    • Suunnittelu- ja toteutusdokumentaation tuottaminen

    • Tietoturvakehikot, esimerkiksi Katakri, CIS ja ISO27000

Mitä tarjoamme

Meillä Patriassa pääset tekemään sellaista, mitä muualla et pääse edes näkemään. Sinulla on mahdollisuus pitkään ja monipuoliseen työuraan Patrian ainutlaatuisten tuotteiden ja toimintojen parissa. Pääset mukaan osaksi hyvähenkistä kokeneista ammattilaista koostuvaa tiimiämme.

Haluaisitko olla osa tarinaamme?

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Marja Salminen, ext-marja.salminen@patriagroup.com.

Miksi Patria?
