4. Mahtava porukka: meillä teet työtä uudistuvassa ja energisessä työyhteisössä, jossa on hymy herkässä. Uskomme, että parhaat tulokset syntyvät hyvässä ilmapiirissä

title: Logistics Coordinator
description:
Get to know The Pokémon Company International

The Pokémon Company International manages the Pokémon property outside of Asia and is responsible for brand management, licensing and marketing, the Pokémon Trading Card Game, the animated TV series, home entertainment, and the official Pokémon website. Pokémon was launched in Japan in 1996 and today is one of the most popular children’s entertainment properties in the world.

Learn more online at and .

Get to know the role

  • Job Title: Logistics Analyst
  • Job Summary: Enhances product workflow by analyzing and developing logistics plans that affect production, distribution, and inventory.
  • FLSA Classification (US Only): Exempt
  • People Manager: No

What you’ll do

  • Analyze inbound and outbound transportation performance, identify recurring logistics risks and service failures, conduct root-cause analyses, and develop recommendations to improve carrier performance, service levels, and operational efficiency for review by supply chain leadership.
  • Evaluate transportation exceptions and disruptions, assess operational and customer impacts, and recommend corrective actions or process improvements to mitigate future risks.
  • Analyze shipment and transportation data within enterprise systems to identify trends, support operational decision-making, and ensure the integrity of logistics performance data
  • Analyze transportation, inventory, and fulfillment data to identify operational risks, evaluate alternatives, and provide recommendations supporting logistics planning and supply chain objectives.
  • Develop and interpret logistics performance metrics, dashboards, and operational analyses to provide insights and recommendations to business stakeholders.
  • Evaluate transportation requirements, carrier capacity constraints, service alternatives, and delivery timelines to support logistics planning and operational decision-making
  • Partner with Supply Chain, Customer, Sales, Finance, and Operations teams to assess logistics requirements, identify operational challenges, and recommend solutions supporting business objectives.
  • Evaluate customer and retail partner logistics requirements and recommend process adjustments necessary to meet service, compliance, and operational objectives.
  • Evaluate transportation performance, cost, and service trends and exercise independent judgment in recommending operational improvements that enhance service levels, reduce costs, and mitigate supply chain risk.

What you’ll bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • 1-2 years of professional experience in logistics, transportation, supply chain, operations, or related analytical roles.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret operational data and identify trends.
  • Experience using Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, lookups, and data analysis tools, to create reports, analyze performance metrics, and identify operational trends.
  • Ability to organize and prioritize multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present findings and recommendations clearly.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to validate data accuracy, identify discrepancies, and support data-driven decision-making
  • Experience using Oracle ERP, Transportation Management Systems (TMS), Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), or similar logistics and supply chain technology platforms
  • Ability to work collaboratively across multiple functions and support cross-functional planning activities.
  • Experience supporting supply chain planning, transportation operations, or process improvement initiatives.

Base Salary Range: For this role, new hires generally start between $80,000 – $89,000 per year. The full range is $80,000.00 - $132,000 per year. This range is applicable for the labor market where the role is intended to be hired. The final base salary is directly related to the candidate’s qualifications and professional experience uniquely.

#LI-HYBRID #LI-AD1

How you’ll be successful

  • Passion for Pokémon: Develops an understanding of the Pokémon brand, the impact it has on our people, culture, business, fans, and communities, and applying that knowledge and passion to everything you do.
  • Challenging the Expected: Approaches challenges with curiosity and creativity, embracing the possibility of failure as an opportunity to learn something new, develop innovative ideas, solve complex problems and identify unique opportunities.
  • Integrity and Respect: Demonstrates integrity and respect by leading with empathy, listening to others, seeking out different perspectives, and taking personal responsibility for decisions, actions, and results.
  • Dedicated to Quality: Takes ownership to maintain and promote high standards, looks for new ways to learn and improve, and embraces a growth mindset to seek and apply feedback from others in an effort to continuously improve.
  • Building Relationships: Develops and strengthens relationships, adopting a “team first” mentality and working collaboratively to solve problems and meet shared goals.
  • Delighting Customers: Listens and understands the interests and needs of our customers and stakeholders, making them feel heard and important, and embracing these learnings to continue delivering a unique Pokémon experience.

What to expect

  • An innovative culture driven by impact, delivering meaningful outcomes.
  • Company events that celebrate the spirit of Pokémon.
  • Competitive cash-based compensation programs.
  • 100% employer-paid healthcare premiums for you.
  • Generous paid family leave.
  • Employer-paid life insurance.
  • Employer-paid long and short-term income protection insurance.
  • US Employees: 401k Employer Matching.
  • UK/IRE/MX Employees: Pension Employer Contributions.
  • Fitness reimbursement.
  • Commuter benefit.
  • LinkedIn learning.
  • Comprehensive relocation package for certain roles.
  • Hybrid work environment.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this role. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Employees may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities from time to time, as needed. For roles in the United Kingdom, candidates will need the right to work. In some cases, and for some roles, the Company may be able to arrange a visa. For roles in Ireland, this role requires candidates to have the right to live and work in the Republic of Ireland. However, we welcome applications from all nationalities and may consider supporting an employment permit application, in appropriate and suitable cases.

The Pokémon Company International is committed to the inclusion of all qualified applicants for consideration in our job application process. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre-employment testing, or a job interview, or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact the Talent Acquisition team at accommodationrequest_ta@pokemon.com.

title: Loan Advisor
description:
Position Summary
The Loan Advisor is responsible for guiding homebuyers through the mortgage process while promoting Universal Lending Corporation’s full suite of loan products. Serving as a key lending partner to buyers of Risewell Homes, this role focuses on relationship-building, exceptional customer service, and ensuring a smooth experience from application through closing.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Build Rapport

  • Build rapport with the sales agents at Risewell communities and division personnel.
  • Maintain a positive sales environment by educating potential borrowers and Homebuilder sales representatives on the Company’s products and services


Loan Applications

  • Complete thorough loan applications by communicating with perspective applicants
  • Obtain specified information relating to the loan or credit application
  • Correspond with applicant via telephone, email or in-person to resolve any questions regarding application information


Prequalification

  • Perform prequalification assessment and analysis of financial condition and risk of financing requests within the Company’s credit policies and programs, as well as all state and federal lending regulations (FHA, VA, Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, Conventional, Conforming, Jumbo, Rural Housing Development, Bond and Portfolio)


Loan Submission

  • Negotiate rate, terms and conditions of the loan.
  • Lock loans on time and in the correct product type.
  • Submit complete loan application, including all required documents and disclosures, and coordinate the process with assigned processing center.
  • Input loans into Encompass and appropriate Automated Underwriting System (AUS), such as DU or LP, for underwriting decision


Processing Issues

  • Assist with, and solve, issues relating to processing, underwriting and closing of loans within employee’s loan pipeline


Industry Knowledge

  • Develop and maintain knowledge of the financial industry, economy, market conditions, rates, vendors and competition


Compliance

  • Maintain compliance on all loan files and pipeline.
  • Consistently apply superior decision-making techniques relating to applicant inquiries, approvals, and requests as they pertain to existing policies, regulations and procedures


Personal Professional Standards

  • Project an image of professionalism through demeanor and appearance while acting with integrity and honesty
  • Strive for teamwork and cooperation and actively participate in goals for self-improvement.


Key Qualifications

  • Must have an active state MLO license in each state where business is to be conducted or be willing to obtain additional state licenses in WA, OR, CA, AZ, CO, FL and TX
  • Highschool diploma or general education degree (GED) required; 4-year college degree preferred
  • Minimum 5 years lending origination experience preferably with builders
  • Must have working knowledge of Encompass or other LOS systems
  • Proficient in Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint
  • Ability to plan for contingencies and anticipate problems and identify risks
  • Ability to negotiate to produce positive outcomes
  • Ability to effectively listen and respond to customers’ needs
  • Ability to display superior customer service skills
  • Ability to exhibit professional written and verbal communication
  • Ability to maintain and foster strong partnerships with builders and customers
  • Ability to ensure customer satisfaction throughout the cycle of the sales process with support and service
  • Ability to identify customer needs and adapt sales presentations effectively


Licensing Requirements:

  • Candidates must be eligible for licensure under the federal SAFE Act § 1008.105 in each state where ULC originates loans. Eligibility requirements include:
  • Never having had a loan originator license revoked in any jurisdiction unless revocation was formally vacated;
  • Never having been convicted of, plead guilty or nolo contendere to a felony;
    • If expunged or pardoned, this may still impact the ability to be licensed in some states.
  • Demonstrating financial responsibility, character and fitness, such as to command the confidence of the community.
    • Examples of issues that can impact eligibility include: poor credit history; arrests; outstanding child support or alimony payments; unpaid judgments, etc.


Physical Requirements:

This is primarily a sedentary position. Requires the ability to hear, type and talk. Finger dexterity is required to operate a computer keyboard. The primary work location is a corporate office with low to moderate noise levels.

The physical demands and work environment characteristics described are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.


Supervisory Responsibility:

This position does not supervise other employees.


Travel Requirements:

Occasional travel may be required. A valid driver’s license and active vehicle insurance is required at all times.


FLSA Classification: Non-Exempt


Disclaimer:
Universal Lending Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. The statements above are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals assigned to this role. Management retains the discretion to add, modify, or remove job duties at any time.

title: Growth Officer
description:
We are looking for an entrepreneurial, execution-driven Growth Officer (GO) to own end-to-end commercial expansion, revenue generation, and global go-to-market (GTM) execution. You will partner directly with the CEO, CTO, and engineering teams to turn our sovereign AI, custom ai & non-ai applications, guardrail frameworks, and enterprise platforms into predictable recurring revenue across key verticals and international markets.

Key Responsibilities

Revenue Generation & Sales Execution

• Pipeline & Quota Ownership: Own end-to-end revenue targets, forecasting, and pipeline generation across enterprise outbound, inbound, and partner-led sales channels.

• Enterprise Sales Leadership: Lead consultative B2B sales cycles for complex AI deployments—from initial discovery and 60-day Proof-of-Concept (PoC) scoping to security/compliance reviews and executive contract negotiations.

• Sales Playbooks & Enablement: Build repeatable sales playbooks, ROI calculators, and objection-handling frameworks tailored to regulated buyers (addressing HIPAA/compliance, data sovereignty, model accuracy, and legacy system integration).

• Pricing, Packaging & Deal Structuring: Architect scalable commercial models across SaaS subscriptions, usage-based AI tiers, and custom enterprise deployments to maximize Average Contract Value (ACV) and gross margin.

• Account Expansion & Upsell: Partner with delivery and customer success teams to convert pilot deployments into multi-year enterprise contracts and expand adoption across new business units.

Qualifications & Experience

• Proven Track Record: 8–12+ years in growth leadership, enterprise B2B sales, revenue leadership, or GTM strategy within AI, enterprise SaaS, cloud infrastructure, or digital transformation firms.

• Product-to-Market Translation: Collaborate with the CTO and AI engineering teams to translate technical capabilities (Sovereign RAG, Multi-Agent Systems, Guardrail Frameworks) into clear, business-outcome messaging.
• Demand Generation & Brand Positioning: Oversee B2B demand generation, thought leadership, enterprise case studies, and executive events that position Gaude as a trusted leader in governed AI.
• Growth Operations & Analytics: Track and optimize full-funnel metrics—including pipeline velocity, CAC, LTV, PoC-to-production conversion rate, and Net Revenue Retention (NRR)

title: Vendor Performance Manager
description:
About SimpliSafe

We’re a high-tech home security company that’s passionate about protecting the life you’ve built and our mission of keeping Every Home Secure. And we’ve created a culture here that cares just as deeply about the career you’re building. Ours is a no ego culture of collaboration and innovation where those seeking their next challenge can find big opportunities and make a huge impact on the lives of all those who we protect. We don’t just want you to work here. We want you to grow and thrive here.

We’re embracing a hybrid work model that enables our teams to split their time between office and home. Hybrid for us means we expect our teams to come together in our office on two core days, typically Tuesday, Wednesday or Thursday, to work together in person, and teams can choose where they work for the remainder of the week. We all benefit from flexibility and get to use the best of both worlds to get our work done.

Why are we hiring?

Well, we’re growing and thriving. So, we need smart, talented, and humble people who share our values to join us as we disrupt the home security space and relentlessly pursue our mission of keeping Every Home Secure.

About the Role

As the Vendor Performance Manager, you’ll independently manage day-to-day BPO performance governance, analyzing partner performance, identifying vendor-specific gaps, challenging root-cause assessments, and driving corrective actions through resolution. You’ll lead recurring partner governance activities, monitor contractual commitments, and prepare executive performance reviews in partnership with LOB leaders, Operations Analysts, WFM, Data & Analytics, and Finance. Reporting to the Director, Vendor Strategy & Governance, you’ll drive partner accountability while escalating material strategic, commercial, and contractual risks.

Here’s What You’ll Do:

  • Lead Partner Governance: Independently lead day-to-day BPO performance governance within the framework established by the Director, driving partner accountability and cross-functional follow-through. Lead weekly partner performance reviews and operational syncs with partner relationship and operations managers, and prepare monthly and quarterly business reviews and enterprise scorecard materials for the Director to lead.
  • Analyze Vendor Performance: Independently analyze BPO performance using standardized Data & Analytics reporting, the partner-produced Daily Partner Health Report, and partner inputs to identify performance gaps, emerging risks, and improvement opportunities. Challenge partner root-cause assessments, recommend targeted corrective actions, and prepare vendor-specific performance analysis and scorecards for leadership reviews, including inputs to the Director’s enterprise scorecard review.
  • Track Contractual Performance: Monitor partner performance against SOW service levels, maintain penalty and credit trackers, and run the monthly Tech and Loyalty invoice validation cycle and coordinate reconciliations for Director review and decision.
  • Drive Partner Recovery and Accountability: Partner with BPO operations leaders to develop and execute performance recovery plans, challenge proposed corrective actions, and monitor progress against agreed milestones. Drive accountability through resolution, escalating persistent performance gaps or material risks to the Director.
  • Identify and Escalate Partner Risks: Evaluate performance trends, recurring operational gaps, and contractual exposure; partner with LOB owners and BPO operations leaders on corrective actions; and escalate material performance, contractual, or commercial risks to the Director.
  • Support Onboarding and Transitions: Maintain onboarding and offboarding trackers and coordinate readiness and hypercare follow-through with partners.
  • Partner Across Teams: Work with LOB leaders, operations analysts, WFM, Data & Analytics, and Finance on vendor data and commitments, while LOB leaders retain accountability for operational outcomes.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 5+ years in vendor management, BPO or contact center operations, or operations program management, with experience holding outsourced partners to SLAs and contractual commitments. Demonstrated experience independently managing complex, cross-functional programs, influencing senior stakeholders, and driving measurable partner performance improvements.
  • Contract Fluency: Working knowledge of SOW mechanics such as service levels, penalties, credits, and change control.
  • Analytical Skills: Independently analyzes vendor performance, identifies trends and root causes, validates scorecards, and translates insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Influence Without Authority: Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to drive accountability across LOB leaders, operations teams, and partner leadership.
  • Inclusivity and Team Spirit: A commitment to fostering an inclusive environment, respecting differences, and encouraging collaboration among team members.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with offshore or nearshore BPO partners across multiple sites and time zones.
  • Familiarity with contact center metrics such as SLA, AHT, attendance and adherence, and quality, and with invoice reconciliation against contract terms.

What Values You’ll Share

  • Customer Obsessed - Building deep empathy for our customers, putting them at the core of our work, and developing strong, long-term relationships with them.
  • Aim High - Always challenging ourselves and others to raise the bar.
  • No Ego - Maintaining a “no job too small” attitude, and an open, inclusive and humble style.
  • One Team - Taking a highly collaborative approach to achieving success.
  • Lift As We Climb - Investing in developing others and helping others around us succeed.
  • Lean & Nimble - Working with agility and efficiency to experiment in an often ambiguous environment.

What We Offer

  • A mission- and values-driven culture and a safe, inclusive environment where you can build, grow and thrive
  • A comprehensive total rewards package that supports your wellness and provides security for SimpliSafers and their families (For more information on our total rewards please click here)
  • Free SimpliSafe system and professional monitoring for your home.
  • Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that bring people together, give opportunities to network, mentor and develop, and advocate for change.

The target annual base pay range for this role is $91,200 to $121,600

This target annual base pay range represents our good-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this role. We use a market-based compensation approach to set our target annual base pay ranges and make adjustments annually. We carefully tailor individual compensation packages, including base pay, taking into consideration employees’ job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and other relevant business factors.

Beyond base pay, we offer a Total Rewards package that may include participation in our annual bonus program, equity, and other forms of compensation, in addition to a full range of medical, retirement, and lifestyle benefits. More details can be found here.

We’re committed to fair and equitable pay practices, as well as pay transparency. We regularly review our programs to ensure they remain competitive and aligned with our values.

We wholeheartedly embrace and actively seek applications from all individuals, no matter how they identify. We are committed to cultivating a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we believe our work is enriched when we incorporate a multitude of perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences. We want everyone who works here to thrive and contribute to not only our mission of keeping every home secure, but also to making our workplace safe and supportive for others. If a reasonable accommodation may be needed to fully participate in the job application or interview process, to perform the essential functions of a position, or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact careers@simplisafe.com.

title: Detailer (flat rate) -540290 - Huntsville AL
description:
Overview

Flat Rate Detail Shop Position(s) Available.

Are you a team player who is focused on providing exemplary customer service and who performs well in a fast paced work environment?

Looking for the following position:

Detail Specialist 1 - Some experience

Detail Specialist 2 - 2 plus years experience

Maintain the facilities of the store to produce high quality service. Ensure customers are serviced at the highest level of satisfaction through quality service/products, courteous employees and quick response to all customer inquiries and/or complaints establishing conclusions in a timely manner. Driving, detailing, and cleaning vehicles.

Teph Seal Auto Appearance, a privately-held company, operates detail/reconditioning centers in auto dealerships across the United States. Our strong team of dedicated professionals is our most powerful asset, allowing us to develop dynamic detail solutions for a wide variety of auto dealerships. Our culture of challenging the status quo makes each employee a key contributor to our success and a vital part of our thriving entrepreneurial-minded company culture.

Responsibilities

The detailer will use their manual dexterity and bodily coordination to perform an array of tasks, including washing the exterior of vehicles using various cleaning solutions, may also wax and buff vehicles using cloths and buffing machines, vacuum interior of automobiles to remove dirt and debris, clean upholstery and surfaces, use air compressors and cloths to dry surfaces and apply preservation chemicals to surfaces for protection against spots and stains. May be required to use different types of dyes, paints and waxes to protect the leather or fabric of vehicles. May also be required to clean and remove grease on engines or engine compartments. Must be flexible and willing able to carry out additional duties as assigned by management due to operational needs.

Working Conditions:

  • This physically demanding position requires frequent movement; i.e. bending, lifting, reaching, squatting, and getting into and out of various vehicles repeatedly during the work shift.
  • May require completion of work outdoors and under varying climate conditions.
  • Will work with and move numerous vehicles during the course of the working day.
  • Use of safe and OSHA approved waxes and cleaners such as, window cleaner, tar remover, tire shine, etc.
  • Frequent and continual flexing of spine, hands, wrists and fingers.
  • Occasional pushing, pulling, lifting, or carrying of up to 50 lbs.
  • Constantly receiving detailed information through oral communication.
  • Clarity of vision and hearing.
  • Ability to distinguish small imperfections in your work, such as, streaks left on windows, smudges on windows or painted surfaces, areas of missed vacuuming, etc.
  • Ability to quality inspect your work as well as that of other team members.
  • Work with a sense of urgency that demonstrates the value we place on our customers' time.

  • Strict adherence to our uniform and grooming standards.

Compensation: FLAT RATE

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have

  • A valid driver's license and a good driving record.
  • Ability to learn quickly.
  • Ability to work as part of a team.
  • Ability to read and comprehend instructions

  • Desire to treat each customer’s personal vehicle with great care and respect

  • The willingness to come to work on time and stay on task when on the clock

  • The ability to drive both automatic and manual shift vehicles

  • The availability to work Saturday or Sunday and holidays as deemed necessary to meet production needs
  • Commitment to report to work on time and stay on task during shift

Teph Seal is a Drug-Free Workplace. All employment is contingent on successful completion of drug and background screening.

We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package and all the tools necessary to be successful. Our offerings include: Medical, Dental, Vision Plans, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off and 401(k) Retirement Plan with company match.

We provide a collaborative work place with growth opportunities for career minded individuals.

title: Maintenance Specialist, Intelligence Systems
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril’s Intelligence Systems team is seeking a Maintenance Specialist to join our team. The Manufacturing Maintenance team is responsible for helping scale production at Anduril and ensuring maximum equipment uptime, a world class preventative maintenance program, and supporting line commissioning of our growing production landscape.


ABOUT THE JOB

As a Maintenance Specialist, you will be involved in every aspect of the asset lifecycle from commissioning to preventative maintenance, to emergency maintenance, and calibration. The right person for this role has developed experience with automated conveyance technologies, controls and vision systems, torque tools, and more across multiple platforms for a variety of product lines, groups, or businesses and integrated with both internal and external customers. If you are someone who wants to develop innovative, adaptive, flexible, creative approaches to equipment and maintenance and develop unified solutions for lots of stakeholders then this role is for you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Support design, construction, commissioning, and start-up of production systems at new factory sites, ensuring successful delivery of the factory and products off the line.
  • Provide technical feedback on product processes, materials, and technologies to mitigate risks and meet production performance and timelines in new facilities.
  • Work hands-on to expedite project completion under extremely tight timelines.
  • Collaborate with product design, manufacturing engineering, operations, facilities and construction, environmental safety & health, and finance to deliver creative and effective production system solutions.
  • Ensure the operational availability of a wide array of manufacturing equipment by installing, maintaining, and repairing mechanical and electrical systems, torque tools, factory automation, and robotics.
  • Partner with high-caliber controls and equipment engineering teams to improve equipment reliability and minimize or eliminate downtime.
  • Act as first-responding problem solvers, managing machine breakdown recoveries to keep production running.
  • This is a physically demanding job working in tight spaces, requiring walking and standing all day, as well as, bending, squatting, kneeling, climbing ladders, and lying on the ground intermittently throughout the day.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 10+ years of experience setting up, integrating, and troubleshooting automated systems AND/OR torque tools to support processes technology development, manufacturing engineering, and/or production/process engineering
  • Technology development experience in automated equipment, testing, and torque tools
  • Ability to work hands-on in a manufacturing environment, next to operations and manufacturing engineering to understand and optimize the production system.
  • Experience in a startup or fast paced environment with rapidly changing demands and unclear requirements
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance
  • Willing to work assigned shift hours, overtime and weekends as needed.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.
  • Prior work with engineering partners and/or contractors to build, improve or modify automated production systems
  • Process improvement, including justification of return on investment for process or operational changes
  • Application of lean manufacturing and linear flow principles in a production environment
  • Hands on experience with the leading automated torque tool makers and high volume coating, dispensing, and inspection
US Hourly Range
$37.50—$50 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit .

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

title: Software Engineer I-Java/Springboot/SQL
description:
Kick-start your software engineering career as an entry-level Software Engineer I. Be part of a team that is pushing the boundaries of what's possible.

As a Software Engineer I-Java/Springboot/SQL at JPMorgan Chase within the Commercial & Investment Banking's Post-Trade Technology, you are part of an agile team that works to enhance, design, and deliver the software components to the firm’s state-of-the-art technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. As an entry-level member of a software engineering team, you execute basic software solutions through the design, development, and troubleshooting of a single technical area within a business function, while gaining skills and experience to grow within your role.

Job Responsibilities

  • Executes basic software solution design, development, and technical troubleshooting, breaking down routine technical tasks to troubleshoot and solve issues
  • Uses enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to accelerate design comprehension and coding support (e.g., drafting unit tests and documentation), validating outputs and handling data according to sensitivity and security requirements.
  • Writes secure and high-quality code using the syntax of at least one programming language with peer guidance
  • Interprets architecture and design representations as well as nonfunctional requirements to develop secure, stable software against a defined architecture
  • Actively applies automation to reduce manual toil in the Software Development Life Cycle and addresses basic code quality issues
  • Gathers, analyzes, and synthesizes basic data sets in service of technical troubleshooting and generating insights to drive continuous improvements
  • Applies reuse-first, AI-assisted practices within SDLC/toolchain automation to reduce manual toil while maintaining security, resiliency, and traceability/auditability expectations.


Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Baseline knowledge of software, applications and technical processes within a given technical discipline
  • Working knowledge of using enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to support software engineering workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity.
  • Hands-on programming experience in Java and Springboot; experience with Perl or C#/.NET will also be considered.
  • Experience working with MSSQL or other relational databases
  • Experience working in Windows, Linux, and Unix environments, including basic system administration and troubleshooting.
  • Ability to review and validate AI-assisted code and technical recommendations before use, escalating when uncertain and following security and data handling requirements.
  • Ability to work in large, collaborative teams to achieve organizational goals, with a passion to build an inclusive and innovative culture
  • Demonstrated ability to code in one or more languages
  • Understanding of software skills such as business analysis, development, maintenance, and software improvement
  • Proficiency in developmental toolsets


Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Experience with Sybase and Microsoft SQL Server is preferred, including writing queries, managing data, and troubleshooting database issues.
  • Exposure to cloud technologies

title: Investment Banking - DACH ECM - Analyst - London
description:
Join as an Analyst, working alongside top-tier professionals in a fast-moving environment - you'll gain a robust career foundation in financial services through hands-on learning, mentorship, and numerous development opportunities.

Our Equity Capital Markets (ECM) team is responsible for the oversight of origination and execution of a variety of transaction types (including IPOs, rights issues, ABBs/blocks, equity-linked instruments and equity private placements).

As an Investment Banking Analyst within the DACH ECM team, you will assist in preparing origination / marketing materials to pitch new ideas and execute transactions for clients. You will be involved in the ECM coverage effort for a variety of corporate clients across industries. You will work closely together with other corporate finance / capital markets teams within the bank (investment banking coverage & industry teams, mergers and acquisitions, debt capital markets, acquisition & leveraged finance and equity derivatives).

Joining here means you’ll become part of our inclusive teams and culture, unified by the firm’s mission and commitment to success.

Job responsibilities:

As part of the team, you’ll be required to:

  • Take part in origination and execution of ECM transactions led by J.P. Morgan
  • Draft equity market updates to corporate clients on a regular basis leveraging internal and external databases (Bloomberg, Dealogic)
  • Liaise with equity syndicate / research / sales / trading teams in order to gather market intelligence on an ad hoc basis
  • Conduct investor targeting exercises and collect investor feedback using a variety of sources and internal teams (sales / syndicate / research / corporate access)
  • Work together with corporate clients and transaction lawyers
  • Proficiency in German required

Required qualifications, capabilities and skills :

  • Excellent academic credentials
  • Ability to multi-task, organized, rigorous
  • Interest in capital markets and corporate finance
  • Ability to work within a team, in a fast-moving, results-driven environment
  • Ability to effectively interact with sales people and research analysts, as well as corporate clients and other banks as part of working groups on projects
  • Ability to work independently and to take initiative
  • Proficient quantitative and analytical skills, including PowerPoint and Excel skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

This role encompasses the performance of regulated activity. The successful candidate will therefore be subject to meeting regulatory requirements in the assessment of fitness, propriety, knowledge and competence (as assessed by the Firm) and (where appropriate) approval by the relevant regulatory authorities to carry out such activities.

title: Development Regulation Manager
description:
Job Description

Collin County is seeking an experienced civil engineer and leader to serve as Development Regulation Manager. A Development Regulation Manager is responsible for, but not limited to, leading the Engineering Department’s Development Regulation function and overseeing the review and inspection of development within the County’s jurisdiction. The Development Regulations Manager supervises a multidisciplinary team responsible for reviewing subdivision plats, development and permit plans, drainage and floodplain studies, and related development applications. The position provides technical leadership on complex development issues and works closely with developers, consulting engineers, surveyors, contractors, County departments, governmental agencies, and the public. Work is performed under the direction of the Assistant Director III.


Primary Functions

  • Lead engineers and inspectors responsible for development regulation.
  • Manage and continuously improve the County’s development review and inspection processes.
  • Oversee reviews of subdivision plats, development plans, permit applications, drainage and floodplain studies, and other engineering submittals.
  • Provide technical guidance and quality control on complex land development, drainage, floodplain, transportation/access, and construction issues.
  • Oversee development-related inspections and assist with resolution of complex field issues.
  • Coordinate investigation and resolution of drainage, floodplain, and development-related complaints.
  • Meet with developers, engineers, surveyors, contractors, citizens, and governmental agencies to resolve technical and regulatory issues.
  • Lead or assist with updates to County subdivision regulations, engineering standards, policies, procedures, and review criteria.
  • Lead the development, negotiation, coordination, and ongoing management of developer agreements and other development-related agreements.
  • Monitor workloads and review timelines and implement improvements that promote timely, consistent, and high-quality development reviews.
  • Prepare and present reports, recommendations, and agenda items to County management and Commissioners Court.
  • Coordinate with other County departments, municipalities, TxDOT, FEMA, utilities, and other agencies.
  • Provide leadership, training, and professional development to Development Regulation staff.


Minimum Qualifications:

  • Must have a Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline.
  • Must have at least ten (10) years of progressively responsible engineering experience, including at least five (5) years reviewing development plans/plats and three (3) years of supervisory or leadership experience.
  • Must possess and maintain a Texas Professional Engineer license (or ability to obtain Texas licensure within six months if licensed in another state).
  • Must possess and maintain a Certified Floodplain Manager certification or ability to obtain within one (1) year.
  • Must possess and maintain a valid Texas Driver License.


The ideal candidate combines strong civil engineering and land development knowledge with effective leadership and communication skills. This person should be comfortable reviewing complex technical issues while also managing people, processes, priorities, and relationships with the development community and the public.

Candidates should have significant experience with development review and a strong understanding of subdivision development, drainage, floodplain management, engineering plans and specifications, and regulatory compliance.


Workplace and Benefits

Collin County offers a fast-paced working environment, 200% retirement match with employee contributions earning 7% interest, 100% tuition reimbursement, affordable medical, dental, and vision plans, 10 paid holidays annually, 24 days of PTO in your first year of employment with balance rollover from year-to-year, county-provided life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, and other optional participation benefits. You can read more about the comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and long and short term disability on the Collin County website.

You must submit a completed application to be considered for employment. Attaching a resume is not considered an acceptable substitute for a completed application.


COLLIN COUNTY IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

title: Vice President of Financial Planning Analysis
description:
Patriot Mobile is America’s only Christian conservative wireless provider. We offer broad coverage on dependable, nationwide 4G or 5G LTE networks. We are committed to providing our members reliable wireless service and exceptional support while relentlessly fighting for our shared values. Patriot Mobile donates a portion of every dollar earned to support organizations that fight for First Amendment Religious Freedom and Freedom of Speech, Second Amendment Right to Bear Arms, Sanctity of Life, and the needs of our Veterans and First Responders.


Job Overview

The Vice President of Financial Planning & Analysis is a strategic and operationally minded leader who will lead all aspects of corporate financial planning, forecasting, and decision support. This is a key leadership role responsible for driving transparency, performance measurement, and capital allocation across the company. The VP, FP&A will manage a team, partner closely with R&D, operations, and commercial leadership, and serve as a core thought partner to the Chief Financial Officer.


Essential Functions and Responsibilities

  • Lead the company-wide annual operating plan, long-range planning, and rolling forecasts processes.
  • Provide actionable insight through scenario modeling, KPI tracking, and business analytics to support executive decision-making.
  • Partner with R&D and operations to evaluate investments, prioritize resource allocation, assess capital expenditures, and support manufacturing and supply chain planning.
  • Collaborate with the sales team to develop pricing strategies and revenue forecast, including customer-level margin analysis.
  • Provide financial leadership for product development decisions and new business initiatives.
  • Support Board of Directors materials and investor-facing financial commentary in partnership with the CFO and IR.
  • Implement and enhance systems, tools, and processes for improved forecasting accuracy, business intelligence, and financial reporting.
  • Build, mentor, and scale the FP&A function to meet the demands of a fast-growing public company.
  • Ensure integration of planning efforts across departments for alignment with corporate strategy.
  • Support M&A, financing, and strategic initiatives through due diligence, modeling, and valuation support.
  • Manage moderate travel (including international) to support operational sites and key business meetings.


Required Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

  • Expertise in financial planning and analysis (FP&A), including annual operating plans, long-range forecasting, and scenario modeling
  • Proven ability to translate complex financial data into strategic insights that drive executive decision-making.
  • Advanced proficiency in financial modeling, business analytics, and KPI development/tracking.
  • Demonstrated success in budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, and presenting to executive teams and Boards.
  • Hands-on experience implementing or optimizing ERP and BI systems (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, Adaptive).
  • Knowledge of investor relations support and financial narrative development in collaboration with senior leadership.
  • Prior public company experience (ideally at IPO or post-IPO stage) strongly preferred.
  • Proven success in building, mentoring, and scaling high-performing FP&A teams within fast-paced or high-growth environments.
  • Ability to quickly learn, analyze situations, and make decisions which support the mission of Patriot Mobile.

Education and Experience

  • 15+ years of progressive finance experience, including senior-level FP&A leadership roles in public or pre-public technology/manufacturing companies.
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing and operations finance, ideally in a hardware or capital-intensive industry.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field; MBA or CMA preferred.


Physical Requirements

  • Must be able to sit or stand for long periods.
  • Must be able to work in an office environment.
  • Must be able to lift and move items up to 25 pounds.


Patriot Mobile is an equal opportunity at-will employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment based on age, race, religion, color, disability, sex, or national origin.

title: Head of Digital Service Delivery
location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
description:
Role Purpose

The Head of Digital Service Delivery is accountable for the reliability, performance, scalability, and continuous evolution of all digital and technology services across the organization.

This role leads a modern, product-aligned, cloud-native service function designed to operate at the standards of leading global technology companies such as Atlassian and Meta.

The mandate is to design and operate a digital-first service delivery model that is automation-led, AI-enabled, DevOps-driven, and fully aligned to measurable business outcomes.

This is not a traditional IT operations role. It is a platform and reliability leadership role that ensures digital capabilities perform as resilient, high-velocity products serving both internal and external customers.


Key Accountabilities

1. Digital Reliability & Platform Performance

  • Own end-to-end service reliability across enterprise and customer-facing platforms
  • Define and govern Service Level Objectives (SLOs), experience metrics, and performance standards
  • Ensure real-time observability, monitoring, and telemetry across all critical systems
  • Drive automation-first incident detection, response, and remediation
  • Embed resilience, scalability, and security by design

Platforms include:

  • SAP S/4HANA and ERP ecosystems
  • CRM and customer engagement platforms
  • Property, community, and CAFM systems
  • Digital customer channels and data platforms
  • Cloud infrastructure, workplace technologies, and core enterprise services


2. Product-Led Service Operating Model

  • Embed service accountability within digital product teams
  • Implement DevOps and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices
  • Enforce “you build it, you run it” ownership principles
  • Integrate service thinking into product roadmaps from inception
  • Transition from project-based delivery to lifecycle-based product operations


3. AI-Enabled Service Management

  • Implement AI-driven operations (AIOps) for predictive monitoring and incident prevention
  • Deploy intelligent service desk automation and virtual agents
  • Drive automation across change, release, and configuration management
  • Use analytics to continuously optimize performance, cost, and customer experience


4. Transformation & Transition Leadership

  • Own build-to-run transitions for major transformation programs
  • Lead cutover planning, hypercare, and stabilization strategies
  • Ensure operational readiness, runbooks, and monitoring frameworks are established before go-live
  • Drive data-driven post-launch optimization


5. Vendor & Partner Governance

  • Manage system integrators and managed service providers under outcome-based contracts
  • Establish clear performance scorecards and governance frameworks
  • Drive service cost transparency and optimization
  • Ensure partners operate within the organization’s modern digital operating model


6. Service Excellence & Continuous Improvement

  • Promote a culture of accountability, transparency, and blameless postmortems
  • Continuously improve service performance through data and automation
  • Reduce manual effort through workflow orchestration and platform engineering
  • Position service delivery as a strategic enabler of business growth



Leadership & Team

  • Build and lead high-performing digital service teams including platform engineers, SREs, service product owners, and automation specialists
  • Develop capability in cloud-native operations, DevOps tooling, and AI-driven service management
  • Foster collaboration between business stakeholders, product teams, engineering, and operations


Experience & Qualifications

  • 12+ years’ experience in Digital / Technology delivery
  • Senior leadership experience in modern service delivery, DevOps, or platform engineering environments
  • Proven experience managing enterprise platforms (ERP, CRM, cloud ecosystems)
  • Strong vendor and commercial governance expertise
  • Demonstrated experience transforming legacy IT service models into product-led, automation-first operating models
  • Experience embedding AI and advanced analytics into service operations preferred


Success Measures

  • Improved service reliability and reduced mean time to recovery (MTTR)
  • Increased automation rates across incident and change management
  • Transparent SLO dashboards aligned to business KPIs
  • Seamless transition from transformation programs to stable operations
  • Measurable cost optimization without compromising performance

title: Communications Surveillance Product Delivery Manager - Compliance - Vice President
description:
Bring your expertise to JPMorgan Chase. As part of Risk Management and Compliance, you are at the center of keeping JPMorgan Chase strong and resilient. You help the firm grow its business in a responsible way by anticipating new and emerging risks, and using your expert judgement to solve real-world challenges that impact our company, customers and communities. Our culture in Risk Management and Compliance is all about thinking outside the box, challenging the status quo and striving to be best-in-class.

As a Product Delivery Manager Vice President supporting the Compliance, Conduct and Operational Risk organization, you will own and support end-to-end delivery for the Communications Surveillance innovation product portfolio. Your portfolio comprises the firm’s next-generation capabilities for data, risk detection & surveillance alert generation capabilities (rules-based and model-based), alert/case investigation workflows, and agentic AI and other enablement frameworks. You will partner closely with Compliance Surveillance, Technology, Data Science, and other key stakeholders to drive innovation and deliver AI-enabled products through clear use cases, robust governance and controls, and clear articulation of return on investment.

Your role sits at the intersection of traditional delivery discipline, product management, and emerging capabilities enabled by AI. You must keep pace with evolving AI-enabled ways of working, as well as own and drive the adoption of product delivery best practices for the team. As an ideal candidate you will have experience delivering data-intensive platforms and/or risk/compliance solutions, with strong program leadership, stakeholder management, and a practical “get it done” implementation mindset.

Job responsibilities

  • Own the delivery lifecycle for surveillance product capabilities: intake → requirements → design → build → test/validation → release → adoption → post-implementation monitoring. Manage delivery across multiple product modules and workstreams.
  • Drive integrated delivery planning and for follow-on innovation products (scope, milestones, critical path, sequencing, dependencies, resourcing, on-time releases) and maintain clear visibility through execution metrics, RAID logs (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies), and governance routines.
  • Facilitate governance and decision-making forums and ensure timely escalation of delivery trade-offs (timeline vs. scope vs. risk), with decision logs.
  • Partner with Surveillance SMEs and other key stakeholders to define and prioritize objectives across the communications surveillance portfolio, and translate those objectives into actionable epics with clear acceptance criteria, test strategies, and implementation playbooks.
  • Partner with Technology scrum/agility leads across to model strong Jira operating disciplines (backlog health, sprint/release hygiene, etc.), and ensure releases meet quality, control, and documentation expectations.
  • Collaborate with Technology leads on architecture decisions, integration patterns, non-functional requirements, and environment readiness.
  • Work with data owners and Technology on data quality controls, reconciliation, remediation, and observability.
  • Partner with Data Science to operationalize models and tuning processes (calibration, gold-set regression, below-the-line sampling, drift monitoring, performance reporting).
  • Demonstrate hands-on adoption and use of AI tools to accelerate delivery outcomes (rapid prototyping, requirements synthesis, workflow design, documentation acceleration), while maintaining human validation and strong critical thinking.
  • Ensure security, data privacy, and trust/guardrails are treated as delivery requirements in AI-enabled capabilities.
  • Coordinate release readiness and operational handoffs: performance testing, parallel run design and measurement, controls testing, cutover planning, training and change enablement, support model, runbooks/monitoring, and adoption/success metrics.

Required qualifications, capabilities and skills

  • 5+ years experience leading complex cross-functional delivery (multi-team / multi-workstream), with strong program-management discipline (plan, governance, RAID, dependencies, stakeholder management).
  • Demonstrated success delivering complex, cross-functional initiatives involving data pipelines, analytics/model components, and user-facing workflows.
  • Deep working knowledge of Agile delivery and Jira (running ceremonies, reporting, portfolio visibility).
  • Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with Compliance Surveillance, Technology, Data Management, Controls, and periodic LOB stakeholders.
  • Practical fluency with modern product/tech delivery fundamentals (APIs, cloud/data platforms) that underpin scalable solutions.
  • Hands-on AI tool usage to prototype and accelerate delivery (not just conceptual familiarity), with strong judgment and validation practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in complex industry domains, with either direct experience in communications surveillance, compliance technology, markets, Risk, or financial services, or a proven ability to rapidly learn complex regulatory, controls, data, and technology environments and translate that understanding into effective delivery execution.
  • Excellent communication skills—able to translate between business, surveillance SMEs, technologists, quantitative teams, and control functions.

Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills

  • Experience delivering in data-centric, platform-based operating models (integrated platforms, open APIs, data sharing).
  • Experience moving teams from sporadic experimentation to consistent, embedded AI-enabled practices/tools.
  • Familiarity delivering model-based capabilities (including in close partnership data science teams) and building appropriate delivery guardrails/oversight as autonomy increases.
  • Direct experience with Communications Surveillance, e-comms archives, lexicon- and model-based detection, alert/case management, or compliance technology.

title: Orthodontic Assistant

We are known for our innovative office designs and are widely recognized as a leader in orthodontics. We aim to create a foundation of optimal oral health for every child and a supportive, inspiring atmosphere for every team member.

title: Field Services Engineer - Water Treatment
description:
Are you a field service engineer who thrives on solving problems onsite, not behind a desk, and speaks fluent Arabic and English?


A global water and wastewater treatment technology company, known for its advanced RO, STP and ETP systems deployed across demanding industrial and offshore environments, is hiring a Field Service Engineer to be based in Dubai or Abu Dhabi. The company has a strong reputation across the Mediterranean and Middle East for reliable installation, commissioning and after sales service on complex plant systems, and this hire will be a critical, hands on presence for their UAE client base.


This is not a desk based technical support role. You will be on client sites, on ships and rigs, and occasionally travelling to moderate risk countries, diagnosing faults, completing repairs and commissioning systems under real time pressure.


What's in it for you:

  • Direct, high trust relationships with clients, you become their go to engineer for plant performance
  • Genuine variety across installation, commissioning, repair and inspection work rather than a single repetitive task
  • Exposure to offshore and international projects, not just local site visits
  • Base salary of AED 12,000 per month

What you'll be doing:

  • Diagnosing faults and completing repairs and calibration on RO, STP and ETP systems across client sites
  • Installing, troubleshooting and commissioning water maker systems within budget and agreed timeframes
  • Conducting site inspections and preparing reports with recommendations and parts lists
  • Providing technical training to clients so they can run their systems smoothly
  • Travelling offshore and to moderate risk countries for installation and commissioning projects
  • Liaising directly with clients to build trust and identify further business opportunities for the sales team

What we need:

  • 6 to 8 years of post qualification experience in RO, STP, filtration and ETP operation, maintenance, inspection or troubleshooting
  • Offshore RO or water treatment system installation and commissioning experience
  • Experience working in the Mediterranean region
  • Diploma or degree in Electrical or Instrumentation Engineering
  • PLC knowledge, essential


  • A willingness to get hands on and deliver under schedule and budget pressure, whether that means confined spaces, ships or rigs


If you want a role where every day looks different and your technical judgement is trusted from the first site visit, we'd like to hear from you.

title: _2nd Assistant Manager - Feliciano-prado

title: Scheduling Manager - Construction
description:
Position Overview
We are seeking an experienced Scheduling Manager to lead schedule development and control activities for construction projects. The Scheduling Manager will be responsible for building and maintaining robust project schedules, integrating schedule and cost controls, driving timely schedule updates and analysis, coordinating with project teams and subcontractors, and producing clear reporting and narratives to support decision making and claims. This role requires strong technical scheduling skills, solid construction experience, and the ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain and optimize project schedules using Microsoft Project and approved scheduling tools; establish and manage baselines for major milestones and deliverables.
  • Perform regular schedule updates, progress measurement, and variance analysis to identify critical path changes and forecast impacts to cost and completion dates.
  • Integrate schedule and project controls processes, including earned value analysis, cost-schedule integration, and baseline management to support project performance tracking.
  • Prepare time-impact analyses, recovery schedules, and delay/forensic assessments to support claims, change management, and dispute resolution.
  • Coordinate schedule inputs and constraints across construction teams, design, procurement and subcontractors; lead schedule review meetings and stakeholder coordination.
  • Execute resource leveling, create resource histograms and coordinate resource allocations to optimize sequencing and mitigate bottlenecks.
  • Produce look-ahead schedules, weekly/monthly narratives, dashboards and executive reports that clearly communicate schedule status, risks and mitigation plans.
  • Conduct schedule risk analysis and schedule compression (crashing, fast-tracking) evaluations to recommend mitigation strategies.
  • Audit, validate and quality-assure subcontractor and vendor schedules for compliance with contract requirements and overall project logic.
  • Mentor and lead scheduling staff or consultants, standardize scheduling processes, templates and best practices across projects.

Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, or related discipline (or equivalent experience).
  • Minimum 7 years of professional scheduling experience on construction projects with responsibility for schedule development, updates and project controls.
  • Proven expertise in Schedule Development, Microsoft Project, Schedule Updating, Project Controls and hands-on construction scheduling practice.
  • Strong working knowledge of CPM (Critical Path Method), baseline management, progress measurement and schedule narratives.
  • Experience with earned value concepts and cost-schedule integration; ability to perform time-impact analyses and recovery scheduling.
  • Excellent analytical skills, proficiency with advanced Excel and reporting tools, and strong oral and written communication skills for stakeholder presentations and claims support.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders, manage subcontractor schedules, and lead schedule audits and reviews.
  • Preferred certifications: PMI-SP, PMP, AACE PSP or equivalent (preferred).
  • Nice-to-have skills: Asta Powerproject; Oracle Primavera P6 EPPM; Primavera Risk Analysis; Resource Leveling and Resource Histograms; Earned Value Management (EVM); Baseline Management; Cost-Schedule Integration; Time Impact Analysis; Forensic Delay Analysis and Delay Claims Management; Schedule Risk Analysis; Schedule Compression (Crashing, Fast-Tracking); Look-Ahead Scheduling; 4D BIM / BIM Scheduling; Linear Scheduling (TILOS); S-Curves; WBS Development; Recovery Scheduling; Progress Measurement; Schedule Narratives; Workface Planning; Schedule Auditing; Stakeholder Coordination; Construction Sequencing; Dashboard & Reporting; Subcontractor Coordination; Procurement Scheduling; Change Management.

Vacation/PTO

Medical

Dental

Vision

- 5+ years of experience as an IT Business Analyst on enterprise technology projects.

- Strong experience with business requirements gathering and documentation.

- Strong understanding of complex, cross-functional business processes.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder facilitation skills.

  • Facilitate regular meetings and workshops with business stakeholders to discuss progress, challenges, dependencies, and opportunities for innovation.
  • Act as a liaison between the digital transformation team and business management to ensure clear communication and alignment on priorities and deliverables.
  • Partner with Legal, Risk, Compliance, Privacy, and other control partners to embed risk and control considerations into the product lifecycle.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills:

  • At least a Bachelor Degree in any discipline
  • 7+ years relevant digital product management / product owner experience required, with proven track record of owning roadmaps and delivering measurable outcomes
  • Must have demonstrated exemplary ownership and hold yourself to high standard; ability to drive decisions across senior stakeholders with competing priorities
  • Must be a strong problem solver and effective communicator with a partnership mindset and underlying passion for digital
  • Ability to define and execute product strategy, roadmap and business models; translate strategy into delivery plans and measurable success criteria
  • Ability to prioritize projects and efforts considering many variables including business and client needs, competitive and industry trends, resource and funding availability, and internal trade-offs
  • Ability to partner with cross-functional teams at all levels for effective execution in an agile manner
  • Ability to manage tight delivery timelines and execute under pressure, balancing short-term delivery with long-term platform health and scalability

title: Senior Scientific ML Engineer – Neural Operators, PINNs & Uncertainty Quantification
description:
Voyager is an innovative defense, national security and space technology company committed to advancing and delivering transformative, mission-critical solutions. We tackle the most complex challenges to unlock new frontiers for human progress, fortify national security, and protect critical assets to lead in the race for technological and operational superiority from ground to space.

Forge the Future: Join Voyager Technologies

The future belongs to those who build it. At Voyager Technologies, we’re building technologies that protect lives, expand frontiers and prepare us for what’s next. And we’re doing that with people who are wired to solve, build, adapt and lead. These roles are not for the faint of heart.

You’ll help lay the foundation for humanity's future. Join a culture where innovation thrives, curiosity is rewarded, and impact is real. We’re a company of doers, thinkers and builders, united by purpose and grounded in reality.

If you want to put your skills to work where the stakes are real and the mission is bigger than any one person, forge the future with Voyager.

__________________________________________________________________________________

Job Summary:

We are seeking a Senior Scientific ML Engineer to build neural-operator surrogates and physics-informed models with calibrated uncertainty for our agentic engineering platform. Working with the differentiable multiphysics lead and the accelerated simulation engineer, you will stand up a parametric data factory for Hall thrusters, train surrogate physics foundation models across geometry families, build physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) and other physics-informed ML models where data is scarce or solvers are expensive, and quantify uncertainty of the results.

You will be joining a new, early-stage team within Voyager's Advanced Technology Group building an AI-native engineering platform. We hire curious, highly motivated domain experts who already build with AI and have the taste to know what good looks like.

Responsibilities:

  • Stand up parametric data-generation pipelines.
  • Train neural-operator surrogates (FNO, DeepONet, mesh GNNs) across geometry families.
  • Develop physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) and physics-informed ML models, including physics-informed neural operators, that embed governing equations, conservation laws, and boundary conditions through PDE-residual losses or hard constraints.
  • Combine sparse data with physics priors for data-scarce regimes, and apply physics-informed methods to inverse problems such as parameter identification and field reconstruction from test data.
  • Deliver calibrated uncertainty with coverage guarantees (conformal prediction, deep ensembles, GPs) for both data-driven and physics-informed models.
  • Use active learning so the solver runs only where the uncertainty warrants it.
  • Integrate surrogates and physics-informed models into our platform as agent-callable tools with validity envelopes.
  • Capture data and close the modeling loop with test data from live physical systems.

Required Qualifications:

  • PhD, or Master's with 5–8 years of experience, in scientific ML or a related field.
  • Neural operators or mesh-based GNNs trained on physics data.
  • Physics-informed ML (PINNs, physics-informed neural operators, or equivalent) trained against PDE residuals, with a working knowledge of known failure modes (loss balancing, stiff or multiscale problems, spectral bias) and how to mitigate them.
  • Uncertainty quantification with coverage guarantees, not just error bars.
  • Has built a parametric data-generation pipeline.
  • PyTorch or JAX, distributed GPU training, and experiment tracking.
  • Demonstrated AI-first workflow: has used agents to orchestrate solver sweeps or data pipelines.
  • S. citizen with ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret Security Clearance. TS preferred.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Plasma or CFD domain background.
  • Geometry-aware operators.
  • Hybrid physics-informed and data-driven modeling, e.g., Bayesian PINNs, PINN-based inverse problems, or coupling PINNs with conventional solvers.
  • Active learning or Bayesian optimization.
  • Open-source contributions to SciML tooling (e.g., PhysicsNeMo, DeepXDE).

Remote (U.S.), with periodic travel to Voyager locations (Los Angeles, CA; Washington, D.C.; Seattle, WA) for lab work, hardware test events, and technical reviews.

This offer is contingent upon your being a U.S. citizen and requires the ability to obtain and maintain a Clearance Level U.S. Government security clearance, access eligibility, and need-to-know required for the position and applicable government contract. Clearance eligibility is determined by our U.S. Government customer.

The good faith base salary range for this role is $170,000-$225,000 at the time of this posting. Where you fall within the range depends on your experience, skills, and location. This range reflects base salary only and does not include benefits or bonus/incentive. This range may be adjusted in the future.
