title: Product Executive Director - Home Lending Product & Transformation
description:
Transform the future of Home Lending—where your AI product vision will redefine what's possible for millions of Chase customers. The Home Lending Product Transformation team is building a reimagined, faster, and more automated lending ecosystem from the ground up, and we're looking for a product leader who builds with AI, not just alongside it.

As a Product Director at JPMorganChase within the Home Lending Product Transformation team, you will own the end-to-end product strategy and delivery of AI-powered capabilities that meaningfully accelerate the home lending journey. You bring hands-on experience shipping agentic and large language model (LLM)-powered solutions, a sharp instinct for what customers need, and the product judgment to set a higher bar for what "done" looks like. This is your opportunity to lead at the intersection of AI innovation and one of the most consequential financial decisions a customer will ever make—and to set new industry standards in the process.

Job responsibilities

  • Define and own the AI product strategy for Home Lending, translating customer insights and business outcomes into a sequenced, data-backed roadmap that prioritizes speed to impact and measurable value delivery
  • Lead the design and delivery of agentic customer experiences across multiple channels—including in-app, SMS, RCS, and voice—ensuring consistent outcomes, clear escalation paths, and seamless human handoffs
  • Establish agent operating boundaries and guardrails, including permitted actions, tool access, context scope, escalation rules, and stop conditions, to ensure predictable and compliant AI behavior at enterprise scale
  • Drive prompt engineering and optimization practices—developing, testing, and tuning system prompts, few-shot examples, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines to continuously improve quality, grounding, and response efficiency
  • Build and validate AI-powered prototypes using firm-approved tooling to compress design and engineering cycle times, accelerate stakeholder alignment, and de-risk delivery before full build
  • Define crisp functional specifications—including process flows, business rules, data contracts, and acceptance criteria—that translate AI-powered outcomes into integration-ready requirements engineering can execute with confidence
  • Instrument AI features end-to-end, own performance analytics, and publish outcome dashboards that connect product decisions to measurable business and customer impact
  • Partner with engineering, design, data, and business leaders to shape scalable, resilient AI solutions; translate trade-offs clearly and drive fast, well-informed decisions across cross-functional teams
  • Champion a culture of experimentation by designing rapid tests and minimum viable products (MVPs) to validate AI assumptions, quantify learning, and iterate with discipline
  • Drive innovation across Home Lending by identifying opportunities to apply AI and automation to eliminate manual work, reduce cycle time, and reimagine legacy processes at scale

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Formal training or certification on product engineering concepts and 10+ years applied experience
  • Hands-on experience building and shipping agentic, LLM-powered products end-to-end, including orchestration pipelines, tool use, prompt engineering, RAG, and model output evaluation
  • Proven track record of delivering AI-powered task automation solutions that eliminate manual work, streamline workflows, and produce measurable business outcomes such as cycle-time reduction, productivity gains, or improved customer satisfaction
  • Advanced product analytics capability with demonstrated ability to set outcome targets, instrument features, and manage delivery to quantified results; proficiency with SQL or light scripting to accelerate hypothesis validation and time-to-insight
  • Deep experience translating business strategy into functional specifications and integration-ready requirements, including data definitions, source-to-target mappings, and non-functional requirements for AI systems
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills with the ability to align engineering, design, data science, and business partners around a shared product vision and delivery plan
  • Experience designing and delivering multi-modal AI experiences across digital and voice channels, with a clear understanding of how to balance automation with appropriate human oversight

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Experience in financial services or mortgage/home lending products, with familiarity with the regulatory and compliance considerations that shape AI deployment in this space
  • Proficiency with Figma or equivalent design tools to rapidly prototype and communicate product concepts with engineering and design partners
  • Familiarity with AI/ML model evaluation frameworks, including grounding, hallucination detection, and responsible AI practices
  • Experience working with large-scale data platforms and defining data contracts or integration standards for AI-powered systems
  • Background in consumer-facing digital product development with demonstrated ability to apply user research and usability testing to inform AI product decisions

title: Functional Family Therapy (FFT) Professional (5004)
description:
About Us

National Counseling Group has been the most trusted provider for Home-Based and Community services in Virginia since 1993. Through the years, our dedication to excellence, results and innovation has resulted in becoming the leading provider for mental, behavioral, and substance use services.
​
Our dedication to the individuals we serve and the communities in which they live is the foundation for everything we do. With passionate and knowledge staff, we are able to make an impact with individuals who need it most.

About the Role

Are you a compassionate and dedicated mental health professional looking to make a meaningful impact? National Counseling Group (NCG), is seeking a Functional Family Therapist (FFT) to join our team. In this role, you will work directly with youth and their families to address challenging behaviors through a structured, evidence-based treatment model. You will conduct comprehensive assessments, engage families in active, change-oriented therapy, and implement individualized treatment plans focused on achieving meaningful outcomes. Carrying a caseload of 10–12 clients, you will collaborate closely with families and community systems to build trust, ensure engagement, and support long-term success. Your work will include maintaining clear documentation aligned with the FFT model, participating in supervision and training, and delivering direct clinical services that make a tangible difference in the lives of those you serve. This is a unique opportunity to be part of a supportive, mission-driven team while developing your expertise in a proven therapeutic approach.

As a Functional Family Therapist, you will provide:

  • Conduct a comprehensive initial assessment to include all desired treatment outcomes, assessment of systemic strengths and needs, comprehensive safety plan, and analysis of contributing factors to referral behaviors
  • Carry a caseload of 10-12 clients
  • Engage the entire family unit in active change-oriented treatment by identifying and overcoming barriers to engagement
  • Implement problem conceptualization, treatment planning, intervention implementation, case outcome review, and strategy revision procedure
  • Maintain clear and concise documentation of treatment efforts that promote peer and supervisory review and feedback, and that demonstrate compliance with the FFT model
  • Collaborate with all relevant systems and key participants within each system to ensure their buy-in and cooperation throughout FFT treatment
  • Provide direct clinical treatment using methods compatible with the FFT model
  • Participate in all FFT training, supervision and consultation activities

This description outlines the general scope and level of work for this role. It is not intended to include every duty or responsibility that may be required of employees in this position.


Compensation

Placement within the range is based on licensure level, education, and experience.

This is a variable rate non-exempt position with unlimited earning potential. Your effort drives your earnings, no limits.

  • Opportunities to build your preferred clinical focus areas
  • Streamlined onboarding and credentialing support

  • Maintain accurate and timely clinical documentation
  • Collaborate with care teams as needed
  • Maintain compliance with all clinical and regulatory standards
  • Participate in supervision (if applicable based on licensure level)

title: Vice President, Analytical Development
description:
About Stoke:

Stoke Therapeutics (Nasdaq: STOK), is a biotechnology company dedicated to restoring protein expression by harnessing the body’s potential with RNA medicine. Using Stoke’s proprietary TANGO (Targeted Augmentation of Nuclear Gene Output) approach, Stoke is developing antisense oligonucleotides (ASOs) to selectively restore naturally-occurring protein levels. Stoke’s first medicine in development, zorevunersen, has demonstrated the potential for disease modification in patients with Dravet syndrome and is currently being evaluated in a Phase 3 study. Stoke’s initial focus are diseases of the central nervous system and the eye that are caused by a loss of ~50% of normal protein levels (haploinsufficiency). Proof of concept has been demonstrated in other organs, tissues, and systems, supporting broad potential for Stoke’s proprietary approach. Stoke is headquartered in Bedford, Massachusetts. For more information, visit https://www.stoketherapeutics.com/

Position Purpose:

The Vice President of Analytical Development is the senior owner of analytical strategy across our technical operations organization. You will lead the development, qualification, transfer of analytical methods for drug substance, drug product, and associated materials, spanning our oligonucleotide and conjugate modalities. Because we rely on external partners, a core part of this role is the scientific and quality oversight of CDMO and CRO analytical laboratories, ensuring data integrity, phase-appropriate rigor, inspection readiness, and on-time delivery.

You will be a member of the technical operations leadership team and a key contributor to regulatory strategy, product control strategy, and cross-functional program governance.

Key Responsibilities

Analytical strategy and leadership

  • Define and execute the analytical development strategy across all programs, aligned with CMC, clinical, regulatory, and commercial timelines
  • Establish phase-appropriate analytical control strategies, including critical quality attributes (CQAs) identification, specifications, characterization plans, and stability programs
  • Build and lead a high-performing team of scientists and managers, with a mix of internal staff and external resources
  • Set the vision for analytical platforms and technologies, and advise on build vs. partner decisions for internal lab capabilities
  • Work closely with Quality Control function to support and troubleshoot long-term routine testing

Oligonucleotide analytical development

  • Direct the development and control of methods for oligonucleotide drug substance and drug product including identity, purity, impurity profiling, potency/strength, and physical characterization
  • Provide expertise in multiple modes of HPLC/UPLC, LC-MS and high-resolution MS for sequence confirmation and impurity identification, and related compendial techniques
  • Guide strategies for process-related and product-related impurities (e.g., n-1/n+1 species, phosphorothioate diastereomers, depurination products), residual solvents, metals, and counter-ion/water content
  • Oversee characterization of reference standards and management of their lifecycle

Broader analytical development

  • Oversee GMP analytical strategy for pipeline of oligonucleotide conjugates, including product characterization, purity and heterogeneity, potency and bioassays, binding assays, and potential process-related impurities
  • Ensure a sound comparability strategy for process and site changes and secondary manufacturers
  • Evaluate and implement new analytical technologies where they add speed, robustness, or insight

CDMO/CRO oversight and tech transfer

  • Serve as the senior scientific authority for analytical activities at external partners, including method transfer, qualification, release testing, and stability studies
  • Participate in CDMO/CRO selection, technical due diligence, and audits; drive governance through regular technical reviews and issue escalation
  • Review and approve GMP work packages including protocols, reports, and data packages; ensure timely, high-quality data delivery and sound investigation of OOS/OOT results and deviations in conjunction with Quality Assurance and Quality Control
  • Manage analytical timelines, budgets, and resource forecasts across multiple vendors and programs

GMP, quality, and regulatory

  • Ensure analytical activities comply with cGMP and applicable guidance (ICH Q2(R2), Q14, Q6A/Q6B, Q5C, Q1A, USP/Ph. Eur., and FDA/EMA expectations, including oligonucleotide-specific guidance)
  • Partner with Quality Assurance and Quality Control and on data integrity, change control, specifications, and batch disposition support
  • Author and review the analytical sections of IND/CTA, IND amendments, NDA submissions, and respond to health authority questions
  • Support pre-approval inspections and lead analytical readiness for process validation and commercial launch

Cross-functional leadership

  • Partner with Process Development, Formulation, Manufacturing, Regulatory, Quality, Clinical, and Supply Chain to deliver integrated strategies
  • Present analytical strategy and risk to executive leadership, governance committees, and, as needed, investors and partners

Required Skills & Experience:

  • Ph.D. in analytical chemistry, biochemistry, chemistry, pharmaceutical sciences, or a related discipline with 15+ years of biotech/pharma experience (or M.S. with 18+ years), including 8+ years in people leadership
  • Experience in oligonucleotide analytical development, including both characterization and GMP release/stability testing
  • Demonstrated leadership and expertise with biologics analytical development, including complex biologic modalities
  • Deep GMP experience, with a track record of working in an outsourced/virtual manufacturing model and overseeing CDMO and CRO analytical operations
  • Proven success in method development, qualification/validation, and transfer, through at least one program into late-stage clinical development
  • Direct authorship of CMC analytical content for regulatory filings
  • Strong understanding of Quality by Design, Design of Experiment analytical development, analytical lifecycle management, and risk-based approaches

title: Director of Operations - High Voltage High Power
description:
Our CLIENT is a global leader in designing and manufacturing customized power solutions for OEM customers in semiconductor, industrial, and healthcare markets. Its High Voltage High Power (HVHP) division in High Bridge, NJ, designs and builds highly engineered, high-mix, high-voltage power supplies for the world's leading semiconductor equipment OEMs and demanding industrial and medical customers. Demand is accelerating sharply, with output set to roughly double and site headcount planned to grow from about 100 to over 175, creating a fast-paced, high-growth environment.


THE ROLE

Our CLIENT seeks a hands-on, high-energy operations leader to run the High Bridge, NJ site day-to-day while the VP of HVHP focuses on ramping manufacturing sites in Asia. This leader will own safety, quality, delivery, cost, and people across production, test, repair, quality, warehouse, and supply chain, and will build the capacity, systems, and standard work needed to scale. The ideal candidate comes from component- and PCB-level electronics manufacturing, sets a fast pace, follows up relentlessly, and can lead change with a long-tenured team.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead and develop a team of about 100 growing to 150–175 through cultural change, and support product transfers to their Asia sites, with a dotted line to a 25–30 person team in Vietnam.
  • Own site performance on safety, quality, on-time delivery, output, lead time, and cost, running a daily and weekly management cadence that drives every action to closure.
  • Own capacity planning and scheduling, translating backlog and forecast into labor, station, and shift plans, and build a multi-year roadmap and CapEx business cases for capacity, layout, automation, test, and systems.
  • Move the site from tribal knowledge to documented standard work, digital work instructions, and data-driven decisions, leading Lean and continuous improvement to raise throughput, first-pass yield, and margin.
  • Partner with Quality to build quality into the process, own readiness for ISO 9001 and customer audits, and serve as the senior operations contact for key semiconductor equipment OEM customers.


QUALIFICATIONS

  • 10+ years of progressive operations leadership in electronics manufacturing, with 5+ years leading a site or multi-function operation.
  • Hands-on component- and PCB-level experience with complex technical products.
  • Experience in test, production, or quality, with a proven record of scaling output through rapid growth.
  • Deep Lean, standard work, and capacity planning expertise, with a quality-first mindset (ISO 9001, root cause, CAPA).
  • High energy, with experience leading change with long-tenured, people-centric teams.
  • Bachelor's degree in engineering; MSEE a plus. Lean Six Sigma belt and product transfers to Asia are a plus.


COMPENSATION: Salary is among the best in the industry.

title: Senior Specialist - AI Business Enablement
description:
Job purpose


Coordinate organisational readiness, adoption and benefits measurement for approved AI initiatives across HCT. Translate agreed business outcomes into change actions, communication, learning support and measurable adoption plans. Work with academic and administrative owners to embed new practices and review outcomes using reliable evidence. Support the AI Business Enablement Manager, with business owners retaining responsibility for local implementation, business acceptance and benefits realization.


Key Responsibilities


Functional and Operational Accountabilities


• Assess how approved AI initiatives affect users, processes, responsibilities and skills. Map stakeholder groups and identify readiness gaps, adoption barriers and support needs with academic and administrative owners.

• Prepare change impact assessments and readiness plans with named action owners, dependencies and completion evidence. Coordinate agreed actions with business owners and escalate unresolved issues to the AI Business Enablement Manager.

• Work with the Business Analysis specialist to align change impacts, user needs and expected benefits with the shared requirements baseline and business case. Provide adoption and capability inputs without duplicating business analysis or product ownership.


Functional and Operational Accountabilities Continued

Communication and capability development


• Develop coordinated communication, engagement and learning activities for agreed stakeholder

groups. Align messages and timing with business owners, Product Lifecycle and relevant HCT

communication and learning functions.

• Prepare user guidance, demonstrations and learning materials with product and technical specialists.

Coordinate practical training and local champions, and assess whether intended users can apply the new practices safely and effectively.

• Gather user feedback through workshops, surveys and support channels. Analyse recurring barriers, recommend corrective actions and track follow-up with the responsible owners before and after implementation.


Adoption and benefits measurement

• Define adoption measures, benefits baselines, data sources, review schedules and named benefits

owners with business owners and the Business Analysis specialist. Maintain one consistent benefits

register linked to the approved business case.

• Monitor adoption and sustained use using agreed product, operational and user evidence. Check data quality and explain differences across user groups, separating training participation from effective use and business outcomes.

• Coordinate benefits reviews and report actual outcomes against baselines and agreed expectations.

  • Distinguish forecasts from verified results, document assumptions and attribution limits, and obtain Finance validation of financial measures.

• Maintain readiness and adoption evidence for lifecycle reviews and independent validation.

Recommend improvements and track agreed actions, while Product Lifecycle governs product scope and lifecycle gates and business owners retain business acceptance.


Delivery coordination and stakeholder service

• Plan and deliver assigned adoption and benefits activities within agreed priorities and resources.

Coordinate contributors, share methods and coach colleagues or champions without assuming line management or budget approval authority.

• Maintain accurate plans, stakeholder records, benefits evidence and action logs. Provide timely

progress reports to the Manager, escalate risks and dependencies, and feed lessons into future

demand assessment and product improvement.


Institutional Accountabilities

• Comply with HCT policies, professional standards and applicable quality, risk, health and safety

requirements. Maintain evidence for reviews and audits.

• Protect institutional and personal information, follow approved AI and information-security controls, complete required awareness activities and promptly report suspected incidents.

• Maintain business continuity responsibilities, participate in exercises when required and support agreed response and recovery actions.

• Improve working practices, maintain professional competence and undertake other duties assigned by the line manager or authorised delegate within the scope of the role.


No independent authority to commit funding, approve product scope or authorise go-live. Business owners retain local implementation, business acceptance and benefits realisation; Finance and specialist functions retain their approval rights.


Qualifications


  • Education Bachelor’s degree in business administration, organisational development, information systems, education or a related discipline. A relevant master’s degree is preferred.

Professional certifications

  • A recognised qualification in change management, learning and development,
  • programme management or benefits management is preferred.
  • Professional proficiency in English; Arabic is an advantage. Ability to use enterprise

collaboration, survey, learning, reporting and analytics tools to support adoption and

evidence-based benefits reviews.


Experience


At least 5 years of relevant experience in organisational change, digital adoption or

business enablement, including at least 2 years delivering complex change or

adoption activities across functions. Proposed threshold for Human Capital review and

final grade evaluation.


Role-specific experience

  • Demonstrated delivery of change impact assessments, stakeholder engagement,
  • communication and learning plans, adoption measurement and benefits reviews.
  • Experience supporting implementation of AI or other digital solutions.

Preferred experience

  • Experience in a large, government, higher-education or multi-campus organisation.
  • Evidence of working with business and technical teams, validating outcome measures

and supporting users through operational change.

title: Digital Product Delivery Manager (Mobile App)
location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
description:

title: Data Scientist, Auto Data & Analytics - Senior Associate
description:
You will help shape how the Auto business understands performance and sets strategy across retail dealer operations, originations, booking and funding, and consumer engagement. You will build predictive models, uncover opportunities through deep analysis, and turn findings into clear, actionable business cases. You will work closely with partners across business, product, and analytics, and communicate with executive-ready storytelling.

As a Data Scientist – Auto Data and Analytics (Senior Associate) at JPMorganChase within the Retail and Consumer Analytics team supporting the Auto business, you will own quantitative analytical workstreams end-to-end. You will build models that predict customer and dealer behavior, quantify the financial impact of your work (including net present value), and translate analytical insights into prioritized actions. You will bridge data science and business strategy by sizing opportunities, defining success measures, and influencing decisions with clear communication.

Job responsibilities

  • Build predictive models and machine learning solutions (propensity, risk, segmentation, and classification) to support Auto business decisions
  • Analyze dealer performance, originations, booking and funding, and consumer behavior to identify drivers and actionable opportunities
  • Quantify financial impact of findings and model outputs (e.g., net present value, revenue opportunity, cost avoidance) to inform prioritization
  • Partner with business and product teams to frame the right questions, size opportunities, and define analytical approaches for new initiatives
  • Design and evaluate experiments (including A/B tests) and measurement frameworks; define key performance indicators tied to objectives
  • Create repeatable Python and SQL workflows on cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake and Amazon Web Services) to support scaled analytics
  • Present insights and business cases to senior stakeholders with clear, executive-ready storytelling and recommendations

Required qualifications, capabilities and skills

  • Formal training or certification in a quantitative discipline (e.g., statistics, economics, computer science, engineering, or related field)
  • Three years of applied experience in data science, quantitative analytics, or a related role
  • Demonstrated experience building and applying machine learning and statistical models (e.g., classification, regression, ensemble methods, propensity modeling)
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL for data analysis, feature engineering, and model development
  • Experience working with cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake and Amazon Web Services) to build scalable analytics workflows
  • Proven experience quantifying business impact in financial terms (e.g., net present value analysis, opportunity sizing, or comparable business-case work)
  • Ability to communicate complex analytical results clearly and independently to senior stakeholders and influence decisions

Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills

  • Experience taking models from development through deployment or sustained business adoption (e.g., monitoring, performance tracking, and iteration)
  • Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau) and translating analysis into clear, stakeholder-ready materials
  • Domain experience in financial services, auto, or lending analytics
  • Experience partnering closely with product teams to shape roadmaps using data and experimentation

  • Strong understanding of automation, data-driven operations, and the adoption of AI and emerging technologies to improve data center service delivery, resilience, and operational efficiency.

  • Demonstrated experience leading safe use of enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment within production support workflows, including validation practices and awareness of data sensitivity.

title: STERILE PROC SHIFT SUPV
description:
Overview

Shift Supervisor, Sterile Processing

Full Time, 72 Hours Per Pay Period, Variable Shifts

Methodist Overview:

Methodist Medical Center of Oak Ridge, part of Covenant Health, is a trusted regional hospital serving East Tennessee with advanced care and a personal touch. With more than 30 specialties, including cardiology, neurosurgery, orthopedics, and vascular care, the facility offers innovative treatments for complex conditions like aneurysms, joint damage, heart failure, and chronic wounds. Backed by a team of over 1,000 healthcare professionals and 250 physicians, Methodist Medical Center combines state-of-the-art technology with compassionate care, earning national recognition for patient safety and excellence in stroke and heart care. Our facilities offer patients all the benefits of medical expertise and innovation while still embodying the convenience of a hometown medical center that is close to the support of family and friends.

Position Summary:

Under the direction of department leadership, responsible for the proper decontamination, inspection, assembly, and high level disinfection and sterilization of surgical instruments. Operates processing equipment. Requires proficiency in instrument decontamination and assembly and knowledge of the sterilization methods available and which method is appropriate in correlation with the devices that are to be processed. They must be proficient in surgical case picking as well as endoscopy reprocessing. Serves as supervisor for assigned shift.

Responsibilities

  • Serves as the lead technician of the shift for all instrumentation.
  • Coordinates daily work assignments and prepares schedule for staff.
  • Orients new employees to specific duties of particular shifts. Will mentor and provide guidance and training as needed and will serve as backup in the absence of the department coordinator.
  • Ensures that supervised staff are trained and evaluated.
  • Decontaminates surgical instruments according to manufacturer’s instructions or advised by the department leader. Will operate all decontamination equipment including washer disinfectors, ultrasonic cleaners, cart washer, and automatic endoscope reprocessor (AER).
  • Inspects instruments after decontamination, ensuring all items are clean, intact, functional, and accounted for.
  • Assembles trays in a manner that ensures devise sterility and is easy for the end user to access for use. Uses count sheets to ensure trays are assembled accurately. Interfaces with the instrument tracking system for all functions of processing.
  • Packages or containerizes instrument sets according to manufacturer’s guidelines and Association for the Advancement of Medical Instrumentation (AAMI) standards. Packages in a neat and proper technique ensuring easy aseptic opening in the operating room.
  • Loads sterilizer carts in a way to ensure packaged items are not punctured or compromised, loads containers and wrapped goods as recommended
  • Assures accurate input of daily sterilizer tests on all steam and low temperature sterilizers.
  • Operates sterilizer according to manufacturer’s instruction ensuring load biological monitoring.
  • Documents all load contents, interfaces load to tracking system, loads cycle confirming correct parameters, monitors sterilizer to tracking system information, records all pertinent information (biological, mechanical, and chemical). Performs quality control as needed.
  • Unloads sterilizers, ensuring items are not compromised, and stores in correct location according to instrument tracking system storage locations.
  • Follows endoscope manufacturer’s processing instructions and accepted standards/guidelines.
  • Prepares hospital requisitions as needed; monitors and communicates to management all items received from outside vendors.
  • Answer phones and relays information with other employees and staff members.
  • Inventories and orders par levels of instruments.
  • Assists with maintaining departmental records and performs instrument and scope audits.
  • Follows policies, procedures, and safety standards. Completes required education assignments annually. Works toward achieving goals and objectives, and participates in quality improvement initiatives as requested.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Minimum Education:

None specified; however, must be sufficient to meet the standards for achievement of the below indicated license and/or certification as required by the issuing authority.

Minimum Experience:

None

Licensure Requirement:

IAHCSMM (International Association for Healthcare Material Management) as a Certified Registered Sterile Processing Technician (CRCST) or CBSPD (Certification Board for Sterile Processing Technicians) as a Certified Sterile Processing Distribution Technician (CSPDT) certification is required.

title: Optimization Lead, Monitoring
description:
About SimpliSafe

We’re a high-tech home security company that’s passionate about protecting the life you’ve built and our mission of keeping Every Home Secure. And we’ve created a culture here that cares just as deeply about the career you’re building. Ours is a no ego culture of collaboration and innovation where those seeking their next challenge can find big opportunities and make a huge impact on the lives of all those who we protect. We don’t just want you to work here. We want you to grow and thrive here.

Our customers are protected by live professional monitoring agents - real people who always have their back. Our professional monitoring center is open and delivers fast emergency response 24/7, and our monitoring specialists are expected to work fully onsite using our advanced technology to keep our customers’ homes secure.

Why are we hiring?

Well, we’re growing and thriving. So, we need smart, talented, and humble people who share our values to join us as we disrupt the home security space and relentlessly pursue our mission of keeping Every Home Secure.

What You’ll Do:

As our Optimization Lead, you’ll build how we measure monitoring performance as AI and camera-first change the way we protect customers. You’ll find out how specialists and AI handle the moments that matter, turn what you learn into clear recommendations, and confirm each change made things better. You’ll join our Launch & Optimization team, the ops lab that partners with Product and Engineering to bring new monitoring capabilities to life.

Primary Responsibilities Include:

  • Build and run measurement of specialist and AI performance on specific video and workflow elements, starting with the human baseline that AI accuracy is measured against.
  • Design sampling plans with support from Engineering and Analytics, then own and refine them over time.
  • Find where performance gaps and improvement opportunities exist, and turn findings into clear recommendations for Product and Engineering, with the expected impact on accuracy or cost to serve.
  • Measure the impact of changes once they’re live to confirm they worked and to inform the next round.
  • Supervise and develop a team of Optimization Analysts: set the sampling plan, review findings for quality, and build their skills.
  • Run calibration sessions so analyst scoring stays consistent and findings can be trusted.
  • Partner with Testing & Implementation to connect element-level findings to end-to-end workflow performance.
  • Flag gaps that come from specialist knowledge rather than the system, so training requirements and content can be updated.
  • Work with QA, Capacity & Workforce Planning and Analytics to align scoring approaches and show the staffing and cost impact of improvements.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in alarm monitoring, contact center operations, quality, or a similar data-driven operations role.
  • Strong data fluency and comfort working with operational and quality data to find patterns and explain what they mean.
  • Experience with QA scoring, calibration or performance measurement.
  • Structured, curious thinking and the ability to turn analysis into clear, practical recommendations.
  • Experience leading, coaching or mentoring analysts or a small team. Supervisory experience is preferred.
  • Clear communication with Operations, Product and Engineering partners.
  • Experience with sampling and measurement methods, or the drive to build that expertise quickly with support.
  • Experience with video monitoring, AI-assisted workflows or evaluating model outputs is a plus. SQL or BI tool experience is also a plus.
  • Hands-on experience applying AI tools to speed up analysis, sampling or reporting is a plus.
  • Flexibility to support occasional early, late or weekend work for go-lives and to reach specialists across all shifts.

What Values You’ll Share

  • Customer Obsessed - Building deep empathy for our customers, putting them at the core of our work, and developing strong, long-term relationships with them.
  • Aim High - Always challenging ourselves and others to raise the bar.
  • No Ego - Maintaining a “no job too small” attitude, and an open, inclusive and humble style.
  • One Team - Taking a highly collaborative approach to achieving success.
  • Lift As We Climb - Investing in developing others and helping others around us succeed.
  • Lean & Nimble - Working with agility and efficiency to experiment in an often ambiguous environment.

What We Offer

  • A mission- and values-driven culture and a safe, inclusive environment where you can build, grow and thrive
  • A comprehensive total rewards package that supports your wellness and provides security for SimpliSafers and their families (For more information on our total rewards please click here)
  • Free SimpliSafe system and professional monitoring for your home.
  • Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that bring people together, give opportunities to network, mentor and develop, and advocate for change.

The target annual base pay range for this role is $88,500 to $118,000

This target annual base pay range represents our good-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this role. We use a market-based compensation approach to set our target annual base pay ranges and make adjustments annually. We carefully tailor individual compensation packages, including base pay, taking into consideration employees’ job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and other relevant business factors.

Beyond base pay, we offer a Total Rewards package that may include participation in our annual bonus program, equity, and other forms of compensation, in addition to a full range of medical, retirement, and lifestyle benefits. More details can be found here.

We’re committed to fair and equitable pay practices, as well as pay transparency. We regularly review our programs to ensure they remain competitive and aligned with our values.

We wholeheartedly embrace and actively seek applications from all individuals, no matter how they identify. We are committed to cultivating a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we believe our work is enriched when we incorporate a multitude of perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences. We want everyone who works here to thrive and contribute to not only our mission of keeping every home secure, but also to making our workplace safe and supportive for others. If a reasonable accommodation may be needed to fully participate in the job application or interview process, to perform the essential functions of a position, or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact careers@simplisafe.com.

title: Principal Quality Systems Analyst
description:

1Kosmos is driving the future of identity security, empowering organizations to eliminate passwords and establish trust at every step of the identity lifecycle. As a vibrant team of innovators, we develop advanced authentication solutions trusted by some of the world's leading brands. Join us as we create a passwordless world and set new standards for digital identity assurance.

Your Title: Principal Quality Systems Analyst

Your Location: Hybrid - Edison, NJ HQ

Department: Engineering & Technology

Employment Type: Full-Time

Reports To: Chief Technology Officer

Annual Base Salary: $210,000

Position Level: Principal - Individual Contributor

We are seeking an experienced Principal Quality Systems Analyst to analyze, evaluate and optimize complex computer systems supporting 1Kosmos' digital identity, authentication and cybersecurity platform. This position will be responsible for evaluating existing systems, identifying technical and functional requirements, developing system specifications, assessing system integrations and recommending solutions to improve system functionality, performance, scalability, reliability and security. The Principal Computer Systems Analyst will serve as a senior technical subject matter expert, working closely with Engineering, Product Management, Security and Infrastructure teams to ensure that computer systems effectively support organizational and customer requirements.

Position Scope: Principal Quality Systems Analyst is a senior-level technical individual contributor responsible for computer systems analysis, evaluation, integration and optimization. The position provides technical expertise, professional guidance and cross-functional collaboration without direct personnel management, employee performance management or departmental administrative responsibilities.

What you will own:

  • Computer Systems Analysis and Evaluation - 30%
  • Analyze existing computer systems, enterprise applications and technical infrastructure to identify opportunities for improvement
  • Evaluate system architecture, functionality, workflows and technical dependencies
  • Identify system limitations, operational inefficiencies and performance gaps
  • Conduct technical feasibility assessments for proposed system enhancements
  • Recommend solutions to improve system functionality, reliability and scalability
  • Technical Requirements and System Design - 25%

  • Translate organizational and customer needs into detailed computer system specifications
  • Develop system models, workflow diagrams, data flow diagrams and technical documentation
  • Evaluate proposed system designs and recommend appropriate technical solutions
  • Assess the impact of system modifications on existing applications and infrastructure
  • Systems Integration and Optimization - 20%
  • Analyze integration requirements across enterprise applications, cloud infrastructure and digital identity platforms
  • Evaluate interoperability between internal and external computer systems
  • Assess application programming interfaces (APIs), data exchange mechanisms and system dependencies
  • Recommend improvements to system configurations, integration architecture and operational efficiency
  • Collaborate with technical teams to implement approved system improvements
  • System Performance and Validation - 15%
  • Evaluate computer system performance against established functional and technical requirements
  • Analyze system-level issues, performance bottlenecks and operational risks
  • Conduct root-cause analysis and recommend technical solutions
  • Assess whether system modifications meet established specifications and operational objectives
  • Evaluate system capacity, availability, reliability and scalability
  • Technical Advisory and Documentation - 10%
  • Serve as a subject matter expert in computer systems analysis and enterprise technology solutions
  • Provide technical recommendations to Engineering, Product Management and Security teams
  • Prepare technical reports, system specifications and recommendations for system improvements
  • Participate in technical architecture and system design reviews
  • Provide technical guidance and knowledge sharing to cross-functional teams.

What you bring:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, Information Technology or a closely related technical discipline
  • 10+ years of relevant experience in computer systems analysis, enterprise technology systems or related technical functions
  • Strong understanding of computer system architecture, distributed systems and cloud-based applications
  • Demonstrated experience analyzing complex technical and functional requirements
  • Experience with system integration, data modeling, APIs and enterprise applications
  • Strong knowledge of system performance analysis, technical troubleshooting and root-cause analysis
  • Ability to develop comprehensive technical specifications and system documentation
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving and communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate with multidisciplinary technical teams
  • Experience working with cybersecurity, digital identity or authentication technologies
  • Knowledge of identity and access management (IAM) systems
  • Familiarity with authentication protocols, including SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect andFIDO2
  • Experience with enterprise SaaS platforms and cloud computing environments
  • Understanding of system reliability, availability, scalability and security requirements

Key Deliverables and Success Measures:

  • Comprehensive computer system assessments and technical recommendations
  • Accurate and actionable system requirements and specifications
  • Improved system performance, efficiency and interoperability
  • Identification and resolution of complex system-level issues
  • Effective implementation of recommended system enhancements
  • High-quality technical documentation and architecture assessments

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to build and lead a critical function at a high-growth Series B startup
  • Competitive salary and equity package
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Unlimited PTO Policy
  • Collaborative, fast-paced culture where your impact is immediate and visible

title: Dock Supervisor - Nashville, TN
location: TN Nashville Millwork, Nashville, TN, US
description:
Position Overview

Job title

Dock Supervisor

Location

Nashville, TN

Department

Warehouse / Shipping

Logistics Manager

Direct reports

Loaders

Shift

10:00 AM until all trucks are loaded and ready to ship

Employment type

Full-time

FLSA status

Exempt (salaried)

Salary range

$55,000 – $65,000 per year


Position Summary:

The Dock Supervisor owns outbound shipping at the Nashville branch: every order loaded accurately, safely, and on time, every day. This person leads the dock crew from the 10:00 AM start until the last truck is loaded, secured, and released to ship. The role balances hands-on leadership on the floor with coordination across inventory, customer service, and drivers.

Key Responsibilities:

Shipping operations

  • Plan the day's loads at shift start: review routes, order volume, and truck schedules, then assign crew and dock doors.
  • Direct loading so trucks are filled in correct stop sequence, properly secured, and protected from damage.
  • Verify every load against pick tickets, bills of lading, and manifests before release.
  • Release each truck only when it is fully loaded, documented, and ready to ship; stay until the last truck is out.
  • Resolve shortages, overages, and damaged product with inventory and customer service before trucks leave.

People leadership

  • Supervise, schedule, and motivate the loader team.
  • Train new and existing team members on loading standards, equipment, and safety.
  • Set clear daily expectations, coach performance, and handle attendance and discipline with HR guidance.
  • Assist with interviewing and hiring loaders.

Safety and equipment

  • Enforce OSHA and company safety rules on the dock, including PPE, forklift operation, and dock-lock/wheel-chock procedures.
  • Confirm loaders who operate forklifts are certified and complete daily equipment inspections.
  • Investigate and report incidents and near-misses; correct hazards on the spot.
  • Keep the dock clean, organized, and free of obstructions.

Coordination and reporting

  • Communicate with drivers, dispatch, and the Logistics Manager on load status, delays, and late adds.
  • Track daily metrics such as loads shipped, on-time departure, load accuracy, and damage claims.
  • Maintain shipping records and complete end-of-shift reports.
  • Recommend process improvements that reduce load time and errors.

Qualifications:

Required

  • High school diploma or GED.
  • 3+ years of warehouse, shipping, or distribution experience, including at least 1 year leading a team.
  • Working knowledge of truck loading, load securement, and shipping documentation (bills of lading, manifests).
  • Forklift certification, or ability to obtain it within 30 days of hire.
  • Basic computer skills, including email and a warehouse management or inventory system.
  • Ability to work a variable-length shift, including late evenings when volume is high.

Preferred

  • Experience shipping building materials, millwork, doors, or other bulky and easily damaged products.
  • OSHA 10 or OSHA 30 certification.
  • Experience with route-sequenced, multi-stop truck loading.
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish.

Physical Requirements and Work Environment:

  • Stand, walk, bend, and climb in and out of trailers for most of the shift.
  • Lift and move up to 50 lbs regularly, and help team-lift heavier items.
  • Work on a loading dock exposed to Nashville heat, cold, humidity, and rain.
  • Work around forklifts, trucks, and moving equipment, with noise and dust present.
  • Wear required PPE, including safety-toe shoes.

Schedule and Equal Opportunity:

The shift starts at 10:00 AM and ends when all trucks are loaded and ready to ship, so end times vary with daily volume. Candidates should expect longer days during peak seasons and flexibility for occasional Saturday work as business needs require.

We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

This description covers the main duties of the role and is not an exhaustive list. Duties may change based on business needs.

title: Finance Business Partner
description:
About Baringa

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Finance team are looking for an experienced Finance Business Partner to join them.

As a Sector Finance Business Partner at Baringa, you will operate as a trusted commercial advisor to sector and business unit leadership teams. You will take a true seat at the leadership table, bringing the financial insight, challenge and commercial judgement needed to help sectors execute their strategy and deliver sustainable, high-margin profitable growth.

You will translate financial performance, project economics, demand, pricing, utilisation, cost and margin data into clear, action-oriented insight. The expectation is that you help leadership teams understand what is really driving performance, where value is being created or lost, and what action is needed to improve outcomes.

A core part of the role is building commercial capability in the sector. You will coach partners, project partners and project managers to manage work with stronger commercial rigour through D365, including project set-up, time discipline, revenue recognition, WIP, invoicing, debt, cash collection, pricing and margin management.

You will work closely with FP&A, Data & Insights, Finance Operations, Staffing & Utilisation, People, Legal and Sector Business Managers to provide joined-up commercial support. The role requires someone who can balance senior-level strategic conversations with the detailed operational grip needed to turn insight into action.

What you will be doing

  • Act as the visible face of Finance for the sector, building trusted relationships with sector leadership, BU leads, partners, project partners and project managers.
  • Take an active seat in sector leadership conversations, using financial insight and commercial judgement to challenge performance, shape decisions and support execution of the sector strategy.
  • Turn financial and operational data into clear, actionable insight; connecting revenue, demand, utilisation, pricing, cost, margin, debt and cash performance to the strategic choices facing the sector.
  • Support high-margin profitable growth by identifying performance and operational risks, margin leakage, pricing opportunities, delivery inefficiencies and areas where leadership action is needed.
  • Lead sector and BU performance reviews, including client, account and project-level deep dives into margin, bill rates, team shape, utilisation, fixed price delivery, WIP and cash collection.
  • Coach sector teams on commercial rigour through D365, helping them manage the full project lifecycle effectively from opportunity and project set-up through time recording, revenue recognition, invoicing, cash collection and project closure.
  • Use D365 and Power BI reporting to improve the quality, consistency and timeliness of commercial conversations, while actively identifying data quality issues, process gaps and reporting improvements.
  • Partner with FP&A on forecasting, planning and scenario analysis, ensuring sector plans are stretching, credible and aligned to strategic priorities, cost envelopes and margin expectations.
  • Prepare and review monthly sector and BU performance materials, management account commentary and inputs to senior leadership packs, ensuring the message is concise, accurate and focused on the “so what”.
  • Provide ad hoc commercial support to bids, pricing decisions and business cases, challenging assumptions and helping teams understand the margin, risk and cash implications of proposed work.
  • Work with Finance Operations to improve working capital outcomes, using sector relationships to unblock billing, addressable debt, aged WIP and cash collection issues.
  • Collaborate across Baringa Enablement, including People, Staffing & Utilisation, Legal, Data & Insights and Sector Business Managers, to provide joined-up commercial support to the sector.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of Finance Business Partnering, sharing insight, raising standards across the team and helping codify what excellent sector partnering looks like.

Your skills and experience

  • Educated to degree level or equivalent.
  • Qualified accountant, ideally with 5+ years post-qualified experience.
  • Strong commercial finance experience, ideally gained in a professional services or project-based environment.
  • Deep understanding of project economics, including revenue recognition, utilisation, pricing, team shape, bill rates, margin, WIP, debt and cash.
  • Ability to turn complex financial and operational data into clear insight, focused narrative and practical actions for senior non-finance stakeholders.
  • Strong knowledge of forecasting, planning, management reporting and performance management processes.
  • Confident using finance systems and reporting tools, with experience of D365 desirable.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to land key messages clearly and influence at leadership level.
  • Credible and mature stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge assumptions and hold senior stakeholders to account in a constructive way.
  • Proactive, resilient and comfortable operating at pace, balancing strategic priorities with the detailed follow-through required to drive outcomes.
  • Coaching mindset, with the ability to build commercial capability in sector teams and raise the standard of project-level financial management.

What a career at Baringa will give you

Putting People First.

Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include:

  • Generous Annual Leave Policy: We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service.
  • Flexible Working: We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave.
  • Corporate Responsibility Days: Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us.
  • Wellbeing Fund: We want to encourage all employees to take charge and prioritise their own wellbeing. We’ve introduced our annual People Fund to support this by offering every individual a fund to support and manage their wellbeing through an activity of their choice.
  • Profit Share Scheme: All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme so everyone has a stake in the company’s success.

Diversity and Inclusion

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people.

An award-winning workplace

You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all. Click here to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this.

Using business as a force for good.

We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve.

We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.

Join us

All applications received will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We never rely solely on automated screening or AI tools to make hiring decisions. Your application will be considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, nationality, disability, age, faith or social background. We do not filter applications by university background and encourage those who have taken alternative educational and career paths to apply. We would like to actively encourage applications from those who identify with less represented and minority groups. We operate an inclusive recruitment process, ensuring reasonable adjustments where needed. Please contact a member of our Recruitment Team to discuss further.

Baringa Privacy Notices

In line with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to request access to, rectification, or erasure (subject to legal limitations) of your personal data. title: Senior GNC PX4 Software Engineer
description:
Position Summary

RedCat Aerial – Torrance is seeking a Senior GNC / PX4 Software Engineer to develop, integrate, and validate flight control systems for unmanned aircraft.

This is a hands-on engineering role combining guidance, navigation, and control (GNC) development with embedded software engineering in the PX4 autopilot framework. The engineer will work directly within the PX4 flight stack to develop and improve control algorithms, implement new flight capabilities, troubleshoot flight performance issues, and support aircraft development from early prototypes through production.

The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in control theory and aircraft dynamics, significant experience with C++ and PX4 software development, and practical experience tuning and validating flight controls on real aircraft.

This position requires someone comfortable working across software, controls, and hardware in a fast-paced engineering environment where solutions are developed, tested, and refined through direct experimentation and flight testing.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, implement, and tune guidance, navigation, and control algorithms for multirotor and VTOL unmanned aircraft, including attitude, angular rate, velocity, position, and trajectory control.
  • Develop, modify, and maintain embedded C++ software within the PX4 autopilot framework, including flight controllers, navigation logic, state machines, and supporting modules.
  • Develop and improve VTOL flight control capabilities, including hover control, fixed-wing control, transition logic, control allocation, and gain scheduling.
  • Debug and resolve issues within the PX4 flight stack, including controller behavior, estimator performance, sensor integration, actuator outputs, and interactions between software modules.
  • Understand and work with PX4 architecture, including uORB messaging, module interfaces, parameters, flight modes, and vehicle state management.
  • Analyze aircraft dynamics and flight control performance to evaluate stability, responsiveness, robustness, and tracking accuracy.
  • Use simulation, dynamic models, and flight test data to develop, tune, and validate flight control algorithms.
  • Perform system identification and flight data analysis to characterize aircraft dynamics, actuator response, and controller performance.
  • Develop, evaluate, and improve navigation and state estimation performance, including sensor fusion, calibration, and handling degraded sensor conditions.
  • Investigate and resolve flight performance issues such as oscillations, instability, transition failures, poor tracking performance, sensor anomalies, and actuator saturation.
  • Integrate new aircraft configurations, sensors, actuators, and propulsion systems into PX4, including modifications to flight control and vehicle configuration software.
  • Develop and execute software-in-the-loop (SIL/SITL), hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), bench, and flight tests to validate flight control functionality.
  • Collaborate with flight test engineers to define test objectives, develop flight test plans, support flight operations, and analyze flight logs to identify and resolve anomalies.
  • Define measurable flight control performance requirements and develop appropriate verification methods.
  • Participate in PX4 software development activities, including Git-based workflows, code reviews, debugging, automated testing, and software release management.
  • Work closely with mechanical, electrical, avionics, systems, and flight software engineers to ensure aircraft hardware and software meet overall vehicle performance requirements.
  • Support new product development, including prototype integration, initial flight testing, performance optimization, and transition to production.
  • Document software changes, control algorithms, design decisions, and test results in accordance with company engineering and quality procedures.
  • Provide technical mentorship and guidance to junior engineers.
  • Follow all applicable company safety, quality, and export-control procedures.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a closely related technical field.
  • 6+ years of professional experience in GNC, flight controls, embedded software, or autonomous systems development, including substantial hands-on flight control software experience.
  • Hands-on experience developing, modifying, or debugging PX4 autopilot software at the source-code level.
  • Strong proficiency in C++, including experience developing, debugging, and maintaining software for embedded or real-time systems.
  • Strong understanding of classical control theory, including PID control, feedback systems, stability, frequency response, and controller tuning.
  • Experience implementing or tuning control algorithms for aircraft, robotic platforms, or other physical dynamic systems.
  • Familiarity with PX4 flight control architecture, including controllers, flight modes, parameters, and inter-module communication.
  • Proficiency in Python for engineering analysis, simulation, automation, and flight data processing.
  • Understanding of rigid-body dynamics, coordinate systems, state estimation, sensor behavior, and actuator limitations.
  • Experience analyzing flight logs or other time-series engineering data to diagnose control-system or software issues.
  • Experience using simulation, software testing, hardware testing, or flight testing to validate control algorithms.
  • Experience with Linux development environments, Git, and software debugging tools.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, including the ability to diagnose problems involving interactions between software, controls, and hardware.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary engineering teams and communicate technical findings clearly.
  • Ability to work on-site in Torrance, CA, and travel to flight test locations as needed (approximately 15%).
  • Ability to access export-controlled technical data consistent with the Export-Control Requirements described below.

Additional Desired Qualifications

  • Master's or Ph.D. in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Controls, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Extensive experience developing or modifying PX4 flight controllers, including multicopter, fixed-wing, or VTOL control modules.
  • Experience with PX4 internals, including uORB, EKF2, Commander, Navigator, control allocation, and actuator output pipelines.
  • Experience developing and tuning flight controls for multirotor, fixed-wing, or hybrid VTOL aircraft.
  • Experience with VTOL transition control, control allocation, gain scheduling, and aircraft with multiple flight configurations.
  • Experience with system identification, frequency-domain analysis, and flight-test-based controller tuning.
  • Experience with Kalman filtering, state estimation, and navigation sensor integration.
  • Experience with MAVLink, QGroundControl, and other common autopilot communication and ground control systems.
  • Experience using PX4 SITL simulation environments, Gazebo, or other simulation and testing frameworks.
  • Experience with embedded Linux, NuttX, or real-time operating systems.
  • Experience developing automated tests, unit tests, and integration tests for embedded software.
  • Experience taking an aircraft or robotic system from prototype development through initial testing and production.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced engineering environment with rapid development, test, and iteration cycles.
  • Familiarity with GPS-denied navigation, visual odometry, or other advanced navigation techniques.
  • Familiarity with aerospace software verification and configuration-management practices.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions

Work is performed in office, laboratory, manufacturing, and outdoor flight test environments, with occasional exposure to weather, noise, and temperature extremes.

Must be able to stand, walk, and work at a bench or test stand for extended periods during integration and testing, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Occasionally lift and carry up to 25 lbs, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Must follow established safety procedures and use required personal protective equipment when working around aircraft, propellers, lithium batteries, and test equipment.

Travel to flight test sites may occasionally involve early mornings, weekends, or extended hours during scheduled test campaigns.

Requires frequent use of computers and standard office equipment for software development, engineering analysis, documentation, and communication.

Background Check

This position will require successfully completing a post-offer background check. Qualified candidates with a criminal history will be considered and are not automatically disqualified, consistent with federal and state law.

Equal Opportunity and Export-Control Requirements

Red Cat Holdings is an equal opportunity employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship or immigration status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Certain positions may require access to hardware, software, technology, or technical data controlled under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). Such access may be provided without export authorizations to individuals who meet the applicable definition of a U.S. person. This generally includes U.S. citizens and nationals, lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees.

Applicants who do not meet the definition of a U.S. person may be considered for employment where Red Cat Holdings can obtain any required export authorization or implement an appropriate access-control arrangement.

Employment decisions will be made in accordance with applicable export-control requirements and anti-discrimination laws. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Any requirement concerning immigration sponsorship will be stated separately and will not be used as a substitute for an individualized export-control assessment.

E-Verify

The company participates in E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility in accordance with applicable requirements.

Compensation

$113,965 – $178,135 annual base salary, plus an annual equity package and potential bonuses.

title: Insurance Manager
description:
Job Title: General Insurance Manager

Type: Full-Time

Location: Dubai, UAE


About the Role
